verses.original: ਆਖੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਲਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aakh gunaa kal aaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Chant the Praises of the Lord; Kali Yuga has come.

verses.original: ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tih jug keraa rahiaa tapaavas je gun dheh ta paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The justice of the previous three ages is gone. One obtains virtue, only if the Lord bestows it. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ ਸਰਾ ਨਿਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: kal kalavaalee saraa nibeRee kaajee kirasanaa hoaa ||
verses.translation: In this turbulent age of Kali Yuga, Muslim law decides the cases, and the blue-robed Qazi is the judge.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: baanee brahamaa bedh atharaban karanee keerat lahiaa ||5||
verses.translation: The Guru's Bani has taken the place of Brahma's Veda, and the singing of the Lord's Praises are good deeds. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਸਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜਤ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਨੇਊ ॥
verses.translit: pat vin poojaa sat vin sa(n)jam jat vin kaahe janeuoo ||
verses.translation: Worship without faith; self-discipline without truthfulness; the ritual of the sacred thread without chastity - what good are these?

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਚੜਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਚ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naavahu dhovahu tilak chaRaavahu such vin soch na hoiee ||6||
verses.translation: You may bathe and wash, and apply a ritualistic tilak mark to your forehead, but without inner purity, there is no understanding. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kal paravaan kateb kuraan ||
verses.translation: In Kali Yuga, the Koran and the Bible have become famous.

verses.original: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰਹੇ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
verses.translit: pothee pa(n)ddit rahe puraan ||
verses.translation: The Pandit's scriptures and the Puraanas are not respected.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਰਹਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naau bhiaa rahamaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord's Name now is Rehmaan, the Merciful.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kar karataa too eko jaan ||7||
verses.translation: Know that there is only One Creator of the creation. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਏਦੂ ਉਪਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee edhoo upar karam nahee ||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. There is no action higher than this.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਓਲਾਮਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਹੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: je ghar hodhai ma(n)gan jaieeaai fir olaamaa milai tahee ||8||1||
verses.translation: If someone goes out to beg for what is already in his own home, then he should be chastised. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹਿ ਮੜੀ ਬਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jag parabodheh maRee badhaaveh ||
verses.translation: You preach to the world, and set up your house.

verses.original: ਆਸਣੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aasan tiaag kaahe sach paaveh ||
verses.translation: Abandoning your Yogic postures, how will you find the True Lord?

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mamataa moh kaaman hitakaaree ||
verses.translation: You are attached to possessiveness and the love of sexual pleasure.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa aaudhootee naa sa(n)saaree ||1||
verses.translation: You are not a renunciate, nor a man of the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਬੈਸਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: jogee bais rahahu dhubidhaa dhukh bhaagai ||
verses.translation: Yogi, remain seated, and the pain of duality will run away from you.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਤ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar maagat laaj na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You beg from door to door, and you don't feel ashamed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੀਤ ਨ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਆਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: gaaveh geet na cheeneh aap ||
verses.translation: You sing the songs, but you do not understand your own self.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਿਵਰੈ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiau laagee nivarai parataap ||
verses.translation: How will the burning pain within be relieved?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਚੈ ਮਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh rachai man bhai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, let your mind be absorbed in the Lord's Love,

verses.original: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਸਹਜ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhikhiaa sahaj veechaaree khai ||2||
verses.translation: and you will intuitively experience the charity of contemplation. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਸਮ ਚੜਾਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhasam chaRai kareh paakha(n)dd ||
verses.translation: You apply ashes to your body, while acting in hypocrisy.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਹਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh saheh jam dda(n)dd ||
verses.translation: Attached to Maya, you will be beaten by Death's heavy club.

verses.original: ਫੂਟੈ ਖਾਪਰੁ ਭੀਖ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: fooTai khaapar bheekh na bhai ||
verses.translation: Your begging bowl is broken; it will not hold the charity of the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan baadhiaa aavai jai ||3||
verses.translation: Bound in bondage, you come and go. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਜਤੀ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bi(n)dh na raakheh jatee kahaaveh ||
verses.translation: You do not control your seed and semen, and yet you claim to practice abstinence.

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮਾਗਤ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiee maagat trai lobhaaveh ||
verses.translation: You beg from Maya, lured by the three qualities.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਦਇਆ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: niradhiaa nahee jot ujaalaa ||
verses.translation: You have no compassion; the Lord's Light does not shine in you.

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਬੂਡੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: booddat boodde sarab ja(n)jaalaa ||4||
verses.translation: You are drowned, drowned in worldly entanglements. ||4||

verses.original: ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਬਹੁ ਥਟੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhekh kareh khi(n)thaa bahu thaTooaa ||
verses.translation: You wear religious robes, and your patched coat assumes many disguises.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਨਟੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTho khel khelai bahu naTooaa ||
verses.translation: You play all sorts of false tricks, like a juggler.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agan chi(n)taa bahu jaare ||
verses.translation: The fire of anxiety burns brightly within you.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: vin karamaa kaise utaras paare ||5||
verses.translation: Without the karma of good actions, how can you cross over? ||5||

verses.original: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਫਟਕ ਬਨਾਈ ਕਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhraa faTak banaiee kaan ||
verses.translation: You make ear-rings of glass to wear in your ears.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਗਿਆਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: mukat nahee bidhiaa bigiaan ||
verses.translation: But liberation does not come from learning without understanding.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੋੁਭਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa i(n)dhree saadh luobhaanaa ||
verses.translation: You are lured by the tastes of the tongue and sex organs.

verses.original: ਪਸੂ ਭਏ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨੀਸਾਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: pasoo bhe nahee miTai neesaanaa ||6||
verses.translation: You have become a beast; this sign cannot be erased. ||6||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਲੋਗਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: tirabidh logaa tirabidh jogaa ||
verses.translation: The people of the world are entangled in the three modes; the Yogis are entangled in the three modes.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ਚੂਕਸਿ ਸੋਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh veechaarai chookas sogaa ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, sorrows are dispelled.

verses.original: ਊਜਲੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: uoojal saachu su sabadh hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, one becomes radiant, pure and truthful.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jogee jugat veechaare soi ||7||
verses.translation: One who contemplates the true lifestyle is a Yogi. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਪਹਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: tujh peh nau nidh too karanai jog ||
verses.translation: The nine treasures are with You, Lord; You are potent, the Cause of causes.

verses.original: ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: thaap uthaape kare su hog ||
verses.translation: You establish and disestablish; whatever You do, happens.

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚੀਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat sa(n)jam sach sucheet ||
verses.translation: One who practices celibacy, chastity, self-control, truth and pure consciousness

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮੀਤੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jogee tirabhavan meet ||8||2||
verses.translation: - O Nanak, that Yogi is the friend of the three worlds. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਖਟੁ ਮਟੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: khaT maT dhehee man bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Above the six chakras of the body dwells the detached mind.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: surat sabadh dhun a(n)tar jaagee ||
verses.translation: Awareness of the vibration of the Word of the Shabad has been awakened deep within.

verses.original: ਵਾਜੈ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: vaajai anahadh meraa man leenaa ||
verses.translation: The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds within; my mind is attuned to it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee sach naam pateenaa ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, my faith is confirmed in the True Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: praanee raam bhagat sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, through devotion to the Lord, peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har har meeThaa laagai har har naam samaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, seems sweet to the Gurmukh, who merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਵਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh bivaraj samaae ||
verses.translation: Eradicating attachment to Maya, one merges into the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai mel milaae ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, we unite in His Union.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan niramolak heeraa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tit raataa meraa man dheeraa ||2||
verses.translation: Attuned to it, the mind is comforted and encouraged. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa rog na laagai ||
verses.translation: The diseases of egotism and possessiveness do not afflict

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam bhagat jam kaa bhau bhaagai ||
verses.translation: one who worships the Lord. Fear of the Messenger of Death runs away.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jam ja(n)dhaar na laagai moh ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death, the enemy of the soul, does not touch me at all.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: niramal naam ridhai har soh ||3||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Name of the Lord illuminates my heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਏ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh beechaar bhe nira(n)kaaree ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, we become Nirankaari - we come to belong to the Formless Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat jaage dhuramat parahaaree ||
verses.translation: Awakening to the Guru's Teachings, evil-mindedness is taken away.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin jaag rahe liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Remaining awake and aware night and day, lovingly focused on the Lord,

verses.original: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jeevan mukat gat a(n)tar paiee ||4||
verses.translation: one becomes Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive. He finds this state deep within himself. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਲਿਪਤ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: alipat gufaa meh raheh niraare ||
verses.translation: In the secluded cave, I remain unattached.

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: tasakar pa(n)ch sabadh sa(n)ghaare ||
verses.translation: With the Word of the Shabad, I have killed the five thieves.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: par ghar jai na man ddolaae ||
verses.translation: My mind does not waver or go to the home of any other.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹਉ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sahaj nira(n)tar rahau samaae ||5||
verses.translation: I remain intuitively absorbed deep within. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਉਧੂਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaag rahe aaudhootaa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I remain awake and aware, unattached.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਪਰੋਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadh bairaagee tat parotaa ||
verses.translation: Forever detached, I am woven into the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਸੂਤਾ ਮਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jag sootaa mar aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The world is asleep; it dies, and comes and goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh na sojhee pai ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it does not understand. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh sabadh vajai dhin raatee ||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates day and night.

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: avigat kee gat gurmukh jaatee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows the state of the eternal, unchanging Lord God.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਜਾਨੀ ਜਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: tau jaanee jaa sabadh pachhaanee ||
verses.translation: When someone realizes the Shabad, then he truly knows.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: eko rav rahiaa nirabaanee ||7||
verses.translation: The One Lord is permeating and pervading everywhere in Nirvaanaa. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n samaadh sahaj man raataa ||
verses.translation: My mind is intuitively absorbed in the state of deepest Samaadhi;

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਹਉ ਲੋਭਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: taj hau lobhaa eko jaataa ||
verses.translation: renouncing egotism and greed, I have come to know the One Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur chele apanaa man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: When the disciple's mind accepts the Guru,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhoojaa meT samaaniaa ||8||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, duality is eradicated, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਾ ਗਣਹਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahaa ganeh na kareh beechaar ||
verses.translation: You calculate the auspicious days, but you do not understand

verses.original: ਸਾਹੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahe uoopar eka(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: that the One Creator Lord is above these auspicious days.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis gur milai soiee bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows the way, who meets the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmat hoi ta hukam pachhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: When one follows the Guru's Teachings, then he realizes the Hukam of God's Command. ||1||

verses.original: ਝੂਠੁ ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh na bol paadde sach kaheeaai ||
verses.translation: Do not tell lies, O Pandit; O religious scholar, speak the Truth.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai jai sabadh ghar laheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When egotism is eradicated through the Word of the Shabad, then one finds His home. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਣਿ ਗਣਿ ਜੋਤਕੁ ਕਾਂਡੀ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gan gan jotak kaa(n)ddee keenee ||
verses.translation: Calculating and counting, the astrologer draws the horoscope.

verses.original: ਪੜੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: paRai sunaavai tat na cheenee ||
verses.translation: He studies it and announces it, but he does not understand reality.

verses.original: ਸਭਸੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabhasai uoopar gur sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Understand, that the Word of the Guru's Shabad is above all.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਉ ਨ ਸਗਲੀ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hor kathanee badhau na sagalee chhaar ||2||
verses.translation: Do not speak of anything else; it is all just ashes. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਵਹਿ ਧੋਵਹਿ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੈਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: naaveh dhoveh poojeh sailaa ||
verses.translation: You bathe, wash, and worship stones.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੈਲੋ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin har raate mailo mailaa ||
verses.translation: But without being imbued with the Lord, you are the filthiest of the filthy.

verses.original: ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਰਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: garab nivaar milai prabh saarath ||
verses.translation: Subduing your pride, you shall receive the supreme wealth of God.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਾਰਥਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mukat praan jap har kirataarath ||3||
verses.translation: The mortal is liberated and emancipated, meditating on the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਵਾਚੈ ਵਾਦੁ ਨ ਬੇਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaachai vaadh na bedh beechaarai ||
verses.translation: You study the arguments, but do not contemplate the Vedas.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਿਤਰਾ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap ddubai kiau pitaraa taarai ||
verses.translation: You drown yourself - how will you save your ancestors?

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT braham cheenai jan koi ||
verses.translation: How rare is that person who realizes that God is in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta sojhee hoi ||4||
verses.translation: When one meets the True Guru, then he understands. ||4||

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਐ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ganat ganeeaai sahasaa dhukh jeeaai ||
verses.translation: Making his calculations, cynicism and suffering afflict his soul.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee saran pavai sukh theeaai ||
verses.translation: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਹਮ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar aparaadh saran ham aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I sinned and made mistakes, but now I seek Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gur har bheTe purab kamaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: The Guru led me to meet the Lord, according to my past actions. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur saran na aaieeaai braham na paieeaai ||
verses.translation: If one does not enter the Guru's Sanctuary, God cannot be found.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਿ ਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaieeaai janam mar aaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, one is born, only to die, and come back again.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧਉ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhar baadhau marai bikaar ||
verses.translation: Dying in corruption, he is bound and gagged at Death's door.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: naa ridhai naam na sabadh achaar ||6||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not in his heart, and he does not act according to the Shabad. ||6||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਧੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮਿਸਰ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik paadhe pa(n)ddit misar kahaaveh ||
verses.translation: Some call themselves Pandits, religious scholars and spiritual teachers.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa raate mahal na paaveh ||
verses.translation: Tinged with double-mindedness, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis gur parasaadhee naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: One who takes the Support of the Naam, by Guru's Grace,

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਪਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: koT madhe ko jan aapaar ||7||
verses.translation: is a rare person, one among millions, incomparable. ||7||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: ek buraa bhalaa sach ekai ||
verses.translation: One is bad, and another good, but the One True Lord is contained in all.

verses.original: ਬੂਝੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟੇਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: boojh giaanee satagur kee Tekai ||
verses.translation: Understand this, O spiritual teacher, through the support of the True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh viralee eko jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: rare indeed is that Gurmukh, who realizes the One Lord.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa meT samaaniaa ||8||
verses.translation: His comings and goings cease, and he merges in the Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai hiradhai eka(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Those who have the One Universal Creator Lord within their hearts,

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarab gunee saachaa beechaar ||
verses.translation: possess all virtues; they contemplate the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai bhaanai karam kamaavai ||
verses.translation: One who acts in harmony with the Guru's Will,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੯॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak saache saach samaavai ||9||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||9||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਠੁ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: haTh nigrahu kar kaiaa chheejai ||
verses.translation: Practicing restraint by Hatha Yoga, the body wears away.

verses.original: ਵਰਤੁ ਤਪਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: varat tapan kar man nahee bheejai ||
verses.translation: The mind is not softened by fasting or austerities.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam sar avar na poojai ||1||
verses.translation: Nothing else is equal to worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sev manaa har jan sa(n)g keejai ||
verses.translation: Serve the Guru, O mind, and associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jam ja(n)dhaar joh nahee saakai sarapan ddas na sakai har kaa ras peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The tyrannical Messenger of Death cannot touch you, and the serpent of Maya cannot sting you, when you drink in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਵਾਦੁ ਪੜੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਜਗੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaadh paRai raagee jag bheejai ||
verses.translation: The world reads the arguments, and is softened only by music.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun bikhiaa janam mareejai ||
verses.translation: In the three modes and corruption, they are born and die.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਹੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin dhookh saheejai ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, they endure suffering and pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਾੜਸਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: chaaRas pavan si(n)ghaasan bheejai ||
verses.translation: The Yogi draws the breath upwards, and opens the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: niaulee karam khaT karam kareejai ||
verses.translation: He practices inner cleansing and the six rituals of purification.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin birathaa saas leejai ||3||
verses.translation: But without the Lord's Name, the breath he draws is useless. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar pa(n)ch agan kiau dheeraj dheejai ||
verses.translation: The fire of the five passions burns within him; how can he be calm?

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚੋਰੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਦੁ ਲਹੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar chor kiau saadh laheejai ||
verses.translation: The thief is within him; how can he taste the taste?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi kaiaa gaR leejai ||4||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh conquers the body-fortress. ||4||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਰਮੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar mail teerath bharameejai ||
verses.translation: With filth within, he wanders around at places of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਚਾ ਕਿਆ ਸੋਚ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man nahee soochaa kiaa soch kareejai ||
verses.translation: His mind is not pure, so what is the use of performing ritual cleansings?

verses.original: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kirat piaa dhos kaa kau dheejai ||5||
verses.translation: He carries the karma of his own past actions; who else can he blame? ||5||

verses.original: ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n na khaeh dhehee dhukh dheejai ||
verses.translation: He does not eat food; he tortures his body.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਥੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur giaan tirapat nahee theejai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru's wisdom, he is not satisfied.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: manmukh janamai janam mareejai ||6||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is born only to die, and be born again. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur poochh sa(n)gat jan keejai ||
verses.translation: Go, and ask the True Guru, and associate with the Lord's humble servants.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man har raachai nahee janam mareejai ||
verses.translation: Your mind shall merge into the Lord, and you shall not be reincarnated to die again.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin kiaa karam keejai ||7||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, what can anyone do? ||7||

verses.original: ਊਂਦਰ ਦੂੰਦਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)dhar dhoo(n)dhar paas dhareejai ||
verses.translation: Silence the mouse scurrying around within you.

verses.original: ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhur kee sevaa raam raveejai ||
verses.translation: Serve the Primal Lord, by chanting the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai kirapaa prabh keejai ||8||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God blesses us with His Name, when He grants His Grace. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਤਭੁਜੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar utabhuj avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: The created Universe emanated from within You; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo kaheeaai so prabh te hoiee ||
verses.translation: Whatever is said to be, is from You, O God.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jugeh juga(n)tar saahib sach soiee ||
verses.translation: He is the True Lord and Master, throughout the ages.

verses.original: ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: autapat paralau avar na koiee ||1||
verses.translation: Creation and destruction do not come from anyone else. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa meraa Thaakur gahir ga(n)bheer ||
verses.translation: Such is my Lord and Master, profound and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin japiaa tin hee sukh paiaa har kai naam na lagai jam teer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on Him, finds peace. The arrow of the Messenger of Death does not strike one who has the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam ratan heeraa niramol ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel, a diamond.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib amar atol ||
verses.translation: The True Lord Master is immortal and immeasurable.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa soochee saachaa bol ||
verses.translation: That tongue which chants the True Name is pure.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੋਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar saachaa naahee rol ||2||
verses.translation: The True Lord is in the home of the self; there is no doubt about it. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਅਸਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik ban meh baiseh ddoogar asathaan ||
verses.translation: Some sit in the forests, and some make their home in the mountains.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਪਚਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam bisaar pacheh abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, they rot away in egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kiaa giaan dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, what is the use of spiritual wisdom and meditation?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paaveh dharageh maan ||3||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਠੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: haTh aha(n)kaar karai nahee paavai ||
verses.translation: Acting stubbornly in egotism, one does not find the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਠ ਪੜੈ ਲੇ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: paaTh paRai le lok sunaavai ||
verses.translation: Studying the scriptures, reading them to other people,

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮਸਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: teerath bharamas biaadh na jaavai ||
verses.translation: and wandering around at places of pilgrimage, the disease is not taken away.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kaise sukh paavai ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, how can one find peace? ||4||

verses.original: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jatan karai bi(n)dh kivai na rahaiee ||
verses.translation: No matter how much he tries, he cannot control his semen and seed.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਨਰਕੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa ddolai narake paiee ||
verses.translation: His mind wavers, and he falls into hell.

verses.original: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੋ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jam pur baadho lahai sajaiee ||
verses.translation: Bound and gagged in the City of Death, he is tortured.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bin naavai jeeau jal bal jaiee ||5||
verses.translation: Without the Name, his soul cries out in agony. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik kete mun dhevaa ||
verses.translation: The many Siddhas and seekers, silent sages and demi-gods

verses.original: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹਿ ਭੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: haTh nigreh na tirapataaveh bhevaa ||
verses.translation: cannot satisfy themselves by practicing restraint through Hatha Yoga.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਗਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh veechaar gaheh gur sevaa ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates the Word of the Shabad, and serves the Guru

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: man tan niramal abhimaan abhevaa ||6||
verses.translation: - his mind and body become immaculate, and his egotistical pride is obliterated. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karam milai paavai sach naau ||
verses.translation: Blessed with Your Grace, I obtain the True Name.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਰਹਉ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum saranaagat rahau subhaau ||
verses.translation: I remain in Your Sanctuary, in loving devotion.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum te upajio bhagatee bhaau ||
verses.translation: Love for Your devotional worship has welled up within me.

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jap jaapau gurmukh har naau ||7||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai garab jai man bheenai ||
verses.translation: When one is rid of egotism and pride, his mind is drenched in the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਝੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh na paavas paakha(n)dd keenai ||
verses.translation: Practicing fraud and hypocrisy, he does not find God.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨਹੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh nahee ghar baar ||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he cannot find the Lord's Door.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh tat beechaar ||8||6||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh contemplates the essence of reality. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਬਉਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਨਮੇ ਤਿਉ ਮਰਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jiau aaiaa tiau jaaveh baure jiau janame tiau maran bhiaa ||
verses.translation: As you come, so will you leave, you fool; as you were born, so will you die.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau ras bhog ke'ee tetaa dhukh laagai naam visaar bhavajal piaa ||1||
verses.translation: As you enjoy pleasures, so will you suffer pain. Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you will fall into the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan dhan dhekhat garab giaa ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon your body and wealth, you are so proud.

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਵਧਾਇਹਿ ਕੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kanik kaamanee siau het vadhaieh kee naam visaareh bharam giaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your love for gold and sexual pleasures increases; why have you forgotten the Naam, and why do you wander in doubt? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੀਲੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪਿੰਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਸਟੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jat sat sa(n)jam seel na raakhiaa pret pi(n)jar meh kaasaT bhiaa ||
verses.translation: You do not practice truth, abstinence, self-discipline or humility; the ghost within your skeleton has turned to dry wood.

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਨ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan isanaan na sa(n)jam saadhasa(n)gat bin baadh jiaa ||2||
verses.translation: You have not practiced charity, donations, cleansing baths or austerities. Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, your life has gone in vain. ||2||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: laalach laagai naam bisaario aavat jaavat janam giaa ||
verses.translation: Attached to greed, you have forgotten the Naam. Coming and going, your life has been ruined.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੇਸ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲ ਗਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa jam dhai kes geh maarai surat nahee mukh kaal giaa ||3||
verses.translation: When the Messenger of Death grabs you by your hair, you will be punished. You are unconscious, and have fallen into Death's mouth. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis ni(n)dhaa taat paraiee hiradhai naam na sarab dhiaa ||
verses.translation: Day and night, you jealously slander others; in your heart, you have neither the Naam, nor compassion for all.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadh na gat pat paaveh raam naam bin narak giaa ||4||
verses.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you will not find salvation or honor. Without the Lord's Name, you shall go to hell. ||4||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਟੂਆ ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹ ਪਾਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh ves kareh naTooaa jiau moh paap meh galat giaa ||
verses.translation: In an instant, you change into various costumes, like a juggler; you are entangled in emotional attachment and sin.

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਗਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eit ut maiaa dhekh pasaaree moh maiaa kai magan bhiaa ||5||
verses.translation: You gaze here and there upon the expanse of Maya; you are intoxicated with attachment to Maya. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਥਾਰ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kareh bikaar vithaar ghanere surat sabadh bin bharam piaa ||
verses.translation: You act in corruption, and put on ostentatious shows, but without awareness of the Shabad, you have fallen into confusion.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: haumai rog mahaa dhukh laagaa gurmat levahu rog giaa ||6||
verses.translation: You suffer great pain from the disease of egotism. Following the Guru's Teachings, you shall be rid of this disease. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਕਉ ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਕਤ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukh sa(n)pat kau aavat dhekhai saakat man abhimaan bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Seeing peace and wealth come to him, the faithless cynic become proud in his mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis kaa ih tan dhan so fir levai a(n)tar sahasaa dhookh piaa ||7||
verses.translation: But He who owns this body and wealth, takes them back again, and then the mortal feels anxiety and pain deep within. ||7||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal kichh saath na chaalai jo dheesai sabh tiseh miaa ||
verses.translation: At the very last instant, nothing goes along with you; all is visible only by His Mercy.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh apara(n)par so prabh har naam ridhai lai paar piaa ||8||
verses.translation: God is our Primal and Infinite Lord; enshrining the Lord's Name in the heart, one crosses over. ||8||

verses.original: ਮੂਏ ਕਉ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਸਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mooe kau roveh kiseh sunaaveh bhai saagar asaraal piaa ||
verses.translation: You weep for the dead, but who hears you weeping? The dead have fallen to the serpent in the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਲਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: dhekh kuTa(n)b maiaa gireh ma(n)dhar saakat ja(n)jaal paraal piaa ||9||
verses.translation: Gazing upon his family, wealth, household and mansions, the faithless cynic is entangled in worthless worldly affairs. ||9||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਆਏ ਤਾ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਪਠਾਏ ਚਾਲੇ ਤਿਨੈ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa aae taa tineh paThaae chaale tinai bulai liaa ||
verses.translation: He comes when the Lord sends him; when the Lord calls him back, he goes.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa bakhasanahaarai bakhas liaa ||10||
verses.translation: Whatever he does, the Lord is doing. The Forgiving Lord forgives him. ||10||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin eh chaakhiaa raam rasain tin kee sa(n)gat khoj bhiaa ||
verses.translation: I seek to be with those who have tasted this sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: ridh sidh budh giaan guroo te paiaa mukat padhaarath saran piaa ||11||
verses.translation: Wealth, miraculous spiritual powers, wisdom and spiritual knowledge, are obtained from the Guru. The treasure of liberation is obtained in His Sanctuary. ||11||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh gurmukh sam kar jaanaa harakh sog te birakat bhiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same; he remains untouched by joy and sorrow.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap maar gurmukh har paae naanak sahaj samai liaa ||12||7||
verses.translation: Conquering his self-conceit, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; O Nanak, he intuitively merges into the Lord. ||12||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਦਖਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee dhakhanee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Dakhanee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jat sat sa(n)jam saach dhiraRaiaa saach sabadh ras leenaa ||1||
verses.translation: Abstinence, chastity, self-control and truthfulness have been implanted within me; I am imbued with the sublime essence of the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: meraa gur dhiaal sadhaa ra(n)g leenaa ||
verses.translation: My Merciful Guru remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis rahai ek liv laagee saache dhekh pateenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Day and night, He remains lovingly focused on the One Lord; gazing upon the True Lord, He is pleased. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਹੈ ਗਗਨ ਪੁਰਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਮੈਸਰਿ ਅਨਹਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗੀਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rahai gagan pur dhirasaT samaisar anahat sabadh ra(n)geenaa ||2||
verses.translation: He abides in the Tenth Gate, and looks equally upon all; He is imbued with the unstruck sound current of the Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਸੀਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sat ba(n)dh kupeen bharipur leenaa jihavaa ra(n)g raseenaa ||3||
verses.translation: Wearing the loin-cloth of chastity, He remains absorbed in the all-pervading Lord; His tongue enjoys the taste of God's Love. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੁ ਰਾਚੇ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: milai gur saache jin rach raache kirat veechaar pateenaa ||4||
verses.translation: The One who created the creation has met the True Guru; contemplating the Guru's lifestyle, He is pleased. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਮਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਏਕਾ ਏਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ek meh sarab sarab meh ekaa eh satigur dhekh dhikhaiee ||5||
verses.translation: All are in the One, and the One is in all. This is what the True Guru has shown me. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਖਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jin ke'ee kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa so prabh lakhan na jaiee ||6||
verses.translation: He who created the worlds, solar systems and galaxies - that God cannot be known. ||6||

verses.original: ਦੀਪਕ ਤੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: dheepak te dheepak paragaasiaa tirabhavan jot dhikhaiee ||7||
verses.translation: From the lamp of God, the lamp within is lit; the Divine Light illuminates the three worlds. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਸਚ ਮਹਲੀ ਬੈਠੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sachai takhat sach mahalee baiThe nirabhau taaRee laiee ||8||
verses.translation: The Guru sits on the true throne in the true mansion; He is attuned, absorbed in the Fearless Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: moh giaa bairaagee jogee ghaT ghaT ki(n)guree vaiee ||9||
verses.translation: The Guru, the detached Yogi, has enticed the hearts of all; He plays His harp in each and every heart. ||9||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੀ ਛੂਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak saran prabhoo kee chhooTe satigur sach sakhaiee ||10||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is emancipated; the True Guru becomes our true help and support. ||10||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਉਹਠਿ ਹਸਤ ਮੜੀ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਧਰਣਿ ਗਗਨ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aauhaTh hasat maRee ghar chhaiaa dharan gagan kal dhaaree ||1||
verses.translation: He has made His home in the monastery of the heart; He has infused His power into the earth and the sky. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੇਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ketee sabadh udhaaree sa(n)tahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs have saved so very many, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mamataa maar haumai sokhai tirabhavan jot tumaaree ||2||
verses.translation: He conquers attachment, and eradicates egotism, and sees Your Divine Light pervading the three worlds, Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: manasaa maar manai meh raakhai satigur sabadh veechaaree ||3||
verses.translation: He conquers desire, and enshrines the Lord within his mind; he contemplates the Word of the True Guru's Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: si(n)n(g)ee surat anaahadh vaajai ghaT ghaT jot tumaaree ||4||
verses.translation: The horn of consciousness vibrates the unstruck sound current; Your Light illuminates each and every heart, Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬੇਣੁ ਤਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਰਜਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: parapa(n)ch ben tahee man raakhiaa braham agan parajaaree ||5||
verses.translation: He plays the flute of the universe in his mind, and lights the fire of God. ||5||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat mil ahinis dheepak niramal jot apaaree ||6||
verses.translation: Bringing together the five elements, day and night, the Lord's lamp shines with the Immaculate Light of the Infinite. ||6||

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਲਉਕੇ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: rav sas lauke ih tan ki(n)guree vaajai sabadh niraaree ||7||
verses.translation: The right and left nostrils, the sun and the moon channels, are the strings of the body-harp; they vibrate the wondrous melody of the Shabad. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: siv nagaree meh aasan aaudhoo alakh aga(n)m apaaree ||8||
verses.translation: The true hermit obtains a seat in the City of God, the invisible, inaccessible, infinite. ||8||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਪੰਚ ਵਸਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagaree ih man raajaa pa(n)ch vaseh veechaaree ||9||
verses.translation: The mind is the king of the city of the body; the five sources of knowledge dwell within it. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਦਲੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: sabadh ravai aasan ghar raajaa adhal kare gunakaaree ||10||
verses.translation: Seated in his home, this king chants the Shabad; he administers justice and virtue. ||10||

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਕਾਲੁ ਕਹੇ ਕਹਿ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਮੂਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kaal bikaal kahe keh bapure jeevat mooaa man maaree ||11||
verses.translation: What can poor death or birth say to him? Conquering his mind, he remains dead while yet alive. ||11||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਇਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes ik moorat aape karataa kaaree ||12||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are manifestations of the One God. He Himself is the Doer of deeds. ||12||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਧਿ ਤਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: kaiaa sodh tarai bhav saagar aatam tat veechaaree ||13||
verses.translation: One who purifies his body, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean; he contemplates the essence of his own soul. ||13||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te sadhaa sukh paiaa a(n)tar sabadh raviaa gunakaaree ||14||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, he finds everlasting peace; deep within, the Shabad permeates him, coloring him with virtue. ||14||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: aape mel le gunadhaataa haumai tirasanaa maaree ||15||
verses.translation: The Giver of virtue unites with Himself, one who conquers egotism and desire. ||15||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਚਉਥੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: trai gun meTe chauthai varatai ehaa bhagat niraaree ||16||
verses.translation: Eradicating the three qualities, dwell in the fourth state. This is the unparalleled devotional worship. ||16||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jog sabadh aatam cheenai hiradhai ek muraaree ||17||
verses.translation: This is the Yoga of the Gurmukh: Through the Shabad, he understands his own soul, and he enshrines within his heart the One Lord. ||17||

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: manooaa asathir sabadhe raataa ehaa karanee saaree ||18||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Shabad, his mind becomes steady and stable; this is the most excellent action. ||18||

verses.original: ਬੇਦੁ ਬਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: bedh baadh na paakha(n)dd aaudhoo gurmukh sabadh beechaaree ||19||
verses.translation: This true hermit does not enter into religious debates or hypocrisy; the Gurmukh contemplates the Shabad. ||19||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jog kamaavai aaudhoo jat sat sabadh veechaaree ||20||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh practices Yoga - he is the true hermit; he practices abstinence and truth, and contemplates the Shabad. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai man maare aaudhoo jog jugat veechaaree ||21||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind is the true hermit; he understands the Way of Yoga. ||21||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਧੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh bhavajal hai avadhoo sabadh tarai kul taaree ||22||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya is the terrifying world-ocean; through the Shabad, the true hermit saves himself, and his ancestors as well. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: sabadh soor jug chaare aaudhoo baanee bhagat veechaaree ||23||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Shabad, you shall be a hero throughout the four ages, O hermit; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani in devotion. ||23||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: eh man maiaa mohiaa aaudhoo nikasai sabadh veechaaree ||24||
verses.translation: This mind is enticed by Maya, O hermit; contemplating the Shabad, you shall find release. ||24||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase mel milaae naanak saran tumaaree ||25||9||
verses.translation: He Himself forgives, and unites in His Union; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||25||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਰਮੈ ਦੀਆ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਰਿ ਤੂ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saramai dheeaa mu(n)dhraa ka(n)nee pai jogee khi(n)thaa kar too dhiaa ||
verses.translation: Make humility your ear-rings, Yogi, and compassion your patched coat.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਜਿਣਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan bibhoot lai jogee taa teen bhavan jin liaa ||1||
verses.translation: Let coming and going be the ashes you apply to your body, Yogi, and then you shall conquer the three worlds. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee ki(n)guree vajai jogee ||
verses.translation: Play that harp, Yogi,

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit ki(n)guree anahadh vaajai har siau rahai liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: which vibrates the unstruck sound current, and remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਝੋਲੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh pat kar jholee jogee a(n)mirat naam bhugat paiee ||
verses.translation: Make truth and contentment your plate and pouch, Yogi; take the Ambrosial Naam as your food.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhiaan kaa kar dda(n)ddaa jogee si(n)n(g)ee surat vajaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Make meditation your walking stick, Yogi, and make higher consciousness the horn you blow. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਲਪਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man dhiraR kar aasan bais jogee taa teree kalapanaa jaiee ||
verses.translation: Make your stable mind the Yogic posture you sit in, Yogi, and then you shall be rid of your tormenting desires.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਚੜਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagaree meh ma(n)gan chaReh jogee taa naam palai paiee ||3||
verses.translation: Go begging in the village of the body, Yogi, and then, you shall obtain the Naam in your lap. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eit ki(n)guree dhiaan na laagai jogee naa sach palai pai ||
verses.translation: This harp does not center you in meditation, Yogi, nor does it bring the True Name into your lap.

verses.original: ਇਤੁ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eit ki(n)guree saa(n)t na aavai jogee abhimaan na vichahu jai ||4||
verses.translation: This harp does not bring you peace, Yogi, nor eliminate egotism from within you. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਇ ਪਤ ਲਾਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhau bhaau dhui pat lai jogee ih sareer kar dda(n)ddee ||
verses.translation: Make the Fear of God, and the Love of God, the two gourds of your lute, Yogi, and make this body its neck.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੰਤੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਖੰਡੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoveh taa ta(n)tee vaajai in bidh tirasanaa kha(n)ddee ||5||
verses.translation: Become Gurmukh, and then vibrate the strings; in this way, your desires shall depart. ||5||

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hukam bujhai so jogee kaheeaai ekas siau chit laae ||
verses.translation: One who understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command is called a Yogi; he links his consciousness to the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sahasaa tooTai niramal hovai jog jugat iv paae ||6||
verses.translation: His cynicism is dispelled, and he becomes immaculately pure; this is how he finds the Way of Yoga. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee aavadhaa sabh kichh binasai har setee chit lai ||
verses.translation: Everything that comes into view shall be destroyed; focus your consciousness on the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur naal teree bhaavanee laagai taa ieh sojhee pai ||7||
verses.translation: Enshrine love for the True Guru, and then you shall obtain this understanding. ||7||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eh jog na hovai jogee j kuTa(n)b chhodd parabhavan kareh ||
verses.translation: This is not Yoga, O Yogi, to abandon your family and wander around.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਰੀਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹਹਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gireh sareer meh har har naam gur parasaadhee apanaa har prabh laheh ||8||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is within the household of the body. By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Lord God. ||8||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih jagat miTee kaa putalaa jogee is meh rog vaddaa tirasanaa maiaa ||
verses.translation: This world is a puppet of clay, Yogi; the terrible disease, the desire for Maya is in it.

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਜੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: anek jatan bhekh kare jogee rog na jai gavaiaa ||9||
verses.translation: Making all sorts of efforts, and wearing religious robes, Yogi, this disease cannot be cured. ||9||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam aaukhadh hai jogee jis no ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is the medicine, Yogi; the Lord enshrines it in the mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai soiee boojhai jog jugat so paae ||10||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh understands this; he alone finds the Way of Yoga. ||10||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jogai kaa maarag bikham hai jogee jis no nadhar kare so paae ||
verses.translation: The Path of Yoga is very difficult, Yogi; he alone finds it, whom God blesses with His Grace.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar eko vekhai vichahu bharam chukaae ||11||
verses.translation: Inside and outside, he sees the One Lord; he eliminates doubt from within himself. ||11||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਜਾਈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin vajaiee ki(n)guree vaajai jogee saa ki(n)guree vajai ||
verses.translation: So play the harp which vibrates without being played, Yogi.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak mukat hoveh jogee saache raheh samai ||12||1||10||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, thus you shall be liberated, Yogi, and remain merged in the True Lord. ||12||1||10||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat khajaanaa gurmukh jaataa satigur boojh bujhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The treasure of devotional worship is revealed to the Gurmukh; the True Guru has inspired me to understand this understanding. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu gurmukh dhei vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Saints, the Gurmukh is blessed with glorious greatness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sach rahahu sadhaa sahaj sukh upajai kaam karodh vichahu jaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Dwelling always in Truth, celestial peace wells up; sexual desire and anger are eliminated from within. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aap chhodd naam liv laagee mamataa sabadh jalaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Eradicating self-conceit, remain lovingly focused on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Shabad, burn away possessiveness. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis te upajai tis te binasai a(n)te naam sakhaiee ||4||
verses.translation: By Him we are created, and by Him we are destroyed; in the end, the Naam will be our only help and support. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨਹ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sadhaa hajoor dhoor neh dhekhahu rachanaa jin rachaiee ||5||
verses.translation: He is ever-present; don't think that He is far away. He created the creation. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh ravai ghaT a(n)tar sache siau liv laiee ||6||
verses.translation: Deep within your heart, chant the True Word of the Shabad; remain lovingly absorbed in the True Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat meh naam niramolak vaddai bhaag paiaa jaiee ||7||
verses.translation: The Priceless Naam is in the Society of the Saints; by great good fortune, it is obtained. ||7||

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਠਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: bharam na bhoolahu satigur sevahu man raakhahu ik Thaiee ||8||
verses.translation: Do not be deluded by doubt; serve the True Guru, and keep your mind steady in one place. ||8||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰਦੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: bin naavai sabh bhoolee firadhee birathaa janam gavaiee ||9||
verses.translation: Without the Name, everyone wanders around in confusion; they waste away their lives in vain. ||9||

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਹੰਢੈ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: jogee jugat gavaiee ha(n)ddai paakha(n)dd jog na paiee ||10||
verses.translation: Yogi, you have lost the Way; you wander around confused. Through hypocrisy, Yoga is not attained. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: siv nagaree meh aasan baisai gur sabadhee jog paiee ||11||
verses.translation: Sitting in Yogic postures in the City of God, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall find Yoga. ||11||

verses.original: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: dhaatur baajee sabadh nivaare naam vasai man aaiee ||12||
verses.translation: Restrain your restless wanderings through the Shabad, and the Naam will come to dwell in your mind. ||12||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: eh sareer saravar hai sa(n)tahu isanaan kare liv laiee ||13||
verses.translation: This body is a pool, O Saints; bathe in it, and enshrine love for the Lord. ||13||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naam isanaan kareh se jan niramal sabadhe mail gavaiee ||14||
verses.translation: Those who cleanse themselves through the Naam, are the most immaculate people; through the Shabad, they wash off their filth. ||14||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਚੇਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: trai gun achet naam cheteh naahee bin naavai binas jaiee ||15||
verses.translation: Trapped by the three qualities, the unconscious person does not think of the Naam; without the Name, he wastes away. ||15||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes trai moorat tiragun bharam bhulaiee ||16||
verses.translation: The three forms of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are trapped in the three qualities, lost in confusion. ||16||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee tirakuTee chhooTai chauthai padh liv laiee ||17||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, this triad is eradicated, and one is lovingly absorbed in the fourth state. ||17||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paReh paR vaadh vakhaaneh ti(n)naa boojh na paiee ||18||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read, study and discuss the arguments; they do not understand. ||18||

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਤੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa maate bharam bhulaae upadhes kaheh kis bhaiee ||19||
verses.translation: Engrossed in corruption, they wander in confusion; who can they possibly instruct, O Siblings of Destiny? ||19||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kee uootam baanee jug jug rahee samaiee ||20||
verses.translation: The Bani, the Word of the humble devotee is the most sublime and exalted; it prevails throughout the ages. ||20||

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: baanee laagai so gat paae sabadhe sach samaiee ||21||
verses.translation: One who is committed to this Bani is emancipated, and through the Shabad, merges in Truth. ||21||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagaree sabadhe khoje naam nava(n) nidh paiee ||22||
verses.translation: One who searches the village of the body, through the Shabad, obtains the nine treasures of the Naam. ||22||

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: manasaa maar man sahaj samaanaa bin rasanaa usatat karaiee ||23||
verses.translation: Conquering desire, the mind is absorbed in intuitive ease, and then one chants the Lord's Praises without speaking. ||23||

verses.original: ਲੋਇਣ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: loin dhekh rahe bisamaadhee chit adhisaT lagaiee ||24||
verses.translation: Let your eyes gaze upon the Wondrous Lord; let your consciousness be attached to the Unseen Lord. ||24||

verses.original: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: adhisaT sadhaa rahai niraalam jotee jot milaiee ||25||
verses.translation: The Unseen Lord is forever absolute and immaculate; one's light merges into the Light. ||25||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: hau gur saalaahee sadhaa aapanaa jin saachee boojh bujhaiee ||26||
verses.translation: I praise my Guru forever, who has inspired me to understand this true understanding. ||26||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੭॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee naavahu gat pat paiee ||27||2||11||
verses.translation: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Name, may I find salvation and honor. ||27||2||11||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kee poojaa dhula(n)bh hai sa(n)tahu kahanaa kachhoo na jaiee ||1||
verses.translation: It is so hard to obtain that devotional worship of the Lord, O Saints. It cannot be described at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu gurmukh pooraa paiee ||
verses.translation: O Saints, as Gurmukh, find the Perfect Lord,

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naamo pooj karaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har bin sabh kichh mailaa sa(n)tahu kiaa hau pooj chaRaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, everything is filthy, O Saints; what offering should I place before Him? ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har saache bhaavai saa poojaa hovai bhaanaa man vasaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases the True Lord is devotional worship; His Will abides in the mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: poojaa karai sabh lok sa(n)tahu manmukh thai na paiee ||4||
verses.translation: Everyone worships Him, O Saints, but the self-willed manmukh is not accepted or approved. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਏਹ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai man niramal sa(n)tahu eh poojaa thai paiee ||5||
verses.translation: If someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, his mind become immaculate, O Saints; such worship is accepted and approved. ||5||

verses.original: ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: pavit paavan se jan saache ek sabadh liv laiee ||6||
verses.translation: Sanctified and pure are those true beings, who enshrine love for the Shabad. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin naavai hor pooj na hovee bharam bhulee lokaiee ||7||
verses.translation: There is no worship of the Lord, other than the Name; the world wanders, deluded by doubt. ||7||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aap pachhaanai sa(n)tahu raam naam liv laiee ||8||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh understands his own self, O Saints; he lolvingly centers his mind on the Lord's Name. ||8||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: aape niramal pooj karaae gur sabadhee thai paiee ||9||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord Himself inspires worship of Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is accepted and approved. ||9||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: poojaa kareh par bidh nahee jaaneh dhoojai bhai mal laiee ||10||
verses.translation: Those who worship Him, but do not know the Way, are polluted with the love of duality. ||10||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su poojaa jaanai bhaanaa man vasaiee ||11||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, knows what worship is; the Lord's Will abides within his mind. ||11||

verses.original: ਭਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: bhaane te sabh sukh paavai sa(n)tahu a(n)te naam sakhaiee ||12||
verses.translation: One who accepts the Lord's Will obtains total peace, O Saints; in the end, the Naam will be our help and support. ||12||

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: apanaa aap na pachhaaneh sa(n)tahu kooR kareh vaddiaaiee ||13||
verses.translation: One who does not understand his own self, O Saints, falsely flatters himself. ||13||

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd keenai jam nahee chhoddai lai jaasee pat gavaiee ||14||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death does not give up on those who practices hypocrisy; they are dragged away in disgrace. ||14||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: jin a(n)tar sabadh aap pachhaaneh gat mit tin hee paiee ||15||
verses.translation: Those who have the Shabad deep within, understand themselves; they find the way of salvation. ||15||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: eh manooaa su(n)n samaadh lagaavai jotee jot milaiee ||16||
verses.translation: Their minds enter into the deepest state of Samaadhi, and their light is absorbed into the Light. ||16||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: sun sun gurmukh naam vakhaaneh satasa(n)gat melaiee ||17||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs listen constantly to the Naam, and chant it in the True Congregation. ||17||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gaavai aap gavaavai dhar saachai sobhaa paiee ||18||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs sing the Lord's Praises, and erase self-conceit; they obtain true honor in the Court of the Lord. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: saachee baanee sach vakhaanai sach naam liv laiee ||19||
verses.translation: True are their words; they speak only the Truth; they lovingly focus on the True Name. ||19||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: bhai bha(n)jan at paap nikha(n)jan meraa prabh a(n)t sakhaiee ||20||
verses.translation: My God is the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of sin; in the end, He is our only help and support. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap varatai naanak naam vaddiaaiee ||21||3||12||
verses.translation: He Himself pervades and permeates everything; O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained through the Naam. ||21||3||12||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham kuchal kucheel at abhimaanee mil sabadhe mail utaaree ||1||
verses.translation: I am filthy and polluted, proud and egotistical; receiving the Word of the Shabad, my filth is taken away. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu gurmukh naam nisataaree ||
verses.translation: O Saints, the Gurmukhs are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar karatai aap savaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Name abides deep within their hearts. The Creator Himself embellishes them. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: paaras parase fir paaras hoe har jeeau apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves become the philosopher's stone; the Dear Lord Himself blesses them with His Mercy. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eik bhekh kareh fireh abhimaanee tin jooaai baajee haaree ||3||
verses.translation: Some wear religious robes, and wander around in pride; they lose their life in the gamble. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eik anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee raam naam ur dhaaree ||4||
verses.translation: Some worship the Lord in devotion, night and day; day and night, they keep the Lord's Name enshrined in their hearts. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: anadhin raate sahaje maate sahaje haumai maaree ||5||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with Him night and day, are spontaneously intoxicated with Him; they intuitively conquer their ego. ||5||

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhai bin bhagat na hoiee kab hee bhai bhai bhagat savaaree ||6||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, devotional worship is never performed; through the Love and the Fear of God, devotional worship is embellished. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabadh jalaiaa giaan tat beechaaree ||7||
verses.translation: The Shabad burns away emotional attachment to Maya, and then one contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape aap karaae karataa aape bakhas bha(n)ddaaree ||8||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself inspires us to act; He Himself blesses us with His treasure. ||8||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਗਾਵਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: tis kiaa gunaa kaa a(n)t na paiaa hau gaavaa sabadh veechaaree ||9||
verses.translation: The limits of His virtues cannot be found; I sing His Praises and contemplate the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਪੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: har jeeau japee har jeeau saalaahee vichahu aap nivaaree ||10||
verses.translation: I chant the Lord's Name, and praise my Dear Lord; egotism is eradicated from within me. ||10||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਖੁਟ ਸਚੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath gur te paiaa akhuT sache bha(n)ddaaree ||11||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam is obtained from the Guru; the treasures of the True Lord are inexhaustible. ||11||

verses.original: ਅਪਣਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਠਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: apaniaa bhagataa no aape tuThaa apanee kirapaa kar kal dhaaree ||12||
verses.translation: He Himself is pleased with His devotees; by His Grace, He infuses His strength within them. ||12||

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: tin saache naam kee sadhaa bhukh laagee gaavan sabadh veechaaree ||13||
verses.translation: They always feel hunger for the True Name; they sing and contemplate the Shabad. ||13||

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh kichh hai tis kaa aakhan bikham beechaaree ||14||
verses.translation: Soul, body and everything are His; it is so difficult to speak of, and contemplate Him. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sabadh lage seiee jan nisatare bhaujal paar utaaree ||15||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who are attached to the Shabad are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||15||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: bin har saache ko paar na paavai boojhai ko veechaaree ||16||
verses.translation: Without the True Lord, no one can cross over; how rare are those who contemplate and understand this. ||16||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa soiee paiaa mil har sabadh savaaree ||17||
verses.translation: We obtain only that which is pre-ordained; receiving the Lord's Shabad, we are embellished. ||17||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ka(n)chan sabadhe raatee saachai nai piaaree ||18||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Shabad, the body becomes golden, and loves only the True Name. ||18||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)mirat rahee bharapoore paieeaai sabadh veechaaree ||19||
verses.translation: The body is then filled to overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, obtained by contemplating the Shabad. ||19||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ਫੂਟਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: jo prabh khojeh seiee paaveh hor fooT mooe aha(n)kaaree ||20||
verses.translation: Those who seek God, find Him; others burst and die from their own egotism. ||20||

verses.original: ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: baadhee binaseh sevak seveh gur kai het piaaree ||21||
verses.translation: The debaters waste away, while the servants serve, with love and affection for the Guru. ||21||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: so jogee tat giaan beechaare haumai tirasanaa maaree ||22||
verses.translation: He alone is a Yogi, who contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom, and conquers egotism and thirsty desire. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa tinai pachhaataa jis no kirapaa tumaaree ||23||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is revealed to those upon whom You bestow Your Grace, O Lord. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੂਏ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: satigur na seveh maiaa laage ddoob mooe aha(n)kaaree ||24||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru, and who are attached to Maya, are drowned; they die in their own egotism. ||24||

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਚੈ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਰਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: jichar a(n)dhar saas tichar sevaa keechai jai mileeaai raam muraaree ||25||
verses.translation: As long as there is breath within you, so long you should serve the Lord; then, you will go and meet the Lord. ||25||

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨੬॥
