verses.translit: anadhin jaagat rahai dhin raatee apane pria preet piaaree ||26||
verses.translation: Night and day, she remains awake and aware, day and night; she is the darling bride of her Beloved Husband Lord. ||26||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਾਰੀ ਵਾਰਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: tan man vaaree vaar ghumaiee apane gur viTahu balihaaree ||27||
verses.translation: I offer my body and mind in sacrifice to my Guru; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||27||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh binas jaigaa ubare sabadh veechaaree ||28||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya will end and go away; only by contemplating the Shabad will you be saved. ||28||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਜਗਾਏ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: aap jagaae seiee jaage gur kai sabadh veechaaree ||29||
verses.translation: They are awake and aware, whom the Lord Himself awakens; so contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||29||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਮੂਏ ਜਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਜੀਵੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੩੦॥੪॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak seiee mooe j naam na cheteh bhagat jeeve veechaaree ||30||4||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who do not remember the Naam are dead. The devotees live in contemplative meditation. ||30||4||13||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam khajaanaa gur te paiaa tirapat rahe aaghaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Receiving the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, from the Guru, I remain satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu gurmukh mukat gat paiee ||
verses.translation: O Saints, the Gurmukhs attain the state of liberation.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek naam vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar poore kee vaddiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One Name abides deep within my heart; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aape karataa aape bhugataa dhedhaa rijak sabaiee ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He Himself gives sustenance to all. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo kichh karanaa so kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever He wants to do, He is doing; no one else can do anything. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape saaje sirasaT upaae sir sir dha(n)dhai laiee ||4||
verses.translation: He Himself fashions and creates the creation; He links each and every person to their task. ||4||

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tiseh sarevahu taa sukh paavahu satigur mel milaiee ||5||
verses.translation: If you serve Him, then you will find peace; the True Guru will unite you in His Union. ||5||

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aapanaa aap aap upaae alakh na lakhanaa jaiee ||6||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself creates Himself; the Unseen Lord cannot be seen. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਆਪੇ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aape maar jeevaale aape tis no til na tamaiee ||7||
verses.translation: He Himself kills, and brings back to life; He does not have even an iota of greed. ||7||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: eik dhaate ik ma(n)gate keete aape bhagat karaiee ||8||
verses.translation: Some are made givers, and some are made beggars; He Himself inspires us to devotional worship. ||8||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee jinee eko jaataa sache rahe samaiee ||9||
verses.translation: Those who know the One Lord are very fortunate; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: aap saroop siaanaa aape keemat kahan na jaiee ||10||
verses.translation: He Himself is beautiful, He Himself is wise and clever; His worth cannot be expressed. ||10||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: aape dhukh sukh paae a(n)tar aape bharam bhulaiee ||11||
verses.translation: He Himself infuses pain and pleasure; He Himself makes them wander around in doubt. ||11||

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਨਿਗੁਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਫਿਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: vaddaa dhaataa gurmukh jaataa niguree a(n)dh firai lokaiee ||12||
verses.translation: The Great Giver is revealed to the Gurmukh; without the Guru, the world wanders in darkness. ||12||

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jinee chaakhiaa tinaa saadh aaiaa satigur boojh bujhaiee ||13||
verses.translation: Those who taste, enjoy the flavor; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||13||

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: eikanaa naavahu aap bhulaae ikanaa gurmukh dhei bujhaiee ||14||
verses.translation: Some, the Lord causes to forget and lose the Name; others become Gurmukh, and are granted this understanding. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa saalaahih sa(n)tahu tis dhee vaddee vaddiaaiee ||15||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, praise the Lord, O Saints; how glorious is His greatness! ||15||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਰਿ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: tis bin avar na koiee raajaa kar tapaavas banat banaiee ||16||
verses.translation: There is no other King except Him; He administers justice, as He has made it. ||16||

verses.original: ਨਿਆਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਸਾਚਾ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: niaau tisai kaa hai sadh saachaa virale hukam manaiee ||17||
verses.translation: His justice is always True; how rare are those who accept His Command. ||17||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: tis no praanee sadhaa dhiaavahu jin gurmukh banat banaiee ||18||
verses.translation: O mortal, meditate forever on the Lord, who has made the Gurmukh in His making. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸੀਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai so jan seejhai jis hiradhai naam vasaiee ||19||
verses.translation: That humble being who meets with the True Guru is fulfilled; the Naam abides in his heart. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: sachaa aap sadhaa hai saachaa baanee sabadh sunaiee ||20||
verses.translation: The True Lord is Himself forever True; He announces His Bani, the Word of His Shabad. ||20||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਈ ॥੨੧॥੫॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sun vekh rahiaa visamaadh meraa prabh raviaa srab thaiee ||21||5||14||
verses.translation: Nanak is wonderstruck, hearing and seeing His Lord; my God is all-pervading, everywhere. ||21||5||14||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee keeaa paravirat pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: Some make a big show of their worldly influence.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee keeaa poojaa bisathaaraa ||
verses.translation: Some make a big show of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਨਿਵਲ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee nival bhuia(n)gam saadhe ||
verses.translation: Some practice inner cleansing teahniques, and control the breath through Kundalini Yoga.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: moh dheen har har aaraadhe ||1||
verses.translation: I am meek; I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa bharosaa piaare ||
verses.translation: I place my faith in You alone, O Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਵੇਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan na jaanaa vesaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not know any other way. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee girahu taj van kha(n)dd paiaa ||
verses.translation: Some abandon their homes, and live in the forests.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਮੋਨਿ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee mon aaudhoot sadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Some put themselves on silence, and call themselves hermits.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਹਤਉ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਭਗਉਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: koiee kahatau ana(n)n bhagautee ||
verses.translation: Some claim that they are devotees of the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਓਟ ਲੀਤੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: moh dheen har har oT leetee ||2||
verses.translation: I am meek; I seek the shelter and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਹਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee kahiaa hau teerath vaasee ||
verses.translation: Some say that they live at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਅੰਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: koiee a(n)n taj bhiaa udhaasee ||
verses.translation: Some refuse food and become Udaasis, shaven-headed renunciates.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਭਵਨੁ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee bhavan sabh dharatee kariaa ||
verses.translation: Some have wandered all across the earth.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: moh dheen har har dhar pariaa ||3||
verses.translation: I am meek; I have fallen at the door of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਮੈ ਕੁਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee kahiaa mai kuleh vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: Some say that they belong to great and noble families.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਕਹਿਆ ਬਾਹ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee kahiaa baeh bahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Some say that they have the arms of their many brothers to protect them.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਮੈ ਧਨਹਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: koiee kahai mai dhaneh pasaaraa ||
verses.translation: Some say that they have great expanses of wealth.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: moh dheen har har aadhaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: I am meek; I have the support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਘੂਘਰ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee ghooghar nirat karaiee ||
verses.translation: Some dance, wearing ankle bells.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੂ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kinahoo varat nem maalaa paiee ||
verses.translation: Some fast and take vows, and wear malas.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਗੋਪੀ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee tilak gopee cha(n)dhan laiaa ||
verses.translation: Some apply ceremonial tilak marks to their foreheads.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: moh dheen har har har dhiaaiaa ||5||
verses.translation: I am meek; I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਟਕ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee sidh bahu cheTak laae ||
verses.translation: Some work spells using the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਟ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee bhekh bahu thaaT banaae ||
verses.translation: Some wear various religious robes and establish their authority.

verses.original: ਕਿਨਹੀ ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਬਹੁ ਖੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: kinahee ta(n)t ma(n)t bahu khevaa ||
verses.translation: Some perform Tantric spells, and chant various mantras.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: moh dheen har har har sevaa ||6||
verses.translation: I am meek; I serve the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||6||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: koiee chatur kahaavai pa(n)ddit ||
verses.translation: One calls himself a wise Pandit, a religious scholar.

verses.original: ਕੋ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਡਿਤ ॥
verses.translit: ko khaT karam sahit siau ma(n)ddit ||
verses.translation: One performs the six rituals to appease Shiva.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਆਚਾਰ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: koiee karai aachaar sukaranee ||
verses.translation: One maintains the rituals of pure lifestyle, and does good deeds.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: moh dheen har har har saranee ||7||
verses.translation: I am meek; I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗ ਸੋਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagale karam dharam jug sodhe ||
verses.translation: I have studied the religions and rituals of all the ages.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai ih man na prabodhe ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, this mind is not awakened.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jau saadhasa(n)g paiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, when I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,

verses.original: ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਾ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: boojhee tirasanaa mahaa seetalaiaa ||8||1||
verses.translation: my thirsty desires were satisfied, and I was totally cooled and soothed. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਪਾਨੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਘਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eis paanee te jin too ghariaa ||
verses.translation: He created you out of this water.

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਲੇ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee kaa le dhehuraa kariaa ||
verses.translation: From clay, He fashioned your body.

verses.original: ਉਕਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aukat jot lai surat pareekhiaa ||
verses.translation: He blessed you with the light of reason and clear consciousness.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maat garabh meh jin too raakhiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In your mother's womb, He preserved you. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਿ ਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaar samhaar janaa ||
verses.translation: Contemplate your Savior Lord.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagale chhodd beechaar manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Give up all others thoughts, O mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਪ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhe'ee tudh baap mahataaree ||
verses.translation: He gave you your mother and father;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਪੁਤ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhe'ee bhraat put haaree ||
verses.translation: he gave you your charming children and siblings;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhe'ee tudh banitaa ar meetaa ||
verses.translation: he gave you your spouse and friends;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis Thaakur kau rakh leh cheetaa ||2||
verses.translation: enshrine that Lord and Master in your consciousness. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin dheeaa tudh pavan amolaa ||
verses.translation: He gave you the invaluable air;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin dheeaa tudh neer niramolaa ||
verses.translation: He gave you the priceless water;

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਬਲਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin dheeaa tudh paavak balanaa ||
verses.translation: He gave you burning fire;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੀ ਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis Thaakur kee rahu man saranaa ||3||
verses.translation: let your mind remain in the Sanctuary of that Lord and Master. ||3||

verses.original: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੋਜਨ ਦੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: chhateeh a(n)mirat jin bhojan dhe'ee ||
verses.translation: He gave you the thirty-six varieties of tasty foods;

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਠਹਰਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar thaan Thaharaavan kau ke'ee ||
verses.translation: He gave you a place within to hold them;

verses.original: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਦੀਓ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਬਲਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: basudhaa dheeo baratan balanaa ||
verses.translation: He gave you the earth, and things to use;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tis Thaakur ke chit rakh charanaa ||4||
verses.translation: enshrine in your consciousness the feet of that Lord and Master. ||4||

verses.original: ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: pekhan kau netr sunan kau karanaa ||
verses.translation: He gave you eyes to see, and ears to hear;

verses.original: ਹਸਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: hasat kamaavan baasan rasanaa ||
verses.translation: He gave you hands to work with, and a nose and a tongue;

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਚਲਨ ਕਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: charan chalan kau sir keeno meraa ||
verses.translation: He gave you feet to walk upon, and the crowning glory of your head;

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: man tis Thaakur ke poojahu pairaa ||5||
verses.translation: O mind, worship the Feet of that Lord and Master. ||5||

verses.original: ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: apavitr pavitr jin too kariaa ||
verses.translation: He transformed you from impure to pure;

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sagal jon meh too sir dhariaa ||
verses.translation: He installed you above the heads of all creatures;

verses.original: ਅਬ ਤੂ ਸੀਝੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਸੀਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: ab too seejh bhaavai nahee seejhai ||
verses.translation: now, you may fulfill your destiny or not;

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kaaraj savarai man prabh dhiaaieejai ||6||
verses.translation: Your affairs shall be resolved, O mind, meditating on God. ||6||

verses.original: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: e'eehaa uoohaa ekai ohee ||
verses.translation: Here and there, only the One God exists.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jat kat dhekheeaai tat tat tohee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there You are.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਤ ਮਨਿ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis sevat man aalas karai ||
verses.translation: My mind is reluctant to serve Him;

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਸਰੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jis visariaai ik nimakh na sarai ||7||
verses.translation: forgetting Him, I cannot survive, even for an instant. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham aparaadhee niraguneeaare ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner, without any virtue at all.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਰਮਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naa kichh sevaa naa karamaare ||
verses.translation: I do not serve You, or do any good deeds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur bohith vaddabhaagee miliaa ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the boat - the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sa(n)g paathar tariaa ||8||2||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak has crossed over, with Him. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai ra(n)g ras roop ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives enjoying pleasures and beauty.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai mai baap poot ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives with their mothers, fathers and children.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai raaj milakh vaapaaraa ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives in power, estates and trade.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bihaavai har naam adhaaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Saints pass their lives with the support of the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਚਨਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਬਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: rachanaa saach banee ||
verses.translation: The world is the creation of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kaa ek dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai bedh ar baadh ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives in arguments and debates about scriptures.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai rasanaa saadh ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives tasting flavors.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਲਪਟਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai lapaT sa(n)g naaree ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives attached to women.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਰਚੇ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t rache keval naam muraaree ||2||
verses.translation: The Saints are absorbed only in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਖੇਲਤ ਜੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai khelat jooaa ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives gambling.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai amalee hooaa ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives getting drunk.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਚੋੁਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai par dharab chuoraae ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives stealing the property of others.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jan bihaavai naam dhiaae ||3||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord pass their lives meditating on the Naam. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਤਪ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai jog tap poojaa ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives in Yoga, strict meditation, worship and adoration.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਭਰਮੀਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo rog sog bharameejaa ||
verses.translation: Some, in sickness, sorrow and doubt.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਪਵਨ ਧਾਰ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo pavan dhaar jaat bihaae ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives practicing control of the breath.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bihaavai keeratan gaae ||4||
verses.translation: The Saints pass their lives singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਾਲਤ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai dhin rain chaalat ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives walking day and night.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਾਲਤ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai so piR maalat ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives on the fields of battle.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਬਾਲ ਪੜਾਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai baal paRaavat ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives teaching children.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bihaavai har jas gaavat ||5||
verses.translation: The Saints pass their lives singing the Lord's Praise. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਨਟ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai naT naaTik nirate ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives as actors, acting and dancing.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਜੀਆਇਹ ਹਿਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai jeeaaieh hirate ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives taking the lives of others.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਡਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai raaj meh ddarate ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives ruling by intimidation.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bihaavai har jas karate ||6||
verses.translation: The Saints pass their lives chanting the Lord's Praises. ||6||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਮਤਾ ਮਸੂਰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai mataa masoorat ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives counseling and giving advice.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਰੂਰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai sevaa jaroorat ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives forced to serve others.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਧਤ ਜੀਵਤ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo bihaavai sodhat jeevat ||
verses.translation: Some pass their lives exploring life's mysteries.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t bihaavai har ras peevat ||7||
verses.translation: The Saints pass their lives drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit ko laiaa tit hee lagaanaa ||
verses.translation: As the Lord attaches us, so we are attached.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂੜੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko mooR nahee ko siaanaa ||
verses.translation: No one is foolish, and no one is wise.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jis dhevai naau || naanak taa kai bal bal jaau ||8||3||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those who are blessed by His Grace to receive His Name. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਾਵਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਟ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavaa agan rahe har booT ||
verses.translation: Even in a forest fire, some trees remain green.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੇ ਛੂਟ ॥
verses.translit: maat garabh sa(n)kaT te chhooT ||
verses.translation: The infant is released from the pain of the mother's womb.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa naam simarat bhau jai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, fear is dispelled.

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taise sa(n)t janaa raakhai har rai ||1||
verses.translation: Just so, the Sovereign Lord protects and saves the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: aaise raakhanahaar dhiaal ||
verses.translation: Such is the Merciful Lord, my Protector.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jat kat dhekhau tum pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see You cherishing and nurturing. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਖਾ ਮਿਟੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: jal peevat jiau tikhaa miTa(n)t ||
verses.translation: As thirst is quenched by drinking water;

verses.original: ਧਨ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਵਤ ਕੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: dhan bigasai gireh aavat ka(n)t ||
verses.translation: as the bride blossoms forth when her husband comes home;

verses.original: ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lobhee kaa dhan praan adhaar ||
verses.translation: as wealth is the support of the greedy person

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tiau har jan har har naam piaar ||2||
verses.translation: - just so, the humble servant of the Lord loves the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਸਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kirasaanee jiau raakhai rakhavaalaa ||
verses.translation: As the farmer protects his fields;

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਦਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa dhiaa jiau baalaa ||
verses.translation: as the mother and father show compassion to their child;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: preetam dhekh preetam mil jai ||
verses.translation: as the lover merges on seeing the beloved;

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tiau har jan raakhai ka(n)Th lai ||3||
verses.translation: just so does the Lord hug His humble servant close in His Embrace. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: jiau a(n)dhule pekhat hoi ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: As the blind man is in ecstasy, when he can see again;

verses.original: ਗੂੰਗਾ ਬਕਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਬਹੁ ਛੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: goo(n)gaa bakat gaavai bahu chha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: and the mute, when he is able to speak and sing songs;

verses.original: ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਰਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pi(n)gul parabat parate paar ||
verses.translation: and the cripple, being able to climb over the mountain

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har kai naam sagal udhaar ||4||
verses.translation: - just so, the Name of the Lord saves all. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੀਤ ਕੋ ਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: jiau paavak sa(n)g seet ko naas ||
verses.translation: As cold is dispelled by fire,

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਛਤ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: aaise praachhat sa(n)tasa(n)g binaas ||
verses.translation: sins are driven out in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਬੁਨਿ ਕਾਪਰ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
verses.translit: jiau saabun kaapar uoojal hot ||
verses.translation: As cloth is cleaned by soap,

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਤ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naam japat sabh bhram bhau khot ||5||
verses.translation: just so, by chanting the Naam, all doubts and fears are dispelled. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jiau chakavee sooraj kee aas ||
verses.translation: As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jiau chaatirak boo(n)dh kee piaas ||
verses.translation: as the rainbird thirsts for the rain drop,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਾਦ ਕਰਨ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau kura(n)k naadh karan samaane ||
verses.translation: as the deer's ears are attuned to the sound of the bell,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tiau har naam har jan maneh sukhaane ||6||
verses.translation: the Lord's Name is pleasing to the mind of the Lord's humble servant. ||6||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree kirapaa te laagee preet ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, we love You.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਤਾ ਆਏ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal bhe taa aae cheet ||
verses.translation: When You show Mercy, then You come into our minds.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhaaree tin dhaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: When the Support of the earth granted His Grace,

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan te hoiee chhuTakaar ||7||
verses.translation: then I was released from my bonds. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh thaan dhekhe nain aloi ||
verses.translation: I have seen all places with my eyes wide open.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: There is no other than Him.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਛੂਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhai chhooTe gur parasaadh ||
verses.translation: Doubt and fear are dispelled, by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak pekhio sabh bisamaadh ||8||4||
verses.translation: Nanak sees the wondrous Lord everywhere. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਪੇਖੀਅਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh pekhe'eeh prabh sagal tumaaree dhaaranaa ||1||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures that are seen, God, depend on Your Support. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਾਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih man har kai naam udhaaranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This mind is saved through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khin meh thaap uthaape kudharat sabh karate ke kaaranaa ||2||
verses.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes, by His Creative Power. All is the Creation of the Creator. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh jhooTh ni(n)dhaa saadhoo sa(n)g bidhaaranaa ||3||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander are banished in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਖੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਨਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam japat man niramal hovai sookhe sookh gudhaaranaa ||4||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and life is passed in absolute peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਨ ਹਾਰਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: bhagat saran jo aavai praanee tis ieehaa uoohaa na haaranaa ||5||
verses.translation: That mortal who enters the Sanctuary of the devotees, does not lose out, here or hereafter. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਸਾਰਨਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sookh dhookh is man kee birathaa tum hee aagai saaranaa ||6||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain, and the condition of this mind, I place before You, Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਲਨਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: too dhaataa sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aapan keeaa paalanaa ||7||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of all beings; You cherish what You have made. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਵਾਰਨਾ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: anik baar koT jan uoopar naanak va(n)n(j)ai vaaranaa ||8||5||
verses.translation: So many millions of times, Nanak is a sacrifice to Your humble servants. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadhee
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Ashtapadee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਦੇਇ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan bheTat paap sabh naaseh har siau dhei milaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Receiving the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all sins are erased, and He unites me with the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa gur paramesar sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: My Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kaa naam dhiraRaae a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He implants the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God within us; in the end, He is our help and support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਦੂਖ ਕਾ ਡੇਰਾ ਭੰਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sagal dhookh kaa dderaa bha(n)naa sa(n)t dhoor mukh laiee ||2||
verses.translation: The source of all pain within is destroyed; I apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to my forehead. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਵੰਞਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: patit puneet ke'ee khin bheetar agiaan a(n)dher va(n)n(j)aiee ||3||
verses.translation: In an instant, He purifies the sinners, and dispels the darkness of ignorance. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: karan kaaran samarath suaamee naanak tis saranaiee ||4||
verses.translation: The Lord is all-powerful, the Cause of causes. Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan toR charan kamal dhiraRaae ek sabadh liv laiee ||5||
verses.translation: Shattering the bonds, the Guru implants the Lord's lotus feet within, and lovingly attunes us to the One Word of the Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਓ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop bikhiaa te kaaddio saach sabadh ban aaiee ||6||
verses.translation: He has lifted me up, and pulled me out of the deep, dark pit of sin; I am attuned to the True Shabad. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaa sahasaa chookaa baahuR katahu na dhaiee ||7||
verses.translation: The fear of birth and death is taken away; I shall never wander again. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: naam rasain ih man raataa a(n)mrit pee tirapataiee ||8||
verses.translation: This mind is imbued with the sublime elixir of the Naam; drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, it is satisfied. ||8||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)g mil keeratan gaiaa nihachal vasiaa jaiee ||9||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; I dwell in the eternal, unchanging place. ||9||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: poorai gur pooree mat dheenee har bin aan na bhaiee ||10||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has given me the perfect teachings; there is nothing except the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||10||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan paiaa vaddabhaagee naanak narak na jaiee ||11||
verses.translation: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam, by great good fortune; O Nanak, I shall not fall into hell. ||11||

verses.original: ਘਾਲ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: ghaal siaanap ukat na meree poorai guroo kamaiee ||12||
verses.translation: Clever tricks have not worked for me; I shall act according to the Instructions of the Perfect Guru. ||12||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam such hai soiee aape kare karaiee ||13||
verses.translation: He is chanting, intense meditation, austere self-discipline and purification. He Himself acts, and causes us to act. ||13||

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇ ਤਰਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr mahaa bikhiaa meh gur saachai lai taraiee ||14||
verses.translation: In the midst of children and spouse, and utter corruption, the True Guru has carried me across. ||14||

verses.original: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: apane jeea tai aap samhaale aap le'ee laR laiee ||15||
verses.translation: You Yourself take care of Your beings; You Yourself attach them to the hem of Your robe. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: saach dharam kaa beRaa baa(n)dhiaa bhavajal paar pavaiee ||16||
verses.translation: I have built the boat of true Dharmic faith, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||16||

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee naanak bal bal jaiee ||17||
verses.translation: The Lord Master is unlimited and endless; Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||17||

verses.original: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਕਲਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਦੀਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: akaal moorat ajoonee sa(n)bhau kal a(n)dhakaar dheepaiee ||18||
verses.translation: Being of Immortal Manifestation, He is not born; He is self-existent; He is the Light in the darkness of Kali Yuga. ||18||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਖਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee jeean kaa dhaataa dhekhat tirapat aghaiee ||19||
verses.translation: He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Giver of souls; gazing upon Him, I am satisfied and fulfilled. ||19||

verses.original: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਭ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: eka(n)kaar nira(n)jan nirabhau sabh jal thal rahiaa samaiee ||20||
verses.translation: He is the One Universal Creator Lord, immaculate and fearless; He is permeating and pervading all the water and the land. ||20||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਮਾਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhagat dhaan bhagataa kau dheenaa har naanak jaachai maiee ||21||1||6||
verses.translation: He blesses His devotees with the Gift of devotional worship; Nanak longs for the Lord, O my mother. ||21||1||6||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla,

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਿਖਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: sikhahu sabadh piaariho janam maran kee Tek ||
verses.translation: Study the Word of the Shabad, O beloveds. It is your anchoring support in life and in death.

verses.original: ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਏਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mukh uoojal sadhaa sukhee naanak simarat ek ||1||
verses.translation: Your face shall be radiant, and you will be at peace forever, O Nanak, meditating in remembrance on the One Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tan raataa raam piaare har prem bhagat ban aaiee sa(n)tahu ||1||
verses.translation: My mind and body are imbued with my Beloved Lord; I have been blessed with loving devotion to the Lord, O Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਖੇਪ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur khep nibaahee sa(n)tahu ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has approved my cargo, O Saints.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਉਲਾਹੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har naam laahaa dhaas kau dheeaa sagalee tirasan ulaahee sa(n)tahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has blessed His slave with the profit of the Lord's Name; all my thirst is quenched, O Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat laal ik paiaa har keemat kahan na jaiee sa(n)tahu ||2||
verses.translation: Searching and searching, I have found the One Lord, the jewel; I cannot express His value, O Saints. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੋ ਧਿਆਨਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: charan kamal siau laago dhiaanaa saachai dharas samaiee sa(n)tahu ||3||
verses.translation: I focus my meditation on His Lotus Feet; I am absorbed in the True Vision of His Darshan, O Saints. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat gaavat bhe nihaalaa har simarat tirapat aghaiee sa(n)tahu ||4||
verses.translation: Singing, singing His Glorious Praises, I am enraptured; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am satisfied and fulfilled, O Saints. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aatam raam raviaa sabh a(n)tar kat aavai kat jaiee sa(n)tahu ||5||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is permeating within all; what comes, and what goes, O Saints? ||5||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadhee hai bhee hosee sabh jeeaa kaa sukhadhaiee sa(n)tahu ||6||
verses.translation: At the very beginning of time, and throughout the ages, He is, and He shall always be; He is the Giver of peace to all beings, O Saints. ||6||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: aap bea(n)t a(n)t nahee paieeaai poor rahiaa sabh Thaiee sa(n)tahu ||7||
verses.translation: He Himself is endless; His end cannot be found. He is totally pervading and permeating everywhere, O Saints. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੁਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਪੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ॥੮॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: meet saajan maal joban sut har naanak baap meree maiee sa(n)tahu ||8||2||7||
verses.translation: Nanak: the Lord is my friend, companion, wealth, youth, son, father and mother, O Saints. ||8||2||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: man bach karam raam naam chitaaree ||
verses.translation: In thought, word and deed, I contemplate the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰਿ ਮਹਾ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghooman gher mahaa at bikhaRee gurmukh naanak paar utaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The horrible world-ocean is very treacherous; O Nanak, the Gurmukh is carried across. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਮਲਨ ਭਏ ਦੁਸਟਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sookhaa baahar sookhaa har jap malan bhe dhusaTaaree ||1||
verses.translation: Inwardly, peace, and outwardly, peace; meditating on the Lord, evil tendencies are crushed. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis te laage tineh nivaare prabh jeeau apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||2||
verses.translation: He has rid me of what was clinging to me; my Dear Lord God has blessed me with His Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਧਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਚਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਹਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: audhare sa(n)t pare har saranee pach binase mahaa aha(n)kaaree ||3||
verses.translation: The Saints are saved, in His Sanctuary; the very egotistical people rot away and die. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਕੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)gat ih fal paiaa ik keval naam adhaaree ||4||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained this fruit, the Support of the One Name alone. ||4||

verses.original: ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹੀਣਾ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: n koiee soor na koiee heenaa sabh pragaTee jot tum(h)aaree ||5||
verses.translation: No one is strong, and no one is weak; all are manifestations of Your Light, Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਵਿਆ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tum(h) samarath akath agochar raviaa ek muraaree ||6||
verses.translation: You are the all-powerful, indescribable, unfathomable, all-pervading Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: keemat kaun kare teree karate prabh a(n)t na paaraavaaree ||7||
verses.translation: Who can estimate Your value, O Creator Lord? God has no end or limitation. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਰੇਣਾਰੀ ॥੮॥੩॥੮॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naam dhaan naanak vaddiaaiee teriaa sa(n)t janaa renaaree ||8||3||8||22||
verses.translation: Please bless Nanak with the glorious greatness of the gift of the Naam, and the dust of the feet of Your Saints. ||8||3||8||22||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਨੰਦੁ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa teejaa ana(n)dhu
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehla, Anand ~ The Song Of Bliss:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ana(n)dh bhiaa meree maae satiguroo mai paiaa ||
verses.translation: I am in ecstasy, O my mother, for I have found my True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਜੀਆ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur ta paiaa sahaj setee man vajeeaa vaadhaieeaa ||
verses.translation: I have found the True Guru, with intuitive ease, and my mind vibrates with the music of bliss.

verses.original: ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਪਰੀਆ ਸਬਦ ਗਾਵਣ ਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: raag ratan paravaar pareeaa sabadh gaavan aaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The jewelled melodies and their related celestial harmonies have come to sing the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੋ ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadho ta gaavahu haree keraa man jinee vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord dwells within the minds of those who sing the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak ana(n)dh hoaa satiguroo mai paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am in ecstasy, for I have found my True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: e man meriaa too sadhaa rahu har naale ||
verses.translation: O my mind, remain always with the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਹੁ ਤੂ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naal rahu too ma(n)n mere dhookh sabh visaaranaa ||
verses.translation: Remain always with the Lord, O my mind, and all sufferings will be forgotten.

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar oh kare teraa kaaraj sabh savaaranaa ||
verses.translation: He will accept You as His own, and all your affairs will be perfectly arranged.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa galaa samarath suaamee so kiau manahu visaare ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is all-powerful to do all things, so why forget Him from your mind?

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak ma(n)n mere sadhaa rahu har naale ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O my mind, remain always with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saache saahibaa kiaa naahee ghar terai ||
verses.translation: O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your celestial home?

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ta terai sabh kichh hai jis dheh su paave ||
verses.translation: Everything is in Your home; they receive, unto whom You give.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sifat salaeh teree naam man vasaave ||
verses.translation: Constantly singing Your Praises and Glories, Your Name is enshrined in the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naam jin kai man vasiaa vaaje sabadh ghanere ||
verses.translation: The divine melody of the Shabad vibrates for those, within whose minds the Naam abides.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sache saahib kiaa naahee ghar terai ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, what is there which is not in Your home? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa naam meraa aadhaaro ||
verses.translation: The True Name is my only support.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਭੁਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: saach naam adhaar meraa jin bhukhaa sabh gavaieeaa ||
verses.translation: The True Name is my only support; it satisfies all hunger.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਛਾ ਸਭਿ ਪੁਜਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar saa(n)t sukh man aai vasiaa jin ichhaa sabh pujaieeaa ||
verses.translation: It has brought peace and tranquility to my mind; it has fulfilled all my desires.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਦੀਆ ਏਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa kurabaan keetaa guroo viTahu jis dheeaa eh vaddiaaieeaa ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who possesses such glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu sabadh dharahu piaaro ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints; enshrine love for the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saachaa naam meraa aadhaaro ||4||
verses.translation: The True Name is my only support. ||4||

verses.original: ਵਾਜੇ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: vaaje pa(n)ch sabadh tit ghar sabhaagai ||
verses.translation: The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, vibrate in that blessed house.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar sabhaagai sabadh vaaje kalaa jit ghar dhaareeaa ||
verses.translation: In that blessed house, the Shabad vibrates; He infuses His almighty power into it.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch dhoot tudh vas keete kaal ka(n)Tak maariaa ||
verses.translation: Through You, we subdue the five demons of desire, and slay Death, the torturer.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhur karam paiaa tudh jin kau s naam har kai laage ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are attached to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak teh sukh hoaa tit ghar anahadh vaaje ||5||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, they are at peace, and the unstruck sound current vibrates within their homes. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: saachee livai bin dheh nimaanee ||
verses.translation: Without the true love of devotion, the body is without honor.

verses.original: ਦੇਹ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheh nimaanee livai baajhahu kiaa kare vechaareeaa ||
verses.translation: The body is dishonored without devotional love; what can the poor wretches do?

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਮਰਥ ਕੋਇ ਨਾਹੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh baajh samarath koi naahee kirapaa kar banavaareeaa ||
verses.translation: No one except You is all-powerful; please bestow Your Mercy, O Lord of all nature.

verses.original: ਏਸ ਨਉ ਹੋਰੁ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: es nau hor thaau naahee sabadh laag savaareeaa ||
verses.translation: There is no place of rest, other than the Name; attached to the Shabad, we are embellished with beauty.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਿਵੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵੇਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak livai baajhahu kiaa kare vechaareeaa ||6||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, without devotional love, what can the poor wretches do? ||6||

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh aana(n)dh sabh ko kahai aana(n)dh guroo te jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Bliss, bliss - everyone talks of bliss; bliss is known only through the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਾਣਿਆ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaaniaa aana(n)dh sadhaa gur te kirapaa kare piaariaa ||
verses.translation: Eternal bliss is known only through the Guru, when the Beloved Lord grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa kilavikh kaTe giaan a(n)jan saariaa ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He cuts away our sins; He blesses us with the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu jin kaa moh tuTaa tin kaa sabadh sachai savaariaa ||
verses.translation: Those who eradicate attachment from within themselves, are adorned with the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak eh ana(n)dh hai aana(n)dh gur te jaaniaa ||7||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this alone is bliss - bliss which is known through the Guru. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa jis too dheh soiee jan paavai ||
verses.translation: O Baba, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it.

verses.original: ਪਾਵੈ ਤ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੇਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paavai ta so jan dheh jis no hor kiaa kareh vechaariaa ||
verses.translation: He alone receives it, unto whom You give it; what can the other poor wretched beings do?

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਇਕਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik bharam bhoole fireh dheh dhis ik naam laag savaariaa ||
verses.translation: Some are deluded by doubt, wandering in the ten directions; some are adorned with attachment to the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee man bhiaa niramal jinaa bhaanaa bhaave ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mind becomes immaculate and pure, for those who follow God's Will.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak jis dheh piaare soiee jan paave ||8||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, unto whom You give it, O Beloved Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sa(n)t piaariho akath kee kareh kahaanee ||
verses.translation: Come, Beloved Saints, let us speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਅਕਥ ਕੇਰੀ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kareh kahaanee akath keree kit dhuaarai paieeaai ||
verses.translation: How can we speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord? Through which door will we find Him?

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਉਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: tan man dhan sabh saup gur kau hukam ma(n)niaai paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Surrender body, mind, wealth, and everything to the Guru; obey the Order of His Will, and you will find Him.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: hukam ma(n)nih guroo keraa gaavahu sachee baanee ||
verses.translation: Obey the Hukam of the Guru's Command, and sing the True Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਥਿਹੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu kathih akath kahaanee ||9||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints, and speak the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||9||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: e man cha(n)chalaa chaturaiee kinai na paiaa ||
verses.translation: O fickle mind, through cleverness, no one has found the Lord.

verses.original: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: chaturaiee na paiaa kinai too sun ma(n)n meriaa ||
verses.translation: Through cleverness, no one has found Him; listen, O my mind.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh maiaa mohanee jin et bharam bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: This Maya is so fascinating; because of it, people wander in doubt.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਤ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਤਿਨੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ta mohanee tinai keetee jin Thagaulee paieeaa ||
verses.translation: This fascinating Maya was created by the One who has administered this potion.

verses.original: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kurabaan keetaa tisai viTahu jin moh meeThaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the One who has made emotional attachment sweet.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak man cha(n)chal chaturaiee kinai na paiaa ||10||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O fickle mind, no one has found Him through cleverness. ||10||

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: e man piaariaa too sadhaa sach samaale ||
verses.translation: O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤੂ ਜਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: eh kuTa(n)b too j dhekhadhaa chalai naahee terai naale ||
verses.translation: This family which you see shall not go along with you.

verses.original: ਸਾਥਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: saath terai chalai naahee tis naal kiau chit laieeaai ||
verses.translation: They shall not go along with you, so why do you focus your attention on them?

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਕੰਮੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa ka(n)m moole na keechai jit a(n)t pachhotaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Don't do anything that you will regret in the end.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਹੋਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo kaa upadhes sun too hovai terai naale ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Teachings of the True Guru - these shall go along with you.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak man piaare too sadhaa sach samaale ||11||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O beloved mind, contemplate the True Lord forever. ||11||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agam agocharaa teraa a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: O inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, Your limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੋ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)to na paiaa kinai teraa aapanaa aap too jaanahe ||
verses.translation: No one has found Your limits; only You Yourself know.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਏ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh khel teraa kiaa ko aakh vakhaane ||
verses.translation: All living beings and creatures are Your play; how can anyone describe You?

verses.original: ਆਖਹਿ ਤ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aakheh ta vekheh sabh toohai jin jagat upaiaa ||
verses.translation: You speak, and You gaze upon all; You created the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak too sadhaa aga(n)m hai teraa a(n)t na paiaa ||12||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, You are forever inaccessible; Your limits cannot be found. ||12||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar mun jan a(n)mrit khojadhe su a(n)mrit gur te paiaa ||
verses.translation: The angelic beings and the silent sages search for the Ambrosial Nectar; this Amrit is obtained from the Guru.

verses.original: ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paiaa a(n)mrit gur kirapaa keenee sachaa man vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: This Amrit is obtained, when the Guru grants His Grace; He enshrines the True Lord within the mind.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਪਰਸਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh tudh upaae ik vekh parasan aaiaa ||
verses.translation: All living beings and creatures were created by You; only some come to see the Guru, and seek His blessing.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh aha(n)kaar chookaa satiguroo bhalaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Their greed, avarice and egotism are dispelled, and the True Guru seems sweet.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak jis no aap tuThaa tin a(n)mrit gur te paiaa ||13||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, those with whom the Lord is pleased, obtain the Amrit, through the Guru. ||13||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kee chaal niraalee ||
verses.translation: The lifestyle of the devotees is unique and distinct.

verses.original: ਚਾਲਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਭਗਤਾਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਿਖਮ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: chaalaa niraalee bhagataeh keree bikham maarag chalanaa ||
verses.translation: The devotees' lifestyle is unique and distinct; they follow the most difficult path.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਜਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਲਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh aha(n)kaar taj tirasanaa bahut naahee bolanaa ||
verses.translation: They renounce greed, avarice, egotism and desire; they do not talk too much.

verses.original: ਖੰਨਿਅਹੁ ਤਿਖੀ ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਏਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)niahu tikhee vaalahu nikee et maarag jaanaa ||
verses.translation: The path they take is sharper than a two-edged sword, and finer than a hair.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jinee aap tajiaa har vaasanaa samaanee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they shed their selfishness and conceit; their hopes are merged in the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਚਾਲ ਭਗਤਾ ਜੁਗਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak chaal bhagataa jugahu jug niraalee ||14||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the lifestyle of the devotees, in each and every age, is unique and distinct. ||14||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵ ਚਲਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau too chalaieh tiv chaleh suaamee hor kiaa jaanaa gun tere ||
verses.translation: As You make me walk, so do I walk, O my Lord and Master; what else do I know of Your Glorious Virtues?

verses.original: ਜਿਵ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਇਹਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਹ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jiv too chalaieh tivai chaleh jinaa maarag paavahe ||
verses.translation: As You cause them to walk, they walk - You have placed them on the Path.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa jin naam laieh s har har sadhaa dhiaavahe ||
verses.translation: In Your Mercy, You attach them to the Naam; they meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis no kathaa sunaieh aapanee s gurdhuaarai sukh paavahe ||
verses.translation: Those whom You cause to listen to Your sermon, find peace in the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sache saahib jiau bhaavai tivai chalaavahe ||15||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O my True Lord and Master, you make us walk according to Your Will. ||15||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh sohilaa sabadh suhaavaa ||
verses.translation: This song of praise is the Shabad, the most beautiful Word of God.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੋ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadho suhaavaa sadhaa sohilaa satiguroo sunaiaa ||
verses.translation: This beauteous Shabad is the everlasting song of praise, spoken by the True Guru.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh tin kai ma(n)n vasiaa jin dhurahu likhiaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: This is enshrined in the minds of those who are so pre-destined by the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik fireh ghanere kareh galaa galee kinai na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Some wander around, babbling on and on, but none obtain Him by babbling.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sabadh sohilaa satiguroo sunaiaa ||16||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Shabad, this song of praise, has been spoken by the True Guru. ||16||

verses.original: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਸੇ ਜਨਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pavit hoe se janaa jinee har dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord become pure.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaaiaa pavit hoe gurmukh jinee dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, they become pure; as Gurmukh, they meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਪਵਿਤੁ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈਆ ॥
verses.translit: pavit maataa pitaa kuTa(n)b sahit siau pavit sa(n)gat sabaieeaa ||
verses.translation: They are pure, along with their mothers, fathers, family and friends; all their companions are pure as well.

verses.original: ਕਹਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahadhe pavit sunadhe pavit se pavit jinee ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Pure are those who speak, and pure are those who listen; those who enshrine it within their minds are pure.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak se pavit jinee gurmukh har har dhiaaiaa ||17||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, pure and holy are those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||17||

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karamee sahaj na uoopajai vin sahajai sahasaa na jai ||
verses.translation: By religious rituals, intuitive poise is not found; without intuitive poise, skepticism does not depart.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਿਤੈ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: neh jai sahasaa kitai sa(n)jam rahe karam kamaae ||
verses.translation: Skepticism does not depart by contrived actions; everybody is tired of performing these rituals.

verses.original: ਸਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ਮਲੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਧੋਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sahasai jeeau maleen hai kit sa(n)jam dhotaa jaae ||
verses.translation: The soul is polluted by skepticism; how can it be cleansed?

verses.original: ਮੰਨੁ ਧੋਵਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)n dhovahu sabadh laagahu har siau rahahu chit lai ||
verses.translation: Wash your mind by attaching it to the Shabad, and keep your consciousness focused on the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਇਵ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak gur parasaadhee sahaj upajai ih sahasaa iv jai ||18||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, intuitive poise is produced, and this skepticism is dispelled. ||18||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਮੈਲੇ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
verses.translit: jeeahu maile baaharahu niramal ||
verses.translation: Inwardly polluted, and outwardly pure.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਤ ਮੈਲੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: baaharahu niramal jeeahu ta maile tinee janam jooaai haariaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are outwardly pure and yet polluted within, lose their lives in the gamble.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਮਰਣੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh tisanaa vaddaa rog lagaa maran manahu visaariaa ||
verses.translation: They contract this terrible disease of desire, and in their minds, they forget about dying.

verses.original: ਵੇਦਾ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਸੋ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: vedhaa meh naam utam so suneh naahee fireh jiau betaaliaa ||
verses.translation: In the Vedas, the ultimate objective is the Naam, the Name of the Lord; but they do not hear this, and they wander around like demons.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak jin sach tajiaa kooRe laage tinee janam jooaai haariaa ||19||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, those who forsake Truth and cling to falsehood, lose their lives in the gamble. ||19||

verses.original: ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ॥
verses.translit: jeeahu niramal baaharahu niramal ||
verses.translation: Inwardly pure, and outwardly pure.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: baaharahu ta niramal jeeahu niramal satigur te karanee kamaanee ||
verses.translation: Those who are outwardly pure and also pure within, through the Guru, perform good deeds.

verses.original: ਕੂੜ ਕੀ ਸੋਇ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kee soi pahuchai naahee manasaa sach samaanee ||
verses.translation: Not even an iota of falsehood touches them; their hopes are absorbed in the Truth.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਖਟਿਆ ਭਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: janam ratan jinee khaTiaa bhale se vanajaare ||
verses.translation: Those who earn the jewel of this human life, are the most excellent of merchants.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak jin ma(n)n niramal sadhaa raheh gur naale ||20||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, those whose minds are pure, abide with the Guru forever. ||20||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je ko sikh guroo setee sanamukh hovai ||
verses.translation: If a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh

verses.original: ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਸਿਖੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: hovai ta sanamukh sikh koiee jeeahu rahai gur naale ||
verses.translation: if a Sikh turns to the Guru with sincere faith, as sunmukh, his soul abides with the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਏ ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan hiradhai dhiaae a(n)tar aatamai samaale ||
verses.translation: Within his heart, he meditates on the lotus feet of the Guru; deep within his soul, he contemplates Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਏ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhadd sadhaa rahai paranai gur bin avar na jaanai koe ||
verses.translation: Renouncing selfishness and conceit, he remains always on the side of the Guru; he does not know anyone except the Guru.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਏ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sunahu sa(n)tahu so sikh sanamukh hoe ||21||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O Saints: such a Sikh turns toward the Guru with sincere faith, and becomes sunmukh. ||21||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je ko gur te vemukh hovai bin satigur mukat na paavai ||
verses.translation: One who turns away from the Guru, and becomes baymukh - without the True Guru, he shall not find liberation.

verses.original: ਪਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਕੋਈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੀਆ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: paavai mukat na hor thai koiee puchhahu bibekeeaa jaae ||
verses.translation: He shall not find liberation anywhere else either; go and ask the wise ones about this.

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anek joonee bharam aavai vin satigur mukat na paae ||
verses.translation: He shall wander through countless incarnations; without the True Guru, he shall not find liberation.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: fir mukat paae laag charanee satiguroo sabadh sunaae ||
verses.translation: But liberation is attained, when one is attached to the feet of the True Guru, chanting the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak veechaar dhekhahu vin satigur mukat na paae ||22||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, contemplate this and see, that without the True Guru, there is no liberation. ||22||

verses.original: ਆਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavahu sikh satiguroo ke piaariho gaavahu sachee baanee ||
verses.translation: Come, O beloved Sikhs of the True Guru, and sing the True Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: baanee ta gaavahu guroo keree baaneeaa sir baanee ||
verses.translation: Sing the Guru's Bani, the supreme Word of Words.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau nadhar karam hovai hiradhai tinaa samaanee ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace - their hearts are imbued with this Bani.

verses.original: ਪੀਵਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਪਿਹੁ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: peevahu a(n)mrit sadhaa rahahu har ra(n)g japih saarigapaanee ||
verses.translation: Drink in this Ambrosial Nectar, and remain in the Lord's Love forever; meditate on the Lord, the Sustainer of the world.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਏਹ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sadhaa gaavahu eh sachee baanee ||23||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, sing this True Bani forever. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਹੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo binaa hor kachee hai baanee ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, other songs are false.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਤ ਕਚੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: baanee ta kachee satiguroo baajhahu hor kachee baanee ||
verses.translation: The songs are false without the True Guru; all other songs are false.

verses.original: ਕਹਦੇ ਕਚੇ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਕਚੇ ਕਚਂੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahadhe kache sunadhe kache kacha(n)ee aakh vakhaanee ||
verses.translation: The speakers are false, and the listeners are false; those who speak and recite are false.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har nit kareh rasanaa kahiaa kachhoo na jaanee ||
verses.translation: They may continually chant, 'Har, Har' with their tongues, but they do not know what they are saying.

verses.original: ਚਿਤੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਪਏ ਰਵਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: chit jin kaa hir liaa maiaa bolan pe ravaanee ||
verses.translation: Their consciousness is lured by Maya; they are just reciting mechanically.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak satiguroo baajhahu hor kachee baanee ||24||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, without the True Guru, other songs are false. ||24||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh rata(n)n hai heere jit jaRaau ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੰਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਏਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh ratan jit ma(n)n laagaa eh hoaa samaau ||
verses.translation: The mind which is attached to this jewel, merges into the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh setee man miliaa sachai laiaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: One whose mind is attuned to the Shabad, enshrines love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape heeraa ratan aape jis no dhei bujhai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the diamond, and He Himself is the jewel; one who is blessed, understands its value.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੜਾਉ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sabadh ratan hai heeraa jit jaRaau ||25||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Shabad is a jewel, studded with diamonds. ||25||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: siv sakat aap upai kai karataa aape hukam varataae ||
verses.translation: He Himself created Shiva and Shakti, mind and matter; the Creator subjects them to His Command.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: hukam varataae aap vekhai gurmukh kisai bujhaae ||
verses.translation: Enforcing His Order, He Himself sees all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, come to know Him.

verses.original: ਤੋੜੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: toRe ba(n)dhan hovai mukat sabadh ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: They break their bonds, and attain liberation; they enshrine the Shabad within their minds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jis no aap kare su hovai ekas siau liv laae ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord Himself makes Gurmukh, lovingly focus their consciousness on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak aap karataa aape hukam bujhaae ||26||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, He Himself is the Creator; He Himself reveals the Hukam of His Command. ||26||

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਬੀਚਾਰਦੇ ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasatr pu(n)n paap beechaaradhe tatai saar na jaanee ||
verses.translation: The Simritees and the Shaastras discriminate between good and evil, but they do not know the true essence of reality.

verses.original: ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਤਤੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: tatai saar na jaanee guroo baajhahu tatai saar na jaanee ||
verses.translation: They do not know the true essence of reality without the Guru; they do not know the true essence of reality.

verses.original: ਤਿਹੀ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: tihee gunee sa(n)saar bhram sutaa sutiaa rain vihaanee ||
verses.translation: The world is asleep in the three modes and doubt; it passes the night of its life sleeping.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te se jan jaage jinaa har man vasiaa boleh a(n)mirat baanee ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings remain awake and aware, within whose minds, by Guru's Grace, the Lord abides; they chant the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੋ ਤਤੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak so tat paae jis no anadhin har liv laagai jaagat rain vihaanee ||27||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, they alone obtain the essence of reality, who night and day remain lovingly absorbed in the Lord; they pass the night of their life awake and aware. ||27||

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਕੇ ਉਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: maataa ke udhar meh pratipaal kare so kiau manahu visaareeaai ||
verses.translation: He nourished us in the mother's womb; why forget Him from the mind?

verses.original: ਮਨਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: manahu kiau visaareeaai evadd dhaataa j agan meh aahaar pahuchaave ||
verses.translation: Why forget from the mind such a Great Giver, who gave us sustenance in the fire of the womb?

verses.original: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: os no kih poh na sakee jis nau aapanee liv laave ||
verses.translation: Nothing can harm one, whom the Lord inspires to embrace His Love.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: aapanee liv aape laae gurmukh sadhaa samaaleeaai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the love, and He Himself is the embrace; the Gurmukh contemplates Him forever.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨੮॥
