verses.translit: kahai naanak evadd dhaataa so kiau manahu visaareeaai ||28||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, why forget such a Great Giver from the mind? ||28||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee agan udhar meh taisee baahar maiaa ||
verses.translation: As is the fire within the womb, so is Maya outside.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਭ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹੀ ਕਰਤੈ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa agan sabh iko jehee karatai khel rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: The fire of Maya is one and the same; the Creator has staged this play.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਭਲਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa tis bhaanaa taa ja(n)miaa paravaar bhalaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: According to His Will, the child is born, and the family is very pleased.

verses.original: ਲਿਵ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਲਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਮਰੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: liv chhuRakee lagee tirasanaa maiaa amar varataiaa ||
verses.translation: Love for the Lord wears off, and the child becomes attached to desires; the script of Maya runs its course.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh maiaa jit har visarai moh upajai bhaau dhoojaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: This is Maya, by which the Lord is forgotten; emotional attachment and love of duality well up.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak gur parasaadhee jinaa liv laagee tinee viche maiaa paiaa ||29||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, those who enshrine love for the Lord find Him, in the midst of Maya. ||29||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har aap amulak hai mul na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is priceless; His worth cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਰਹੇ ਲੋਕ ਵਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mul na paiaa jai kisai viTahu rahe lok vilalai ||
verses.translation: His worth cannot be estimated, even though people have grown weary of trying.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa satigur je milai tis no sir saupeeaai vichahu aap jai ||
verses.translation: If you meet such a True Guru, offer your head to Him; your selfishness and conceit will be eradicated from within.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa jeeau tis mil rahai har vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: Your soul belongs to Him; remain united with Him, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਮੁਲਕੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: har aap amulak hai bhaag tinaa ke naanakaa jin har palai pai ||30||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is priceless; very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who attain to the Lord. ||30||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har raas meree man vanajaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my capital; my mind is the merchant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har raas meree man vanajaaraa satigur te raas jaanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant; through the True Guru, I know my capital.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਹੁ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਟਿਹੁ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har nit japih jeeahu laahaa khaTih dhihaaRee ||
verses.translation: Meditate continually on the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul, and you shall collect your profits daily.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: eh dhan tinaa miliaa jin har aape bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: This wealth is obtained by those who are pleasing to the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak har raas meree man hoaa vanajaaraa ||31||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord is my capital, and my mind is the merchant. ||31||

verses.original: ਏ ਰਸਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਨ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: e rasanaa too an ras raach rahee teree piaas na jai ||
verses.translation: O my tongue, you are engrossed in other tastes, but your thirsty desire is not quenched.

verses.original: ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: piaas na jai horat kitai jichar har ras palai na pai ||
verses.translation: Your thirst shall not be quenched by any means, until you attain the subtle essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇ ਪਲੈ ਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ras pai palai peeaai har ras bahuR na tirasanaa laagai aai ||
verses.translation: If you do obtain the subtle essence of the Lord, and drink in this essence of the Lord, you shall not be troubled by desire again.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: eh har ras karamee paieeaai satigur milai jis aai ||
verses.translation: This subtle essence of the Lord is obtained by good karma, when one comes to meet with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹੋਰਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਭਿ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak hor an ras sabh veesare jaa har vasai man aai ||32||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, all other tastes and essences are forgotten, when the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||32||

verses.original: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: e sareeraa meriaa har tum meh jot rakhee taa too jag meh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: O my body, the Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਖੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jot rakhee tudh vich taa too jag meh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord infused His Light into you, and then you came into the world.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਉਪਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har aape maataa aape pitaa jin jeeau upai jagat dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is your mother, and He Himself is your father; He created the created beings, and revealed the world to them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਚਲਤੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee bujhiaa taa chalat hoaa chalat nadharee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, some understand, and then it's a show; it seems like just a show.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sirasaT kaa mool rachiaa jot raakhee taa too jag meh aaiaa ||33||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, He laid the foundation of the Universe, and infused His Light, and then you came into the world. ||33||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗਮੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: man chaau bhiaa prabh aagam suniaa ||
verses.translation: My mind has become joyful, hearing of God's coming.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਬਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)gal gaau sakhee girahu ma(n)dhar baniaa ||
verses.translation: Sing the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions; my household has become the Lord's Mansion.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੋਗੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਏ ॥
verses.translit: har gaau ma(n)gal nit sakhe'ee sog dhookh na viaape ||
verses.translation: Sing continually the songs of joy to welcome the Lord, O my companions, and sorrow and suffering will not afflict you.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਪਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur charan laage dhin sabhaage aapanaa pir jaape ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that day, when I am attached to the Guru's feet and meditate on my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: anahat baanee gur sabadh jaanee har naam har ras bhogo ||
verses.translation: I have come to know the unstruck sound current and the Word of the Guru's Shabad; I enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord, the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak prabh aap miliaa karan kaaran jogo ||34||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, God Himself has met me; He is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||34||

verses.original: ਏ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: e sareeraa meriaa is jag meh aai kai kiaa tudh karam kamaiaa ||
verses.translation: O my body, why have you come into this world? What actions have you committed?

verses.original: ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: k karam kamaiaa tudh sareeraa jaa too jag meh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: And what actions have you committed, O my body, since you came into this world?

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin har teraa rachan rachiaa so har man na vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord who formed your form - you have not enshrined that Lord in your mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har ma(n)n vasiaa poorab likhiaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Lord abides within the mind, and one's pre-ordained destiny is fulfilled.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak eh sareer paravaan hoaa jin satigur siau chit laiaa ||35||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this body is adorned and honored, when one's consciousness is focused on the True Guru. ||35||

verses.original: ਏ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਮੇਰਿਹੋ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: e netrahu meriho har tum meh jot dharee har bin avar na dhekhahu koiee ||
verses.translation: O my eyes, the Lord has infused His Light into you; do not look upon any other than the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har bin avar na dhekhahu koiee nadharee har nihaaliaa ||
verses.translation: Do not look upon any other than the Lord; the Lord alone is worthy of beholding.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਵਿਸੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eh vis sa(n)saar tum dhekhadhe eh har kaa roop hai har roop nadharee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: This whole world which you see is the image of the Lord; only the image of the Lord is seen.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾ ਵੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee bujhiaa jaa vekhaa har ik hai har bin avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I understand, and I see only the One Lord; there is no one except the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਹਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਅੰਧ ਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak eh netr a(n)dh se satigur miliaai dhib dhirasaT hoiee ||36||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, these eyes were blind; but meeting the True Guru, they became all-seeing. ||36||

verses.original: ਏ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਹੁ ਮੇਰਿਹੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: e sravanahu meriho saachai sunanai no paThaae ||
verses.translation: O my ears, you were created only to hear the Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: saachai sunanai no paThaae sareer laae sunahu sat baanee ||
verses.translation: To hear the Truth, you were created and attached to the body; listen to the True Bani.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jit sunee man tan hariaa hoaa rasanaa ras samaanee ||
verses.translation: Hearing it, the mind and body are rejuvenated, and the tongue is absorbed in Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਅਲਖ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sach alakh viddaanee taa kee gat kahee na jaae ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is unseen and wondrous; His state cannot be described.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੁਨਣੈ ਨੋ ਪਠਾਏ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak a(n)mirat naam sunahu pavitr hovahu saachai sunanai no paThaae ||37||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen to the Ambrosial Naam and become holy; you were created only to hear the Truth. ||37||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau gufaa a(n)dhar rakh kai vaajaa pavan vajaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body.

verses.original: ਵਜਾਇਆ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣ ਨਉ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕੀਏ ਦਸਵਾ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vajaiaa vaajaa paun nau dhuaare paragaT ke'ee dhasavaa gupat rakhaiaa ||
verses.translation: He blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body, and revealed the nine doors; but He kept the Tenth Door hidden.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰੈ ਲਾਇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਇਕਨਾ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurdhuaarai lai bhaavanee ikanaa dhasavaa dhuaar dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, some are blessed with loving faith, and the Tenth Door is revealed to them.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਉ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teh anek roop naau nav nidh tis dhaa a(n)t na jaiee paiaa ||
verses.translation: There are many images of the Lord, and the nine treasures of the Naam; His limits cannot be found.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਜੀਉ ਗੁਫਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਕੈ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak har piaarai jeeau gufaa a(n)dhar rakh kai vaajaa pavan vajaiaa ||38||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord placed the soul to the cave of the body, and blew the breath of life into the musical instrument of the body. ||38||

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: eh saachaa sohilaa saachai ghar gaavahu ||
verses.translation: Sing this true song of praise in the true home of your soul.

verses.original: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਤ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: gaavahu ta sohilaa ghar saachai jithai sadhaa sach dhiaavahe ||
verses.translation: Sing the song of praise in your true home; meditate there on the True Lord forever.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: sacho dhiaaveh jaa tudh bhaaveh gurmukh jinaa bujhaavahe ||
verses.translation: They alone meditate on You, O True Lord, who are pleasing to Your Will; as Gurmukh, they understand.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: eih sach sabhanaa kaa khasam hai jis bakhase so jan paavahe ||
verses.translation: This Truth is the Lord and Master of all; whoever is blessed, obtains it.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sach sohilaa sachai ghar gaavahe ||39||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, sing the true song of praise in the true home of your soul. ||39||

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: anadh sunahu vaddabhaageeho sagal manorath poore ||
verses.translation: Listen to the song of bliss, O most fortunate ones; all your longings shall be fulfilled.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਤਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham prabh paiaa utare sagal visoore ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Supreme Lord God, and all sorrows have been forgotten.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਉਤਰੇ ਸੁਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh rog sa(n)taap utare sunee sachee baanee ||
verses.translation: Pain, illness and suffering have departed, listening to the True Bani.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਸਰਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t saajan bhe sarase poore gur te jaanee ||
verses.translation: The Saints and their friends are in ecstasy, knowing the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਸੁਣਤੇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਹਤੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sunate puneet kahate pavit satigur rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: Pure are the listeners, and pure are the speakers; the True Guru is all-pervading and permeating.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੪੦॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak gur charan laage vaaje anahadh toore ||40||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, touching the Guru's Feet, the unstruck sound current of the celestial bugles vibrates and resounds. ||40||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਸਦੁ
verses.translit: raamakalee sadhu
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Sadd ~ The Call Of Death:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jag dhaataa soi bhagat vachhal tih loi jeeau ||
verses.translation: He is the Great Giver of the Universe, the Lover of His devotees, throughout the three worlds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh samaave avar na jaanai koi jeeau ||
verses.translation: One who is merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad does not know any other.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: avaro na jaaneh sabadh gur kai ek naam dhiaavahe ||
verses.translation: Dwelling upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not know any other; he meditates on the One Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: parasaadh naanak guroo a(n)gadh param padhavee paavahe ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of Guru Nanak and Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das obtained the supreme status.

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਹਕਾਰਾ ਚਲਣਵਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa hakaaraa chalanavaaraa har raam naam samaiaa ||
verses.translation: And when the call came for Him to depart, He merged in the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਗਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jag amar aTal atol Thaakur bhagat te har paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Through devotional worship in this world, the imperishable, immovable, immeasurable Lord is found. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaanaa gur bhaiaa gur jaavai har prabh paas jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and so the Guru easily reached the Lord God's Presence.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kare har peh benatee meree paij rakhahu aradhaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru prays to the Lord, ""Please, save my honor. This is my prayer"".

verses.original: ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: paij raakhahu har janeh keree har dheh naam nira(n)jano ||
verses.translation: Please save the honor of Your humble servant, O Lord; please bless him with Your Immaculate Name.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਲੀ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t chaladhiaa hoi belee jamadhoot kaal nikha(n)jano ||
verses.translation: At this time of final departure, it is our only help and support; it destroys death, and the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo kee benatee paiee har prabh sunee aradhaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord God heard the prayer of the True Guru, and granted His request.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har dhaar kirapaa satigur milaiaa dhan dhan kahai saabaas jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord showered His Mercy, and blended the True Guru with Himself; He said, ""Blessed! Blessed! Wonderful!""||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਉ ਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mere sikh sunahu put bhaieeho merai har bhaanaa aau mai paas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Listen O my Sikhs, my children and Siblings of Destiny; it is my Lord's Will that I must now go to Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaanaa gur bhaiaa meraa har prabh kare saabaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and my Lord God applauded Him.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat satigur purakh soiee jis har prabh bhaanaa bhaave ||
verses.translation: One who is pleased with the Lord God's Will is a devotee, the True Guru, the Primal Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh anahadh vajeh vaaje har aap gal melaave ||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current of bliss resounds and vibrates; the Lord hugs him close in His embrace.

verses.original: ਤੁਸੀ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: tusee put bhaiee paravaar meraa man vekhahu kar nirajaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: O my children, siblings and family, look carefully in your minds, and see.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhur likhiaa paravaanaa firai naahee gur jai har prabh paas jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: The pre-ordained death warrant cannot be avoided; the Guru is going to be with the Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bhaanai aapanai beh paravaar sadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, in His Own Sweet Will, sat up and summoned His family.

verses.original: ਮਤ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੋਈ ਰੋਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mat mai pichhai koiee rovasee so mai mool na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Let no one weep for me after I am gone. That would not please me at all.

verses.original: ਮਿਤੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਮਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: mit paijhai mit bigasai jis mit kee paij bhaave ||
verses.translation: When a friend receives a robe of honor, then his friends are pleased with his honor.

verses.original: ਤੁਸੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪੈਨਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: tusee veechaar dhekhahu put bhaiee har satiguroo painaave ||
verses.translation: Consider this and see, O my children and siblings; the Lord has given the True Guru the robe of supreme honor.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਟਿਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satiguroo paratakh hodhai beh raaj aap Tikaiaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru Himself sat up, and appointed the successor to the Throne of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of Meditation and Success.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖ ਬੰਧਪ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh sikh ba(n)dhap put bhaiee raamadhaas pairee paiaa ||4||
verses.translation: All the Sikhs, relatives, children and siblings have fallen at the Feet of Guru Ram Das. ||4||

verses.original: ਅੰਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)te satigur boliaa mai pichhai keeratan kariahu nirabaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Finally, the True Guru said, ""When I am gone, sing Kirtan in Praise of the Lord, in Nirvaanaa.""

verses.original: ਕੇਸੋ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਦਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: keso gopaal pa(n)ddit sadhiahu har har kathaa paReh puraan jeeau ||
verses.translation: Call in the long-haired scholarly Saints of the Lord, to read the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਬੇਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: har kathaa paReeaai har naam suneeaai bebaan har ra(n)g gur bhaave ||
verses.translation: Read the sermon of the Lord, and listen to the Lord's Name; the Guru is pleased with love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾ ਫੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dd patal kiriaa dheevaa ful har sar paave ||
verses.translation: Do not bother with offering rice-balls on leaves, lighting lamps, and other rituals like floating the body out on the Ganges; instead, let my remains be given up to the Lord's Pool.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhaiaa satigur boliaa har miliaa purakh sujaan jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Lord was pleased as the True Guru spoke; he was blended then with the all-knowing Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸੋਢੀ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: raamadhaas soddee tilak dheeaa gur sabadh sach neesaan jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: The Guru then blessed the Sodhi Ram Das with the ceremonial tilak mark, the insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਰਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh j boliaa gursikhaa ma(n)n liee rajai jeeau ||
verses.translation: And as the True Guru, the Primal Lord spoke, and the Gursikhs obeyed His Will.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਰੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: moharee put sanamukh hoiaa raamadhaasai pairee pai jeeau ||
verses.translation: His son Mohri turned sunmukh, and become obedient to Him; he bowed, and touched Ram Das' feet.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਪਵੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੇਰੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh pavai pairee satiguroo keree jithai guroo aap rakhiaa ||
verses.translation: Then, everyone bowed and touched the feet of Ram Das, into whom the Guru infused His essence.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਰਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਨਿਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਆਣਿ ਨਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: koiee kar bakheelee nivai naahee fir satiguroo aan nivaiaa ||
verses.translation: And any that did not bow then because of envy - later, the True Guru brought them around to bow in humility.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਦੀਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gureh bhaanaa dheeiee vaddiaaiee dhur likhiaa lekh rajai jeeau ||
verses.translation: It pleased the Guru, the Lord, to bestow glorious greatness upon Him; such was the pre-ordained destiny of the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahai su(n)dhar sunahu sa(n)tahu sabh jagat pairee pai jeeau ||6||1||
verses.translation: Says Sundar, listen, O Saints: all the world fell at His feet. ||6||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖਲੋਇਅੜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਜਨੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: saajanaRaa meraa saajanaRaa nikaT khaloiaRaa meraa saajanaRaa ||
verses.translation: Friend, my Friend - standing so near to me is my Friend!

verses.original: ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਅੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaaneeaRaa har jaaneeaRaa nain aloiaRaa har jaaneeaRaa ||
verses.translation: Beloved, the Lord my Beloved - with my eyes, I have seen the Lord, my Beloved!

verses.original: ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਇਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੋਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: nain aloiaa ghaT ghaT soiaa at a(n)mirat pria gooRaa ||
verses.translation: With my eyes I have seen Him, sleeping upon the bed within each and every heart; my Beloved is the sweetest ambrosial nectar.

verses.original: ਨਾਲਿ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: naal hova(n)dhaa leh na saka(n)dhaa suaau na jaanai mooRaa ||
verses.translation: He is with all, but he cannot be found; the fool does not know His taste.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੋਛੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਭਰਮ ਧੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa madh maataa hochhee baataa milan na jaiee bharam dhaRaa ||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, the mortal babbles on about trivial affairs; giving in to the illusion, he cannot meet the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਖੜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur bin naahee soojhai har saajan sabh kai nikaT khaRaa ||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, without the Guru, he cannot understand the Lord, the Friend who is standing near everyone. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dhaa mere gobi(n)dhaa praan adhaaraa mere gobi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: God, my God - the Support of the breath of life is my God.

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਦਾਨ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaalaa mere kirapaalaa dhaan dhaataaraa mere kirapaalaa ||
verses.translation: Merciful Lord, my Merciful Lord - the Giver of gifts is my Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਦਾਨ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaan dhaataaraa apar apaaraa ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sohaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Giver of gifts is infinite and unlimited; deep within each and every heart, He is so beautiful!

verses.original: ਇਕ ਦਾਸੀ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਲੈ ਮੋਹਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhaasee dhaaree sabal pasaaree jeea ja(n)t lai mohaniaa ||
verses.translation: He created Maya, His slave, so powerfully pervasive - she has enticed all beings and creatures.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no raakhai so sach bhaakhai gur kaa sabadh beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord saves, chants the True Name, and contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jo prabh kau bhaanaa tis hee kau prabh piaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who is pleasing to God - God is very dear to him. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਾਣੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਣੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: maano prabh maano mere prabh kaa maano ||
verses.translation: I take pride, I take pride in God; I take pride in my God.

verses.original: ਜਾਣੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaano prabh jaano suaamee sughaR sujaano ||
verses.translation: Wise, God is wise; my Lord and Master is all-wise, and all-knowing.

verses.original: ਸੁਘੜ ਸੁਜਾਨਾ ਸਦ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: sughaR sujaanaa sadh paradhaanaa a(n)mrit har kaa naamaa ||
verses.translation: All-wise and all-knowing, and forever supreme; the Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: chaakh aghaane saarigapaane jin kai bhaag mathaanaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny recorded upon their foreheads, taste it, and are satisfied with the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਮਾਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: tin hee paiaa tineh dhiaaiaa sagal tisai kaa maano ||
verses.translation: They meditate on Him, and find Him; they place all their pride in Him.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਦੀਬਾਣੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak thir takhat nivaasee sach tisai dheebaano ||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, He is seated on His eternal throne; True is His royal court. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮੰਗਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)galaa har ma(n)galaa mere prabh kai suneeaai ma(n)galaa ||
verses.translation: The song of joy, the Lord's song of joy; listen to the song of joy of my God.

verses.original: ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀਐ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ॥
verses.translit: sohilaRaa prabh sohilaRaa anahadh dhuneeaai sohilaRaa ||
verses.translation: The wedding song, God's wedding song; the unstruck sound current of His wedding song resounds.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਜੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh vaaje sabadh agaaje nit nit jiseh vadhaiee ||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current vibrates, and the Word of the Shabad resounds; there is continuous, continual rejoicing.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh dhiaaieeaai sabh kichh paieeaai marai na aavai jaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditating on that God, everything is obtained; He does not die, or come or go.

verses.original: ਚੂਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: chookee piaasaa pooran aasaa gurmukh mil niraguneeaai ||
verses.translation: Thirst is quenched, and hopes are fulfilled; the Gurmukh meets with the absolute, unmanifest Lord.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ghar prabh mere kai nit nit ma(n)gal suneeaai ||4||1||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, in the Home of my God, the songs of joy are continuously, continually heard. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har har dhiaai manaa khin na visaareeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O mind; don't forget Him, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਮਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: raam raamaa raam ramaa ka(n)Th ur dhaareeaai ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, Raam, within your heart and throat.

verses.original: ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: aur dhaar har har purakh pooran paarabraham nira(n)jano ||
verses.translation: Enshrine within your heart the Primal Lord, Har, Har, the all-pervading, supreme, immaculate Lord God.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ ਦੁਸਹ ਦੁਖ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhai dhoor karataa paap harataa dhuseh dhukh bhav kha(n)ddano ||
verses.translation: He sends fear far away; He is the Destroyer of sin; He eradicates the unbearable pains of the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਮਾਧੋ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jagadhees iees guopaal maadho gun govi(n)dh veechaareeaai ||
verses.translation: Contemplate the Lord of the World, the Cherisher of the World, the Lord, the Virtuous Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak mil sa(n)g saadhoo dhinas rain chitaareeaai ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, remember the Lord, day and night. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal aadhaar jan kaa aasaraa ||
verses.translation: His lotus feet are the support and anchor of His humble servants.

verses.original: ਮਾਲੁ ਮਿਲਖ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਨੰਤ ਧਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: maal milakh bha(n)ddaar naam ana(n)t dharaa ||
verses.translation: He takes the Naam, the Name of the Infinite Lord, as his wealth, property and treasure.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਏਕ ਨਰਾਇਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: naam narahar nidhaan jin kai ras bhog ek narainaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have the treasure of the Lord's Name, enjoy the taste of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੰਤ ਬੀਠਲ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਇਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: ras roop ra(n)g ana(n)t beeThal saas saas dhiaainaa ||
verses.translation: They meditate on the Infinite Lord with each and every breath, as their pleasure, joy and beauty.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣਾ ਨਾਮ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਹਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh haranaa naam punahacharanaa naam jam kee traas haraa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Destroyer of sins, the only deed of redemption. The Naam drives out the fear of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਸਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਹ ਆਸਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak raas jan kee charan kamaleh aasaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the support of His lotus feet is the capital of His humble servant. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit: gun bea(n)t suaamee tere koi na jaaniee ||
verses.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are endless, O my Lord and Master; no one knows them all.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਗਤ ਵਖਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhekh chalat dhiaal sun bhagat vakhaaniee ||
verses.translation: Seeing and hearing of Your wondrous plays, O Merciful Lord, Your devotees narrate them.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh tujh dhiaaveh purakhapat paramesaraa ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures meditate on You, O Primal Transcendent Lord, Master of men.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jaachik ek dhaataa karunaa mai jagadheesaraa ||
verses.translation: All beings are beggars; You are the One Giver, O Lord of the Universe, Embodiment of mercy.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਮਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)t sujaan soiee jiseh prabh jee maaniee ||
verses.translation: He alone is holy, a Saint, a truly wise person, who is accepted by the Dear Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋਇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa soi tujheh pachhaaniee ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, they alone realize You, unto whom You show Mercy. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: moh niragun anaath saranee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am unworthy and without any master; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bal bal bal gurdhev jin naam dhiraRaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Divine Guru, who has implanted the Naam within me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਰਬ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur naam dheeaa kusal theeaa sarab ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru blessed me with the Naam; happiness came, and all my desires were fulfilled.

verses.original: ਜਲਨੇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jalane bujhaiee saa(n)t aaiee mile chiree vichhu(n)niaa ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire has been quenched, and peace and tranquility have come; after such a long separation, I have met my Lord again.

verses.original: ਆਨੰਦ ਹਰਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aana(n)dh harakh sahaj saache mahaa ma(n)gal gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have found ecstasy, pleasure and true intuitive poise, singing the great glories, the song of bliss of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak naam prabh kaa gur poore te paiaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have obtained the Name of God from the Perfect Guru. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਗਾਈਐ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: run jhuno sabadh anaahadh nit uTh gaieeaai sa(n)tan kai ||
verses.translation: Rise early each morning, and with the Saints, sing the melodious harmony, the unstruck sound current of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh sabh dhokh binaasan har naam japeeaai gur ma(n)tan kai ||
verses.translation: All sins and sufferings are erased, chanting the Lord's Name, under Guru's Instructions.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਜੈ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਜੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: har naam leejai amiau peejai rain dhinas araadheeaai ||
verses.translation: Dwell upon the Lord's Name, and drink in the Nectar; day and night, worship and adore Him.

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਲਗਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲਹ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jog dhaan anek kiriaa lag charan kamaleh saadheeaai ||
verses.translation: The merits of Yoga, charity and religious rituals are obtained by grasping His lotus feet.

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau bhagat dhiaal mohan dhookh sagale paraharai ||
verses.translation: Loving devotion to the merciful, enticing Lord takes away all pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਰਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak tarai saagar dhiaai suaamee naraharai ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, cross over the world-ocean, meditating on the Lord, your Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਭਗਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar gobi(n)dh simaran bhagat gaaveh gun tere raam ||
verses.translation: Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is an ocean of peace; Your devotees sing Your Glorious Praises, Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: anadh ma(n)gal gur charanee laage paae sookh ghanere raam ||
verses.translation: Ecstasy, bliss and great happiness are obtained by grasping hold of the Guru's feet.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿਆ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sukh nidhaan miliaa dhookh hariaa kirapaa kar prabh raakhiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the treasure of peace, their pains are taken away; granting His Grace, God protects them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har charan laagaa bhram bhau bhaagaa har naam rasanaa bhaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who grasp the Lord's feet - their fears and doubts run away, and they chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ek chitavai prabh ek gaavai har ek dhirasaTee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: He thinks of the One Lord, and he sings of the One God; he gazes upon the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak prabh karee kirapaa pooraa satigur paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, God has granted His Grace, and I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mil raheeaai prabh saadh janaa mil har keeratan suneeaai raam ||
verses.translation: Meet with the holy, humble servants of God; meeting with the Lord, listen to the Kirtan of His Praises.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਮਾਧੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal prabhoo dhaamodhar maadho a(n)t na paieeaai guneeaai raam ||
verses.translation: God is the Merciful Master, the Lord of wealth; there is no end to His Virtues.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਹਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaal dhukh har saran dhaataa sagal dhokh nivaarano ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord is the Dispeller of pain, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Eradicator of all evil.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਸੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੜੇ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮ ਉਧਾਰਣੋ ॥
verses.translit: moh sog vikaar bikhaRe japat naam udhaarano ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment, sorrow, corruption and pain - chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is saved from these.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭ ਰੇਣ ਥੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jeea tere prabhoo mere kar kirapaa sabh ren theevaa ||
verses.translation: All beings are Yours, O my God; bless me with Your Mercy, that I may become the dust under the feet of all men.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak prabh miaa keejai naam teraa jap jeevaa ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, O God, be kind to me, that I may chant Your Name, and live. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਅਪਣੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: raakh le'ee prabh bhagat janaa apanee charanee laae raam ||
verses.translation: God saves His humble devotees, attaching them to His feet.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar apanaa prabh simareh eko naam dhiaae raam ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they meditate in remembrance on their God; they meditae on the One Name.

verses.original: ਧਿਆਇ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਰੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਰਹੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaai so prabh tare bhavajal rahe aavan jaanaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on that God, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and their comings and goings cease.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਗਾ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukh kaliaan keeratan prabh lagaa meeThaa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: They enjoy eternal peace and pleasure, singing the Kirtan of God's Praises; His Will seems so sweet to them.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ichh pu(n)nee aas pooree mile satigur pooriaa ||
verses.translation: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸੂਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap mele fir naahee dhookh visooriaa ||4||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, God has blended me with Himself; I shall never suffer pain or sorrow again. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Chhant.

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal saranaagatee anadh ma(n)gal gun gaam ||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of His lotus feet, I sing His Glorious Praises in ecstasy and bliss.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh aaraadheeaai bipat nivaaran raam ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, worship God in adoration, the Eradicator of misfortune. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bipat nivaarano tis bin avar na koi jeeau ||
verses.translation: God is the Eradicator of misfortune; there is none other than Him.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa har simareeaai jal thal maheeal soi jeeau ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, remember the Lord in meditation; He is permeating the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal poor rahiaa ik nimakh manahu na veesarai ||
verses.translation: He is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; do not forget Him from your mind, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦਿਨ ਸਭਾਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur charan laage dhin sabhaage sarab gun jagadheesarai ||
verses.translation: Blessed was that day, when I grasped the Guru's feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar sev sevak dhinas rainee tis bhaavai so hoi jeeau ||
verses.translation: So serve Him day and night, O servant; whatever pleases Him, happens.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bal jai naanak sukheh dhaate paragaas man tan hoi jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Giver of peace; his mind and body are enlightened. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸੋਚ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat man tan sukhee binasee dhuteeaa soch ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the mind and body find peace; the thought of duality is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਕੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੋਚ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak Tek guopaal kee govi(n)dh sa(n)kaT moch ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak takes the support of the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of troubles. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai sa(n)kaT kaaTe naarain dhiaal jeeau ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Lord has eradicated my fears and troubles.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਨੰਦ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har gun aana(n)dh gaae prabh dheenaa naath pratipaal jeeau ||
verses.translation: In ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; God is the Cherisher, the Master of the meek.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: pratipaal achut purakh eko tiseh siau ra(n)g laagaa ||
verses.translation: The Cherishing Lord is imperishable, the One and only Primal Lord; I am imbued with His Love.

verses.original: ਕਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar charan masatak mel leene sadhaa anadhin jaagaa ||
verses.translation: When I placed my hands and forehead upon His Feet, He blended me with Himself; I became awake and aware forever, night and day.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd girahu thaan tis kaa tan joban dhan maal jeeau ||
verses.translation: My soul, body, household and home belong to Him, along with my body, youth, wealth and property.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadh sadhaa bal jai naanak sarab jeeaa pratipaal jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice to Him, who cherishes and nurtures all beings. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਵਖਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ucharai har hare gun govi(n)dh vakhiaan ||
verses.translation: My tongue chants the Name of the Lord, and chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਕੜੀ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਖੈ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pakaRee Tek ek paramesar rakhai nidhaan ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak has grasped the sheltering support of the One Transcendent Lord, who shall save him in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਕੋ ਅੰਚਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: so suaamee prabh rakhako a(n)chal taa kai laag jeeau ||
verses.translation: He is God, our Lord and Master, our Saving Grace. Grab hold of the hem of His robe.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaj saadhoo sa(n)g dhiaal dhev man kee mat tiaag jeeau ||
verses.translation: Vibrate, and meditate on the Merciful Divine Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; renounce your intellectual mind.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਓਟ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਸ ਇਕ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: eik oT keejai jeeau dheejai aas ik dharaneedharai ||
verses.translation: Seek the Support of the One Lord, and surrender your soul to Him; place your hopes only in the Sustainer of the World.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)ge har naam ra(n)ge sa(n)saar saagar sabh tarai ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Name, in the Saadh Sangat, cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਛੂਟੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran bikaar chhooTe fir na laagai dhaag jeeau ||
verses.translation: The corrupting sins of birth and death are eradicated, and no stain ever sticks to them again.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਥਿਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bal jai naanak purakh pooran thir jaa kaa sohaag jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Primal Lord; His marriage is eternal. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: dharam arath ar kaam mokh mukat padhaarath naath ||
verses.translation: Righteous faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and salvation; the Lord bestows these four blessings.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath pooriaa naanak likhiaa maath ||1||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny upon his forehead, O Nanak, has all his desires fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal ichh meree pu(n)neeaa miliaa nira(n)jan rai jeeau ||
verses.translation: All my desires are fulfilled, meeting with my Immaculate, Sovereign Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadh bhiaa vaddabhaageeho gireh pragaTe prabh aai jeeau ||
verses.translation: I am in ecstasy, O very fortunate ones; the Dear Lord has become manifest in my own home.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਏ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਗਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gireh laal aae purab kamaae taa kee upamaa kiaa ganaa ||
verses.translation: My Beloved has come to my home, because of my past actions; how can I count His Glories?

verses.original: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਭਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: bea(n)t pooran sukh sahaj dhaataa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace and intuition, is infinite and perfect; with what tongue can I describe His Glorious Virtues?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aape milaae geh ka(n)Th laae tis binaa nahee jai jeeau ||
verses.translation: He hugs me close in His embrace, and merges me into Himself; there is no place of rest other than Him.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: bal jai naanak sadhaa karate sabh meh rahiaa samai jeeau ||4||4||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Creator, who is contained in, and permeating all. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਣ ਝੁੰਝਨੜਾ ਗਾਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: ran jhu(n)jhanaRaa gaau sakhee har ek dhiaavahu ||
verses.translation: Sing the melodious harmonies, O my companions, and meditate on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਖੀ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur tum sev sakhee man chi(n)dhiaRaa fal paavahu ||
verses.translation: Serve your True Guru, O my companions, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires.

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰੁਤੀ ਸਲੋਕੁ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa rutee saloku
verses.translation: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Ruti ~ The Seasons. Shalok:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਾਛਉ ਸਾਧਹ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar ba(n)dhan prabh paarabraham baachhau saadheh dhoor ||
verses.translation: Bow to the Supreme Lord God, and seek the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap nivaar har har bhajau naanak prabh bharapoor ||1||
verses.translation: Cast out your self-conceit, and vibrate, meditate, on the Lord, Har, Har. O Nanak, God is all-pervading. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟਣ ਭੈ ਹਰਣ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh kaaTan bhai haran sukh saagar har rai ||
verses.translation: He is the Eradicator of sins, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal dhukh bha(n)jano naanak neet dhiaai ||2||
verses.translation: Merciful to the meek, the Destroyer of pain: O Nanak, always meditate on Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jas gaavahu vaddabhaageeho kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t jeeau ||
verses.translation: Sing His Praises, O very fortunate ones, and the Dear Lord God shall bless you with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਮੂਰਤ ਘੜੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰਤ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rutee maeh moorat ghaRee gun ucharat sobhaava(n)t jeeau ||
verses.translation: Blessed and auspicious is that season, that month, that moment, that hour, when you chant the Lord's Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun ra(n)g raate dha(n)n te jan jinee ik man dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those humble beings, who are imbued with love for His Praises, and who meditate single-mindedly on Him.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam bhiaa tin kaa jinee so prabh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Their lives become fruitful, and they find that Lord God.

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪਾ ਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan na tul kiriaa har sarab paapaa ha(n)t jeeau ||
verses.translation: Donations to charities and religious rituals are not equal to meditation on the Lord, who destroys all sins.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak simar jeevaa janam maran raha(n)t jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, meditating in remembrance on Him, I live; birth and death are finished for me. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਉਦਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੋ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: audham agam agocharo charan kamal namasakaar ||
verses.translation: Strive for the inaccessible and unfathomable Lord, and bow in humility to His lotus feet.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਸਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kathanee saa tudh bhaavasee naanak naam adhaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that sermon alone is pleasing to You, Lord, which inspires us to take the Support of the Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਪਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t saran saajan parahu suaamee simar ana(n)t ||
verses.translation: Seek the Sanctuary of the Saints, O friends; meditate in remembrance on your infinite Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸੂਕੇ ਤੇ ਹਰਿਆ ਥੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sooke te hariaa theeaa naanak jap bhagava(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: The dried branch shall blossom forth in its greenery again, O Nanak, meditating on the Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਸ ਬਸੰਤ ਮਾਹ ਚੇਤੁ ਵੈਸਾਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rut saras basa(n)t maeh chet vaisaakh sukh maas jeeau ||
verses.translation: The season of spring is delightful; the months of Chayt and Baisaakhi are the most pleasant months.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau naahu miliaa mauliaa man tan saas jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Dear Lord as my Husband, and my mind, body and breath have blossomed forth.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghar naahu nihachal anadh sakhe'ee charan kamal prafuliaa ||
verses.translation: The eternal, unchanging Lord has come into my home as my Husband, O my companions; dwelling upon His lotus feet, I blossom forth in bliss.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਬੇਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਅਮੁਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sughaR sujaan betaa gun govi(n)dh amuliaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is beautiful, proficient, wise and all-knowing;

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaag paiaa dhukh gavaiaa bhiee pooran aas jeeau ||
verses.translation: His Virtues are priceless. By great good fortune, I have found Him; my pain is dispelled, and my hopes are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak saran teree miTee jam kee traas jeeau ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have entered Your Sanctuary, Lord, and my fear of death is eradicated. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਈ ਕਰਤੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat bin bhram muiee karatee karam anek ||
verses.translation: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one dies wandering around in confusion, performing all sorts of rituals.

verses.original: ਕੋਮਲ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਾਧੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: komal ba(n)dhan baadheeaa naanak karameh lekh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, all are bound by the attractive bonds of Maya, and the karmic record of past actions. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਭਾਣੇ ਸੇ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਭੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo bhaane se meliaa vichhoRe bhee aap ||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to God are united with Him; He separates others from Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kaa vadd parataap ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; His greatness is glorious! ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਜੇਠ ਅਖਾੜੈ ਘਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: greekham rut at gaakhaRee jeTh akhaaRai ghaam jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the summer season, in the months of Jayt'h and Asaarh, the heat is terrible, intense and severe.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਦੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਕਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: prem bichhoh dhuhaaganee dhirasaT na karee raam jeeau ||
verses.translation: The discarded bride is separated from His Love, and the Lord does not even look at her.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਰਤ ਹਾਵੈ ਮਹਾ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: neh dhirasaT aavai marat haavai mahaa gaarab muTheeaa ||
verses.translation: She does not see her Lord, and she dies with an aching sigh; she is defrauded and plundered by her great pride.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਬਾਝੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੜਫੜਾਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੁਠੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: jal baajh machhulee taRafaRaavai sa(n)g maiaa ruTheeaa ||
verses.translation: She flails around, like a fish out of water; attached to Maya, she is alienated from the Lord.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਜੋਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਹੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਸਾਸਨ ਜਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar paap jonee bhai bheet hoiee dhei saasan jaam jeeau ||
verses.translation: She sins, and so she is fearful of reincarnation; the Messenger of Death will surely punish her.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak oT teree raakh pooran kaam jeeau ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, take me under Your sheltering support, Lord, and protect me; You are the Fulfiller of desire. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saradhaa laagee sa(n)g preetamai ik til rahan na jai ||
verses.translation: With loving faith, I am attached to my Beloved; I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar rav rahe naanak sahaj subhai ||1||
verses.translation: He is permeating and pervading my mind and body, O Nanak, with intuitive ease. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: kar geh leenee saajaneh janam janam ke meet ||
verses.translation: My Friend has taken me by the hand; He has been my best friend, lifetime after lifetime.

verses.original: ਚਰਨਹ ਦਾਸੀ ਕਰਿ ਲਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: charaneh dhaasee kar liee naanak prabh hit cheet ||2||
verses.translation: He has made me the slave of His feet; O Nanak, my consciousness is filled with love for God. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਰੁਤਿ ਬਰਸੁ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਸਾਵਣ ਭਾਦਵੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rut baras suheleeaa saavan bhaadhave aana(n)dh jeeau ||
verses.translation: The rainy season is beautiful; the months of Saawan and Bhaadon bring bliss.

verses.original: ਘਣ ਉਨਵਿ ਵੁਠੇ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghan unav vuThe jal thal pooriaa makara(n)dh jeeau ||
verses.translation: The clouds are low, and heavy with rain; the waters and the lands are filled with honey.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh poor rahiaa sarab Thaiee har naam nav nidh gireh bhare ||
verses.translation: God is all-pervading everywhere; the nine treasures of the Lord's Name fill the homes of all hearts.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: simar suaamee a(n)tarajaamee kul samoohaa sabh tare ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord and Master, the Searcher of hearts, all one's ancestry is saved.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਹ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਸਦ ਬਖਸਿੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: pria ra(n)g jaage neh chhidhr laage kirapaal sadh bakhasi(n)dh jeeau ||
verses.translation: No blemish sticks to that being who remains awake and aware in the Love of the Lord; the Merciful Lord is forever forgiving.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਦੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak har ka(n)t paiaa sadhaa man bhaava(n)dh jeeau ||4||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord, who is forever pleasing to my mind. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਉ ਕਬ ਪੇਖਉ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: aas piaasee mai firau kab pekhau gopaal ||
verses.translation: Thirsty with desire, I wander around; when will I behold the Lord of the World?

verses.original: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hai koiee saajan sa(n)t jan naanak prabh melanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: Is there any humble Saint, any friend, O Nanak, who can lead me to meet with God? ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin milabe saa(n)t na uoopajai til pal rahan na jai ||
verses.translation: Without meeting Him, I have no peace or tranquility; I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har saadheh saranaagatee naanak aas pujai ||2||
verses.translation: Entering the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy Saints, O Nanak, my desires are fulfilled. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਦ ਅਡੰਬਰੋ ਅਸੂ ਕਤਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rut saradh adda(n)baro asoo katake har piaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the cool, autumn season, in the months of Assu and Katik, I am thirsty for the Lord.

verses.original: ਖੋਜੰਤੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਫਿਰਤ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: khoja(n)tee dharasan firat kab mileeaai gunataas jeeau ||
verses.translation: Searching for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I wander around wondering, when will I meet my Lord, the treasure of virtue?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਹ ਸੂਖ ਸਾਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਕੰਙਣ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin ka(n)t piaare neh sookh saare haar ka(n)n(g)n dhirag banaa ||
verses.translation: Without my Beloved Husband Lord, I find no peace, and all my necklaces and bracelets become cursed.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਬੇਤੀ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar sujaan chatur betee saas bin jaise tanaa ||
verses.translation: So beautiful, so wise, so clever and knowing; still, without the breath, it is just a body.

verses.original: ਈਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਅਲੋਕਨ ਮਨਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਿਆਸ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet ut dheh dhis alokan man milan kee prabh piaas jeeau ||
verses.translation: I look here and there, in the ten directions; my mind is so thirsty to meet God!

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa melahu prabh gunataas jeeau ||5||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, shower Your Mercy upon me; unite me with Yourself, O God, O treasure of virtue. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਜਲਣਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jalan bujhee seetal bhe man tan upajee saa(n)t ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire is cooled and quenched; my mind and body are filled with peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh pooran mile dhuteeaa binasee bhraa(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have met my Perfect God; the illusion of duality is dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਪਠਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh paThaae aap har ham tum te naahee dhoor ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself sent His Holy Saints, to tell us that He is not far away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਰਮਣ ਰਾਮ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhram bhai miT ge raman raam bharapoor ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, doubt and fear are dispelled, chanting the Name of the all-pervading Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਸੀਅਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮੰਘਰ ਪੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: rut siseear seetal har pragaTe ma(n)ghar poh jeeau ||
verses.translation: In the cold season of Maghar and Poh, the Lord reveals Himself.

verses.original: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: jalan bujhee dharas paiaa binase maiaa dhroh jeeau ||
verses.translation: My burning desires were quenched, when I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the fraudulent illusion of Maya is gone.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kaam poore mil hajoore har charan sevak seviaa ||
verses.translation: All my desires have been fulfilled, meeting the Lord face-to-face; I am His servant, I serve at His feet.

verses.original: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: haar ddor seegaar sabh ras gun gaau alakh abheviaa ||
verses.translation: My necklaces, hair-ties, all decorations and adornments, are in singing the Glorious Praises of the unseen, mysterious Lord.

verses.original: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaau bhagat govi(n)dh baa(n)chhat jam na saakai joh jeeau ||
verses.translation: I long for loving devotion to the Lord of the Universe, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap melee teh na prem bichhoh jeeau ||6||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, God has united me with Himself; I shall never suffer separation from my Beloved again. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan paiaa sohaaganee ddolat naahee cheet ||
verses.translation: The happy soul bride has found the wealth of the Lord; her consciousness does not waver.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sa(n)jogee naanakaa gireh pragaTe prabh meet ||1||
verses.translation: Joining together with the Saints, O Nanak, God, my Friend, has revealed Himself in my home. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੋਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: naadh binodh ana(n)dh kodd pria preetam sa(n)g bane ||
verses.translation: With her Beloved Husband Lord, she enjoys millions of melodies, pleasures and joys.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: man baa(n)chhat fal paiaa har naanak naam bhane ||2||
verses.translation: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, O Nanak, chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਹਿਮਕਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤੀ ਮਾਘੁ ਫਗਣੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: himakar rut man bhaavatee maagh fagan gunava(n)t jeeau ||
verses.translation: The snowy winter season, the months of Maagh and Phagun, are pleasing and ennobling to the mind.

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee sahelee gaau ma(n)galo gireh aae har ka(n)t jeeau ||
verses.translation: O my friends and companions, sing the songs of joy; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gireh laal aae man dhiaae sej su(n)dhar soheeaa ||
verses.translation: My Beloved has come into my home; I meditate on Him in my mind. The bed of my heart is beautifully adorned.

verses.original: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਭਏ ਹਰਿਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੋਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: van tiran tirabhavan bhe hariaa dhekh dharasan moheeaa ||
verses.translation: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in their greenery; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am fascinated.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: mile suaamee ichh pu(n)nee man japiaa niramal ma(n)t jeeau ||
verses.translation: I have met my Lord and Master, and my desires are fulfilled; my mind chants His Immaculate Mantra.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak nit karahu raleeaa har mile sreedhar ka(n)t jeeau ||7||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I celebrate continuously; I have met my Husband Lord, the Lord of excellence. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sahaiee jeea ke bhavajal taaranahaar ||
verses.translation: The Saints are the helpers, the support of the soul; they carry us cross the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh te uooche jaane'eeh naanak naam piaar ||1||
verses.translation: Know that they are the highest of all; O Nanak, they love the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਤਰੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin jaaniaa seiee tare se soore se beer ||
verses.translation: Those who know Him, cross over; they are the brave heroes, the heroic warriors.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tin balihaaranai har jap utare teer ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord, and cross over to the other shore. ||2||

verses.original: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: chha(n)t ||
verses.translation: Chhant:

verses.original: ਚਰਣ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਸਭ ਊਪਰੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan biraajit sabh uoopare miTiaa sagal kales jeeau ||
verses.translation: His feet are exalted above all. They eradicate all suffering.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaavan dhukh hare har bhagat keeaa paraves jeeau ||
verses.translation: They destroy the pains of coming and going. They bring loving devotion to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raate sahaj maate til na man te beesarai ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, and does not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: taj aap saranee pare charanee sarab gun jagadheesarai ||
verses.translation: Shedding my self-conceit, I have entered the Sanctuary of His Feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh gun nidh sreera(n)g suaamee aadh kau aadhes jeeau ||
verses.translation: I bow in humility to the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of excellence, our Primal Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੋ ਇਕ ਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak miaa dhaarahu jug jugo ik ves jeeau ||8||1||6||8||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; throughout the ages, You take the same form. ||8||1||6||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa dhakhanee oa(n)kaaru
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla, Dakhanee, Ongkaar:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar brahamaa utapat ||
verses.translation: From Ongkaar, the One Universal Creator God, Brahma was created.

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar keeaa jin chit ||
verses.translation: He kept Ongkaar in his consciousness.

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੈਲ ਜੁਗ ਭਏ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar sail jug bhe ||
verses.translation: From Ongkaar, the mountains and the ages were created.

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਨਿਰਮਏ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar bedh nirame ||
verses.translation: Ongkaar created the Vedas.

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar sabadh udhare ||
verses.translation: Ongkaar saves the world through the Shabad.

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar gurmukh tare ||
verses.translation: Ongkaar saves the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਓਨਮ ਅਖਰ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: onam akhar sunahu beechaar ||
verses.translation: Listen to the Message of the Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਓਨਮ ਅਖਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: onam akhar tirabhavan saar ||1||
verses.translation: The Universal, Imperishable Creator Lord is the essence of the three worlds. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਪਾਡੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sun paadde kiaa likhahu ja(n)jaalaa ||
verses.translation: Listen, O Pandit, O religious scholar, why are you writing about worldly debates?

verses.original: ਲਿਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: likh raam naam gurmukh gopaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, write only the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਇਕ ਜੋਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: sasai sabh jag sahaj upaiaa teen bhavan ik jotee ||
verses.translation: Sassa: He created the entire universe with ease; His One Light pervades the three worlds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਲੈ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vasat paraapat hovai chun lai maanak motee ||
verses.translation: Become Gurmukh, and obtain the real thing; gather the gems and pearls.

verses.original: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: samajhai soojhai paR paR boojhai a(n)t nira(n)tar saachaa ||
verses.translation: If one understands, realizes and comprehends what he reads and studies, in the end he shall realize that the True Lord dwells deep within his nucleus.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dhekhai saach samaale bin saache jag kaachaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sees and contemplates the True Lord; without the True Lord, the world is false. ||2||

verses.original: ਧਧੈ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਰੇ ਧਰਮਾ ਪੁਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhadhai dharam dhare dharamaa pur gunakaaree man dheeraa ||
verses.translation: Dhadha: Those who enshrine Dharmic faith and dwell in the City of Dharma are worthy; their minds are steadfast and stable.

verses.original: ਧਧੈ ਧੂਲਿ ਪੜੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhadhai dhool paRai mukh masatak ka(n)chan bhe manooraa ||
verses.translation: Dhadha: If the dust of their feet touches one's face and forehead, he is transformed from iron into gold.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dharaneedhar aap ajonee tol bol sach pooraa ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the Support of the Earth; He Himself is not born; His measure and speech are perfect and True.

verses.original: ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: karate kee mit karataa jaanai kai jaanai gur sooraa ||3||
verses.translation: Only the Creator Himself knows His own extent; He alone knows the Brave Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਙਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: n(g)iaan gavaiaa dhoojaa bhaiaa garab gale bikh khaiaa ||
verses.translation: In love with duality, spiritual wisdom is lost; the mortal rots away in pride, and eats poison.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਰਸੁ ਗੀਤ ਬਾਦ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur ras geet baadh nahee bhaavai suneeaai gahir ga(n)bheer gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: He thinks that the sublime essence of the Guru's song is useless, and he does not like to hear it. He loses the profound, unfathomable Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur sach kahiaa a(n)mrit lahiaa man tan saach sukhaiaa ||
