verses.translation: Through the Guru's Words of Truth, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained, and the mind and body find joy in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aape gurmukh aape dhevai aape a(n)mrit peeaaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Nectar; He Himself leads us to drink it in. ||4||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: eko ek kahai sabh koiee haumai garab viaapai ||
verses.translation: Everyone says that God is the One and only, but they are engrossed in egotism and pride.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਇਉ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar ek pachhaanai iau ghar mahal sin(j)aapai ||
verses.translation: Realize that the One God is inside and outside; understand this, that the Mansion of His Presence is within the home of your heart.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਏਕੋ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: prabh neRai har dhoor na jaanahu eko sirasaT sabaiee ||
verses.translation: God is near at hand; do not think that God is far away. The One Lord permeates the entire universe.

verses.original: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: eka(n)kaar avar nahee dhoojaa naanak ek samaiee ||5||
verses.translation: There in One Universal Creator Lord; there is no other at all. O Nanak, merge into the One Lord. ||5||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਅਫਰਿਓ ਤੁਲਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eis karate kau kiau geh raakhau afario tulio na jaiee ||
verses.translation: How can you keep the Creator under your control? He cannot be seized or measured.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਦੇਵਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa ke dhevaane praanee jhooTh Thagauree paiee ||
verses.translation: Maya has made the mortal insane; she has administered the poisonous drug of falsehood.

verses.original: ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੁਹਤਾਜਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh muhataaj vigoote ib tab fir pachhutaiee ||
verses.translation: Addicted to greed and avarice, the mortal is ruined, and then later, he regrets and repents.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ek sarevai taa gat mit paavai aavan jaan rahaiee ||6||
verses.translation: So serve the One Lord, and attain the state of Salvation; your comings and goings shall cease. ||6||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਇਕੁ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: ek achaar ra(n)g ik roop ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is in all actions, colors and forms.

verses.original: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee aganee asaroop ||
verses.translation: He manifests in many shapes through wind, water and fire.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਭਵਰੁ ਭਵੈ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko bhavar bhavai tih loi ||
verses.translation: The One Soul wanders through the three worlds.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko boojhai soojhai pat hoi ||
verses.translation: One who understands and comprehends the One Lord is honored.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲੇ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan le samasar rahai ||
verses.translation: One who gathers in spiritual wisdom and meditation, dwells in the state of balance.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ek viralaa ko lahai ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, attain the One Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis no dhei kirapaa te sukh paae ||
verses.translation: They alone find peace, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: guroo dhuaarai aakh sunaae ||7||
verses.translation: In the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, they speak and hear of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਊਰਮ ਧੂਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: uooram dhooram jot ujaalaa ||
verses.translation: His Light illuminates the ocean and the earth.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: teen bhavan meh gur gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: Throughout the three worlds, is the Guru, the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਊਗਵਿਆ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: uoogaviaa asaroop dhikhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord reveals His various forms;

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa apunai ghar aavai ||
verses.translation: granting His Grace, He enters the home of the heart.

verses.original: ਊਨਵਿ ਬਰਸੈ ਨੀਝਰ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: uoonav barasai neejhar dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The clouds hang low, and the rain is pouring down.

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: uootam sabadh savaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord embellishes and exalts with the Sublime Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਏਕੇ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: eis eke kaa jaanai bheau ||
verses.translation: One who knows the mystery of the One God,

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਉ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: aape karataa aape dheau ||8||
verses.translation: is Himself the Creator, Himself the Divine Lord. ||8||

verses.original: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: augavai soor asur sa(n)ghaarai ||
verses.translation: When the sun rises, the demons are slain;

verses.original: ਊਚਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: uoochau dhekh sabadh beechaarai ||
verses.translation: the mortal looks upwards, and contemplates the Shabad.

verses.original: ਊਪਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: uoopar aadh a(n)t tih loi ||
verses.translation: The Lord is beyond the beginning and the end, beyond the three worlds.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਕਥੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape karai kathai sunai soi ||
verses.translation: He Himself acts, speaks and listens.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh bidhaataa man tan dhei ||
verses.translation: He is the Architect of Destiny; He blesses us with mind and body.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh bidhaataa man mukh soi ||
verses.translation: That Architect of Destiny is in my mind and mouth.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jagajeevan avar na koi ||
verses.translation: God is the Life of the world; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate pat hoi ||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is honored. ||9||

verses.original: ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਰਵੈ ਹਿਤਕਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: raajan raam ravai hitakaar ||
verses.translation: One who lovingly chants the Name of the Sovereign Lord King,

verses.original: ਰਣ ਮਹਿ ਲੂਝੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ran meh loojhai manooaa maar ||
verses.translation: fights the battle and conquers his own mind;

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: raat dhina(n)t rahai ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: day and night, he remains imbued with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teen bhavan jug chaare jaataa ||
verses.translation: He is famous throughout the three worlds and the four ages.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin jaataa so tis hee jehaa ||
verses.translation: One who knows the Lord, becomes like Him.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: at niramail seejhas dhehaa ||
verses.translation: He becomes absolutely immaculate, and his body is sanctified.

verses.original: ਰਹਸੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rahasee raam ridhai ik bhai ||
verses.translation: His heart is happy, in love with the One Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh saach liv lai ||10||
verses.translation: He lovingly centers his attention deep within upon the True Word of the Shabad. ||10||

verses.original: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਰਹਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ros na keejai a(n)mrit peejai rahan nahee sa(n)saare ||
verses.translation: Don't be angry - drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall not remain in this world forever.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਇ ਰੰਕ ਨਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raaje rai ra(n)k nahee rahanaa aai jai jug chaare ||
verses.translation: The ruling kings and the paupers shall not remain; they come and go, throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਰਹਣ ਕਹਣ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: rahan kahan te rahai na koiee kis peh karau bina(n)tee ||
verses.translation: Everyone says that they will remain, but none of them remain; unto whom should I offer my prayer?

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੋਧਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਮਤੀ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: ek sabadh raam naam nirodhar gur dhevai pat matee ||11||
verses.translation: The One Shabad, the Name of the Lord, will never fail you; the Guru grants honor and understanding. ||11||

verses.original: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੰਤੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਖੋਲਿ ਚਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: laaj mara(n)tee mar giee ghooghaT khol chalee ||
verses.translation: My shyness and hesitation have died and gone, and I walk with my face unveiled.

verses.original: ਸਾਸੁ ਦਿਵਾਨੀ ਬਾਵਰੀ ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਸੰਕ ਟਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: saas dhivaanee baavaree sir te sa(n)k Talee ||
verses.translation: The confusion and doubt from my crazy, insane mother-in-law has been removed from over my head.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਰਲੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: prem bulaiee ralee siau man meh sabadh ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: My Beloved has summoned me with joyful caresses; my mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਲਾਲਿ ਰਤੀ ਲਾਲੀ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਚਿੰਦੁ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: laal ratee laalee bhiee gurmukh bhiee nichi(n)dh ||12||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Love of my Beloved, I have become Gurmukh, and carefree. ||12||

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa naam ratan jap saar ||
verses.translation: Chant the jewel of the Naam, and earn the profit of the Lord.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh buraa aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Greed, avarice, evil and egotism;

verses.original: ਲਾੜੀ ਚਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: laaRee chaaRee laitabaar ||
verses.translation: slander, inuendo and gossip;

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh a(n)dhaa mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: the self-willed manmukh is blind, foolish and ignorant.

verses.original: ਲਾਹੇ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: laahe kaaran aaiaa jag ||
verses.translation: For the sake of earning the profit of the Lord, the mortal comes into the world.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਮਜੂਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਠਗਾਇ ਠਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: hoi majoor giaa Thagai Thag ||
verses.translation: But he becomes a mere slave laborer, and is mugged by the mugger, Maya.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa naam poo(n)jee vesaahu ||
verses.translation: One who earns the profit of the Naam, with the capital of faith,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sachee pat sachaa paatisaahu ||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is truly honored by the True Supreme King. ||13||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਵਿਗੂਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: aai vigootaa jag jam pa(n)th ||
verses.translation: The world is ruined on the path of Death.

verses.original: ਆਈ ਨ ਮੇਟਣ ਕੋ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaiee na meTan ko samarath ||
verses.translation: No one has the power to erase Maya's influence.

verses.original: ਆਥਿ ਸੈਲ ਨੀਚ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aath sail neech ghar hoi ||
verses.translation: If wealth visits the home of the lowliest clown,

verses.original: ਆਥਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aath dhekh nivai jis dhoi ||
verses.translation: seeing that wealth, all pay their respects to him.

verses.original: ਆਥਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਾ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਸਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aath hoi taa mugadh siaanaa ||
verses.translation: Even an idiot is thought of as clever, if he is rich.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bihoonaa jag bauraanaa ||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship, the world is insane.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh varatai eko soi ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is contained among all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kare tis paragaT hoi ||14||
verses.translation: He reveals Himself, unto those whom He blesses with His Grace. ||14||

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug thaap sadhaa niravair ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, the Lord is eternally established; He has no vengeance.

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹੀ ਧੰਧਾ ਧੈਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran nahee dha(n)dhaa dhair ||
verses.translation: He is not subject to birth and death; He is not entangled in worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so aape aap ||
verses.translation: Whatever is seen, is the Lord Himself.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਘਟ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap upai aape ghaT thaap ||
verses.translation: Creating Himself, He establishes Himself in the heart.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aap agochar dha(n)dhai loiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is unfathomable; He links people to their affairs.

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jog jugat jagajeevan soiee ||
verses.translation: He is the Way of Yoga, the Life of the World.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar aachaar sach sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Living a righteous lifestyle, true peace is found.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਵ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naam vihoonaa mukat kiv hoiee ||15||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone find liberation? ||15||

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਰੋਧੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai verodh sareer ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, even one's own body is an enemy.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਮਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: kiau na mileh kaaTeh man peer ||
verses.translation: Why not meet the Lord, and take away the pain of your mind?

verses.original: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaaT vaTaauoo aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The traveller comes and goes along the highway.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa le aaiaa kiaa palai pai ||
verses.translation: What did he bring when he came, and what will he take away when he goes?

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai toTaa sabh thai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, one loses everywhere.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa milai jaa dhei bujhai ||
verses.translation: The profit is earned, when the Lord grants understanding.

verses.original: ਵਣਜੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਵਣਜੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: vanaj vaapaar vanajai vaapaaree ||
verses.translation: In merchandise and trade, the merchant is trading.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: vin naavai kaisee pat saaree ||16||
verses.translation: Without the Name, how can one find honor and nobility? ||16||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun veechaare giaanee soi ||
verses.translation: One who contemplates the Lord's Virtues is spiritually wise.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun meh giaan paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: Through His Virtues, one receives spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gunadhaataa viralaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: How rare in this world, is the Giver of virtue.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saachee karanee gur veechaar ||
verses.translation: The True way of life comes through contemplation of the Guru.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar keemat nahee pai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is inaccessible and unfathomable. His worth cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa mileeaai jaa le milai ||
verses.translation: They alone meet Him, whom the Lord causes to meet.

verses.original: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: gunava(n)tee gun saare neet ||
verses.translation: The virtuous soul bride continually contemplates His Virtues.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮੀਤ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmat mileeaai meet ||17||
verses.translation: O Nanak, following the Guru's Teachings, one meets the Lord, the true friend. ||17||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਗਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh kaiaa kau gaalai ||
verses.translation: Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger waste the body away,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਾ ਢਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau ka(n)chan sohaagaa ddaalai ||
verses.translation: as gold is dissolved by borax.

verses.original: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਸਹੈ ਸੁ ਤਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kas kasavaTee sahai su taau ||
verses.translation: The gold is touched to the touchstone, and tested by fire;

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਸਰਾਫ ਵੰਨੀ ਸਚੜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar saraaf va(n)nee sachaRaau ||
verses.translation: when its pure color shows through, it is pleasing to the eye of the assayer.

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਪਸੂ ਅਹੰ ਕਾਲੁ ਕਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jagat pasoo aha(n) kaal kasaiee ||
verses.translation: The world is a beast, and arrogent Death is the butcher.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kar karatai karanee kar paiee ||
verses.translation: The created beings of the Creator receive the karma of their actions.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jin keetee tin keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: He who created the world, knows its worth.

verses.original: ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: hor kiaa kaheeaai kichh kahan na jaiee ||18||
verses.translation: What else can be said? There is nothing at all to say. ||18||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat a(n)mrit peeaa ||
verses.translation: Searching, searching, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਖਿਮਾ ਗਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: khimaa gahee man satagur dheeaa ||
verses.translation: I have adopted the way of tolerance, and given my mind to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kharaa kharaa aakhai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone calls himself true and genuine.

verses.original: ਖਰਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kharaa ratan jug chaare hoi ||
verses.translation: He alone is true, who obtains the jewel throughout the four ages.

verses.original: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਅੰਤ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khaat peea(n)t mooe nahee jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Eating and drinking, one dies, but still does not know.

verses.original: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੂਏ ਜਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: khin meh mooe jaa sabadh pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He dies in an instant, when he realizes the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਮਰਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: asathir cheet maran man maaniaa ||
verses.translation: His consciousness becomes permanently stable, and his mind accepts death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te naam pachhaaniaa ||19||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||19||

verses.original: ਗਗਨ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gagan ga(n)bheer gagana(n)tar vaas ||
verses.translation: The Profound Lord dwells in the sky of the mind, the Tenth Gate;

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai sukh sahaj nivaas ||
verses.translation: singing His Glorious Praises, one dwells in intuitive poise and peace.

verses.original: ਗਇਆ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaa na aavai aai na jai ||
verses.translation: He does not go to come, or come to go.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord.

verses.original: ਗਗਨੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gagan aga(n)m anaath ajonee ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the mind-sky is inaccessible, independent and beyond birth.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਗੋਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: asathir cheet samaadh sagonee ||
verses.translation: The most worthy Samaadhi is to keep the consciousness stable, focused on Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਵਹਿ ਨ ਜੂਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: har naam chet fir paveh na joonee ||
verses.translation: Remembering the Lord's Name, one is not subject to reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੋਰ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੀ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: gurmat saar hor naam bihoonee ||20||
verses.translation: The Guru's Teachings are the most Excellent; all other ways lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||20||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਦਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar fir thaakee bahutere ||
verses.translation: Wandering to countless doorsteps and homes, I have grown weary.

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaat asa(n)kh a(n)t nahee mere ||
verses.translation: My incarnations are countless, without limit.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kete maat pitaa sut dheeaa ||
verses.translation: I have had so many mothers and fathers, sons and daughters.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: kete gur chele fun hooaa ||
verses.translation: I have had so many gurus and disciples.

verses.original: ਕਾਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaache gur te mukat na hooaa ||
verses.translation: Through a false guru, liberation is not found.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ketee naar var ek samaal ||
verses.translation: There are so many brides of the One Husband Lord - consider this.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh maran jeevan prabh naal ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh dies, and lives with God.

verses.original: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਢੂਢਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dhis ddoodd gharai meh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Searching in the ten directions, I found Him within my own home.

verses.original: ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: mel bhiaa satiguroo milaiaa ||21||
verses.translation: I have met Him; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||21||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh gaavai gurmukh bolai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sings, and the Gurmukh speaks.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਵੈ ਤੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh tol tuolaavai tolai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh evaluates the value of the Lord, and inspires others to evaluate Him as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aavai jai nisa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh comes and goes without fear.

verses.original: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਲਾਇ ਕਲੰਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: parahar mail jalai kala(n)k ||
verses.translation: His filth is taken away, and his stains are burnt off.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naadh bedh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh contemplates the sound current of the Naad for his Vedas.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh majan chaj achaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh's cleansing bath is the performance of good deeds.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadh a(n)mrit hai saar ||
verses.translation: For the Gurmukh, the Shabad is the most excellent Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paavai paar ||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh crosses over. ||22||

verses.original: ਚੰਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)chal cheet na rahiee Thai ||
verses.translation: The fickle consciousness does not remain stable.

verses.original: ਚੋਰੀ ਮਿਰਗੁ ਅੰਗੂਰੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: choree mirag a(n)gooree khai ||
verses.translation: The deer secretly nibbles at the green sprouts.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਚੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal ur dhaare cheet ||
verses.translation: One who enshrines the Lord's lotus feet in his heart and consciousness

verses.original: ਚਿਰੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਚੇਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: chir jeevan chetan nit neet ||
verses.translation: lives long, always remembering the Lord.

verses.original: ਚਿੰਤਤ ਹੀ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chi(n)tat hee dheesai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone has worries and cares.

verses.original: ਚੇਤਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਤਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: cheteh ek tahee sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: He alone finds peace, who thinks of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chit vasai raachai har nai ||
verses.translation: When the Lord dwells in the consciousness, and one is absorbed in the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: mukat bhiaa pat siau ghar jai ||23||
verses.translation: one is liberated, and returns home with honor. ||23||

verses.original: ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹ ਖੁਲੈ ਇਕ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
verses.translit: chheejai dheh khulai ik ga(n)dd ||
verses.translation: The body falls apart, when one knot is untied.

verses.original: ਛੇਆ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਜਗਿ ਹੰਢਿ ॥
verses.translit: chheaa nit dhekhahu jag ha(n)dd ||
verses.translation: Behold, the world is on the decline; it will be totally destroyed.

verses.original: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoop chhaav je sam kar jaanai ||
verses.translation: Only one who looks alike upon sunshine and shade

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan kaaT mukat ghar aanai ||
verses.translation: has his bonds shattered; he is liberated and returns home.

verses.original: ਛਾਇਆ ਛੂਛੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhaiaa chhoochhee jagat bhulaanaa ||
verses.translation: Maya is empty and petty; she has defrauded the world.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaa kirat dhure paravaanaa ||
verses.translation: Such destiny is pre-ordained by past actions.

verses.original: ਛੀਜੈ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਜਰੂਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: chheejai joban jarooaa sir kaal ||
verses.translation: Youth is wasting away; old age and death hover above the head.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਛੀਜੈ ਭਈ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: kaiaa chheejai bhiee sibaal ||24||
verses.translation: The body falls apart, like algae upon the water. ||24||

verses.original: ਜਾਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaapai aap prabhoo tih loi ||
verses.translation: God Himself appears throughout the three worlds.

verses.original: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jug jug dhaataa avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, He is the Great Giver; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau raakheh raakh ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You protect and preserve us.

verses.original: ਜਸੁ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: jas jaachau dhevai pat saakh ||
verses.translation: I ask for the Lord's Praises, which bless me with honor and credit.

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat jaag rahaa tudh bhaavaa ||
verses.translation: Remaining awake and aware, I am pleasing to You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa too meleh taa tujhai samaavaa ||
verses.translation: When You unite me with Yourself, then I am merged in You.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar japau jagadhees ||
verses.translation: I chant Your Victorious Praises, O Life of the World.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਬੀਸ ਇਕੀਸ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: gurmat mileeaai bees ikees ||25||
verses.translation: Accepting the Guru's Teachings, one is sure to merge in the One Lord. ||25||

verses.original: ਝਖਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਗ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhakh bolan kiaa jag siau vaadh ||
verses.translation: Why do you speak such nonsense, and argue with the world?

verses.original: ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਰਮਾਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhoor marai dhekhai paramaadh ||
verses.translation: You shall die repenting, when you see your own insanity.

verses.original: ਜਨਮਿ ਮੂਏ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: janam mooe nahee jeevan aasaa ||
verses.translation: He is born, only to die, but he does not wish to live.

verses.original: ਆਇ ਚਲੇ ਭਏ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aai chale bhe aas niraasaa ||
verses.translation: He comes hopeful, and then goes, without hope.

verses.original: ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jhur jhur jhakh maaTee ral jai ||
verses.translation: Regretting, repenting and grieving, he is dust mixing with dust.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਂਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaal na chaa(n)pai har gun gai ||
verses.translation: Death does not chew up one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਾਈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paiee nav nidh har kai nai ||
verses.translation: The nine treasures are obtained through the Name of the Lord;

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: aape dhevai sahaj subhai ||26||
verses.translation: the Lord bestows intuitive peace and poise. ||26||

verses.original: ਞਿਆਨੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: n(j)iaano bolai aape boojhai ||
verses.translation: He speaks spiritual wisdom, and He Himself understands it.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸਮਝੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape samajhai aape soojhai ||
verses.translation: He Himself knows it, and He Himself comprehends it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa kahiaa a(n)k samaavai ||
verses.translation: One who takes the Words of the Guru into his very fiber,

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੂਚੇ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: niramal sooche saacho bhaavai ||
verses.translation: is immaculate and holy, and is pleasing to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਟ ॥
verses.translit: gur saagar ratanee nahee toT ||
verses.translation: In the ocean of the Guru, there is no shortage of pearls.

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਖੋਟ ॥
verses.translit: laal padhaarath saach akhoT ||
verses.translation: The treasure of jewels is truly inexhaustible.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kahiaa saa kaar kamaavahu ||
verses.translation: Do those deeds which the Guru has ordained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee karanee kaahe dhaavahu ||
verses.translation: Why are you chasing after the Guru's actions?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹੁ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmat saach samaavahu ||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, merge in the True Lord. ||27||

verses.original: ਟੂਟੈ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: TooTai neh k boleh sahee ||
verses.translation: Love is broken, when one speaks in defiance.

verses.original: ਟੂਟੈ ਬਾਹ ਦੁਹੂ ਦਿਸ ਗਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: TooTai baeh dhuhoo dhis gahee ||
verses.translation: The arm is broken, when it is pulled from both sides.

verses.original: ਟੂਟਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਗਈ ਬੁਰ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: TooT pareet giee bur bol ||
verses.translation: Love breaks, when the speech goes sour.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਛਾਡੀ ਢੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat parahar chhaaddee ddol ||
verses.translation: The Husband Lord abandons and leaves behind the evil-minded bride.

verses.original: ਟੂਟੈ ਗੰਠਿ ਪੜੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: TooTai ga(n)Th paRai veechaar ||
verses.translation: The broken knot is tied again, through contemplation and meditation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee ghar kaaraj saar ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one's affairs are resolved in one's own home.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਾ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa saach na aavai toTaa ||
verses.translation: One who earns the profit of the True Name, will not lose it again;

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਟਾ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: tirabhavan Thaakur preetam moTaa ||28||
verses.translation: the Lord and Master of the three worlds is your best friend. ||28||

verses.original: ਠਾਕਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakahu manooaa raakhahu Thai ||
verses.translation: Control your mind, and keep it in its place.

verses.original: ਠਹਕਿ ਮੁਈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: Thahak muiee avagun pachhutai ||
verses.translation: The world is destroyed by conflict, regretting its sinful mistakes.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਾਈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur ek sabaiee naar ||
verses.translation: There is one Husband Lord, and all are His brides.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bahute ves kare kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: The false bride wears many costumes.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: par ghar jaatee Thaak rahaiee ||
verses.translation: He stops her from going into the homes of others;

verses.original: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mahal bulaiee Thaak na paiee ||
verses.translation: He summons her to the Mansion of His Presence, and no obstacles block her path.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh savaaree saach piaaree ||
verses.translation: She is embellished with the Word of the Shabad, and is loved by the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: saiee suohaagan Thaakur dhaaree ||29||
verses.translation: She is the happy soul bride, who takes the Support of her Lord and Master. ||29||

verses.original: ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਫਾਟੇ ਚੀਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ddolat ddolat he sakhee faaTe cheer seegaar ||
verses.translation: Wandering and roaming around, O my companion, your beautiful robes are torn.

verses.original: ਡਾਹਪਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਡਰ ਬਿਣਠੀ ਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ddaahapan tan sukh nahee bin ddar binaThee ddaar ||
verses.translation: In jealousy, the body is not at peace; without the Fear of God, multitudes are ruined.

verses.original: ਡਰਪਿ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਡੀਠੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਸੁਜਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: ddarap muiee ghar aapanai ddeeThee ka(n)t sujaan ||
verses.translation: One who remains dead within her own home, through the Fear of God, is looked upon with favor by her all-knowing Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਡਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: ddar raakhiaa gur aapanai nirabhau naam vakhaan ||
verses.translation: She maintains fear of her Guru, and chants the Name of the Fearless Lord.

verses.original: ਡੂਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਘਣੀ ਜਬ ਦੇਖਾ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ddoogar vaas tikhaa ghanee jab dhekhaa nahee dhoor ||
verses.translation: Living on the mountain, I suffer such great thirst; when I see Him, I know that He is not far away.

verses.original: ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tikhaa nivaaree sabadh ma(n)n a(n)mrit peeaa bharapoor ||
verses.translation: My thirst is quenched, and I have accepted the Word of the Shabad. I drink my fill of the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: dheh dheh aakhai sabh koiee jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
verses.translation: Everyone says, ""Give! Give!"" As He pleases, He gives.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: guroo dhuaarai dhevasee tikhaa nivaarai soi ||30||
verses.translation: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Door, He gives, and quenches the thirst. ||30||

verses.original: ਢੰਢੋਲਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਹਉ ਫਿਰੀ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਵਨਿ ਕਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dda(n)ddolat ddooddat hau firee ddeh ddeh pavan karaar ||
verses.translation: Searching and seeking, I fell down and collapsed upon the bank of the river of life.

verses.original: ਭਾਰੇ ਢਹਤੇ ਢਹਿ ਪਏ ਹਉਲੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhaare ddahate ddeh pe haule nikase paar ||
verses.translation: Those who are heavy with sin sink down, but those who are light swim across.

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਅਜਾਚੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: amar ajaachee har mile tin kai hau bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who meet the immortal and immeasurable Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee dhooR aghuleeaai sa(n)gat mel milaau ||
verses.translation: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in their company, we are united in the Lord's Union.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man dheeaa gur aapanai paiaa niramal naau ||
verses.translation: I gave my mind to my Guru, and received the Immaculate Name.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jin naam dheeaa tis sevasaa tis balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I serve the One who gave me the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸੋ ਢਾਹਸੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo usaare so ddaahasee tis bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: He who builds, also demolishes; there is no other than Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮੑਲਾ ਤਾ ਤਨਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee tis sa(n)m(h)laa taa tan dhookh na hoi ||31||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I contemplate Him, and then my body does not suffer in pain. ||31||

verses.original: ਣਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਹੀ ਣਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa ko meraa kis gahee naa ko hoaa na hog ||
verses.translation: No one is mine - whose gown should I grasp and hold? No one ever was, and no one shall ever be mine.

verses.original: ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan vigucheeaai dhubidhaa viaapai rog ||
verses.translation: Coming and going, one is ruined, afflicted with the disease of dual-mindedness.

verses.original: ਣਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਆਦਮੀ ਕਲਰ ਕੰਧ ਗਿਰੰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam vihoone aadhamee kalar ka(n)dh gira(n)t ||
verses.translation: Those beings who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, collapse like pillars of salt.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਅੰਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai kiau chhooTeeaai jai rasaatal a(n)t ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, how can they find release? They fall into hell in the end.

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵੈ ਅਖਰੀ ਅਗਣਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ganat ganaavai akharee aganat saachaa soi ||
verses.translation: Using a limited number of words, we describe the unlimited True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: agiaanee matiheen hai gur bin giaan na hoi ||
verses.translation: The ignorant lack understanding. Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਤੂਟੀ ਤੰਤੁ ਰਬਾਬ ਕੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: tooTee ta(n)t rabaab kee vaajai nahee vijog ||
verses.translation: The separated soul is like the broken string of a guitar, which does not vibrate its sound.

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa melai prabhoo naanak kar sa(n)jog ||32||
verses.translation: God unites the separated souls with Himself, awakening their destiny. ||32||

verses.original: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਪੰਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖੀ ਪੰਚ ॥
verses.translit: taravar kaiaa pa(n)kh man taravar pa(n)khee pa(n)ch ||
verses.translation: The body is the tree, and the mind is the bird; the birds in the tree are the five senses.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਰੰਚ ॥
verses.translit: tat chugeh mil ekase tin kau faas na ra(n)ch ||
verses.translation: They peck at the essence of reality, and merge with the One Lord. They are never trapped at all.

verses.original: ਉਡਹਿ ਤ ਬੇਗੁਲ ਬੇਗੁਲੇ ਤਾਕਹਿ ਚੋਗ ਘਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: auddeh ta begul begule taakeh chog ghanee ||
verses.translation: But the others fly away in a hurry, when they see the food.

verses.original: ਪੰਖ ਤੁਟੇ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੜੀ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਭੀੜ ਬਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)kh tuTe faahee paRee avagun bheeR banee ||
verses.translation: Their feathers are clipped, and they are caught in the noose; through their mistakes, they are caught in disaster.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin saache kiau chhooTeeaai har gun karam manee ||
verses.translation: Without the True Lord, how can anyone find release? The jewel of the Lord's Glorious Praises comes by the karma of good actions.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhaddaae chhooTeeaai vaddaa aap dhanee ||
verses.translation: When He Himself releases them, only then are they released. He Himself is the Great Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee chhooTeeaai kirapaa aap karei ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, they are released, when He Himself grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: apanai haath vaddaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||33||
verses.translation: Glorious greatness rests in His Hands. He blesses those with whom He is pleased. ||33||

verses.original: ਥਰ ਥਰ ਕੰਪੈ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਾਨ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: thar thar ka(n)pai jeeaRaa thaan vihoonaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The soul trembles and shakes, when it loses its mooring and support.

verses.original: ਥਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਫੀਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: thaan maan sach ek hai kaaj na feeTai koi ||
verses.translation: Only the support of the True Lord brings honor and glory. Through it, one's works are never in vain.

verses.original: ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: thir naarain thir guroo thir saachaa beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord is eternal and forever stable; the Guru is stable, and contemplation upon the True Lord is stable.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਧਾਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar naatheh naath too nidhaaraa aadhaar ||
verses.translation: O Lord and Master of angels, men and Yogic masters, You are the support of the unsupported.

verses.original: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰੀ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sarabe thaan thana(n)taree too dhaataa dhaataar ||
verses.translation: In all places and interspaces, You are the Giver, the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh ek too a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there I see You, Lord; You have no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: You are pervading and permeating the places and interspaces; reflecting upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, You are found.

verses.original: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਵਡਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: anama(n)giaa dhaan dhevasee vaddaa agam apaar ||34||
verses.translation: You give gifts even when they are not asked for; You are great, inaccessible and infinite. ||34||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhaan dhiaal too kar kar dhekhanahaar ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, You are the embodiment of mercy; creating the Creation, You behold it.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa kareh prabh mel laih khin meh ddaeh usaar ||
verses.translation: Please shower Your Mercy upon me, O God, and unite me with Yourself. In an instant, You destroy and rebuild.

verses.original: ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhaanaa too beenaa tuhee dhaanaa kai sir dhaan ||
verses.translation: You are all-wise and all-seeing; You are the Greatest Giver of all givers.

verses.original: ਦਾਲਦ ਭੰਜਨ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: dhaaladh bha(n)jan dhukh dhalan gurmukh giaan dhiaan ||35||
verses.translation: He is the Eradicator of poverty, and the Destroyer of pain; the Gurmukh realizes spiritual wisdom and meditation. ||35||

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਗਇਐ ਬਹਿ ਝੂਰੀਐ ਧਨ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤੁ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhan giaai beh jhooreeaai dhan meh cheet gavaar ||
verses.translation: Losing his wealth, he cries out in anguish; the fool's consciousness is engrossed in wealth.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhan viralee sach sa(n)chiaa niramal naam piaar ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who gather the wealth of Truth, and love the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਣ ਦੇਹਿ ਜੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ॥
verses.translit: dhan giaa taa jaan dheh je raacheh ra(n)g ek ||
verses.translation: If by losing your wealth, you may become absorbed in the Love of the One Lord, then just let it go.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਸਉਪੀਐ ਭੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: man dheejai sir saupeeaai bhee karate kee Tek ||
verses.translation: Dedicate your mind, and surrender your head; seek only the Support of the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat reh ge man meh sabadh ana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Worldly affairs and wanderings cease, when the mind is filled with the bliss of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਤੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਭਏ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: dhurajan te saajan bhe bheTe gur govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Even one's enemies become friends, meeting with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਫਿਰਤੀ ਢੂਢਤੀ ਬਸਤੁ ਰਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ban ban firatee ddooddatee basat rahee ghar baar ||
verses.translation: Wandering from forest to forest searching, you will find that those things are within the home of your own heart.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: satigur melee mil rahee janam maran dhukh nivaar ||36||
verses.translation: United by the True Guru, you shall remain united, and the pains of birth and death will be ended. ||36||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa karat na chhooTeeaai vin gun jam pur jaeh ||
verses.translation: Through various rituals, one does not find release. Without virtue, one is sent to the City of Death.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹੁ ਨ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis eh na oh hai avagun fir pachhutaeh ||
verses.translation: One will not have this world or the next; committing sinful mistakes, one comes to regret and repent in the end.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis giaan na dhiaan hai naa tis dharam dhiaan ||
verses.translation: He has neither spiritual wisdom or meditation; neither Dharmic faith nor meditation.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai nirabhau kahaa kiaa jaanaa abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, how can one be fearless? How can he understand egotistical pride?

verses.original: ਥਾਕਿ ਰਹੀ ਕਿਵ ਅਪੜਾ ਹਾਥ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: thaak rahee kiv apaRaa haath nahee naa paar ||
verses.translation: I am so tired - how can I get there? This ocean has no bottom or end.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naa saajan se ra(n)gule kis peh karee pukaar ||
verses.translation: I have no loving companions, whom I can ask for help.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak priau priau je karee mele melanahaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, crying out, ""Beloved, Beloved"", we are united with the Uniter.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ ਸੋ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: jin vichhoRee so melasee gur kai het apaar ||37||
verses.translation: He who separated me, unites me again; my love for the Guru is infinite. ||37||

verses.original: ਪਾਪੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paap buraa paapee kau piaaraa ||
verses.translation: Sin is bad, but it is dear to the sinner.

verses.original: ਪਾਪਿ ਲਦੇ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paap ladhe paape paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: He loads himself with sin, and expands his world through sin.

verses.original: ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: parahar paap pachhaanai aap ||
verses.translation: Sin is far away from one who understands himself.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis sog vijog sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: He is not afflicted by sorrow or separation.

verses.original: ਨਰਕਿ ਪੜੰਤਉ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਬੰਚੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: narak paRa(n)tau kiau rahai kiau ba(n)chai jamakaal ||
verses.translation: How can one avoid falling into hell? How can he cheat the Messenger of Death?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiau aavan jaanaa veesarai jhooTh buraa khai kaal ||
verses.translation: How can coming and going be forgotten? Falsehood is bad, and death is cruel.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੀ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਭੀ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man ja(n)jaalee veRiaa bhee ja(n)jaalaa maeh ||
verses.translation: The mind is enveloped by entanglements, and into entanglements it falls.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਪਾਪੇ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: vin naavai kiau chhooTeeaai paape pacheh pachaeh ||38||
verses.translation: Without the Name, how can anyone be saved? They rot away in sin. ||38||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਸੈ ਕਊਆ ॥
verses.translit: fir fir faahee faasai kuooaa ||
verses.translation: Again and again, the crow falls into the trap.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਾ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: fir pachhutaanaa ab kiaa hooaa ||
verses.translation: Then he regrets it, but what can he do now?

verses.original: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: faathaa chog chugai nahee boojhai ||
verses.translation: Even though he is trapped, he pecks at the food; he does not understand.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਆਖੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: satagur milai ta aakhee soojhai ||
verses.translation: If he meets the True Guru, then he sees with his eyes.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: jiau machhulee faathee jam jaal ||
verses.translation: Like a fish, he is caught in the noose of death.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: vin gur dhaate mukat na bhaal ||
verses.translation: Do not seek liberation from anyone else, except the Guru, the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: fir fir aavai fir fir jai ||
verses.translation: Over and over again, he comes; over and over again, he goes.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik ra(n)g rachai rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: Be absorbed in love for the One Lord, and remain lovingly focused on Him.

verses.original: ਇਵ ਛੂਟੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਾਸ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: eiv chhooTai fir faas na pai ||39||
verses.translation: In this way you shall be saved, and you shall not fall into the trap again. ||39||

verses.original: ਬੀਰਾ ਬੀਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਬੀਰ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: beeraa beeraa kar rahee beer bhe bairai ||
verses.translation: She calls out, ""Brother, O brother - stay, O brother!"" But he becomes a stranger.

verses.original: ਬੀਰ ਚਲੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿਣ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: beer chale ghar aapanai bahin bireh jal jai ||
verses.translation: Her brother departs for his own home, and his sister burns with the pain of separation.

verses.original: ਬਾਬੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟੜੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਬਾਲੈ ਨੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: baabul kai ghar beTaRee baalee baalai neh ||
verses.translation: In this world, her father's home, the daughter, the innocent soul bride, loves her Young Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: je loReh var kaamanee satigur seveh teh ||
verses.translation: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul bride, then serve the True Guru with love.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਲੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਣਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: biralo giaanee boojhanau satigur saach milei ||
verses.translation: How rare are the spiritually wise, who meet the True Guru, and truly understand.

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur haath vaddaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
verses.translation: All glorious greatness rests in the Lord and Master's Hands. He grants them, when He is pleased.

verses.original: ਬਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲਉ ਬੀਚਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baanee biralau beechaarasee je ko gurmukh hoi ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Bani; they become Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: eeh baanee mahaa purakh kee nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||40||
verses.translation: This is the Bani of the Supreme Being; through it, one dwells within the home of his inner being. ||40||

verses.original: ਭਨਿ ਭਨਿ ਘੜੀਐ ਘੜਿ ਘੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਉਸਰੇ ਢਾਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhan bhan ghaReeaai ghaR ghaR bhajai ddaeh usaarai usare ddaahai ||
verses.translation: Shattering and breaking apart, He creates and re-creates; creating, He shatters again. He builds up what He has demolished, and demolishes what He has built.

verses.original: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਖੈ ਭੀ ਭਰਿ ਪੋਖੈ ਸਮਰਥ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sar bhar sokhai bhee bhar pokhai samarath veparavaahai ||
verses.translation: He dries up the pools which are full, and fills the dried tanks again. He is all-powerful and independent.

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaane bhe dhivaane vin bhaagaa kiaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, they have gone insane; without destiny, what do they obtain?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਡੋਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਕੜੀ ਜਿਨ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh giaan ddoree prabh pakaRee jin khi(n)chai tin jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs know that God holds the string; wherever He pulls it, they must go.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gai sadhaa ra(n)g raate bahuR na pachhotaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, are forever imbued with His Love; they never again feel regret.

verses.original: ਭਭੈ ਭਾਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhabhai bhaaleh gurmukh boojheh taa nij ghar vaasaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Bhabha: If someone seeks, and then becomes Gurmukh, then he comes to dwell in the home of his own heart.

verses.original: ਭਭੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhabhai bhaujal maarag vikhaRaa aas niraasaa tareeaai ||
verses.translation: Bhabha: The way of the terrifying world-ocean is treacherous. Remain free of hope, in the midst of hope, and you shall cross over.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਆਪੋ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਵ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee aapo cheen(h)ai jeevatiaa iv mareeaai ||41||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one comes to understand himself; in this way, he remains dead while yet alive. ||41||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa maiaa kar mue maiaa kisai na saath ||
verses.translation: Crying out for the wealth and riches of Maya, they die; but Maya does not go along with them.

verses.original: ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਡੁਮਣੋ ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੀ ਆਥਿ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)s chalai uTh ddumano maiaa bhoolee aath ||
verses.translation: The soul-swan arises and departs, sad and depressed, leaving its wealth behind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਚਲਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man jhooThaa jam johiaa avagun chaleh naal ||
verses.translation: The false mind is hunted by the Messenger of Death; it carries its faults along when it goes.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਉਲਟੋ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: man meh man ulaTo marai je gun hoveh naal ||
verses.translation: The mind turns inward, and merges with mind, when it is with virtue.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: meree meree kar mue vin naavai dhukh bhaal ||
verses.translation: Crying out, ""Mine, mine!"", they have died, but without the Name, they find only pain.

verses.original: ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਕਹਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gaR ma(n)dhar mahalaa kahaa jiau baajee dheebaan ||
verses.translation: So where are their forts, mansions, palaces and courts? They are like a short story.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam vin jhooThaa aavan jaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, the false just come and go.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: aape chatur saroop hai aape jaan sujaan ||42||
verses.translation: He Himself is clever and so very beautiful; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||42||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਆਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo aaveh se jaeh fun aai ge pachhutaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who come, must go in the end; they come and go, regretting and repenting.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਵਧੈ ਉਤਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee ghaTai na vadhai utaeh ||
verses.translation: They will pass through 8.4 millions species; this number does not decrease or rise.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: se jan ubare jin har bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: They alone are saved, who love the Lord.

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਮੁਆ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa muaa vigootee maiaa ||
verses.translation: Their worldly entanglements are ended, and Maya is conquered.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਾਲਸੀ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo dheesai so chaalasee kis kau meet kareau ||
verses.translation: Whoever is seen, shall depart; who should I make my friend?

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਸਮਪਉ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau samapau aapanaa tan man aagai dheau ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my soul, and place my body and mind in offering before Him.

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਓਟ ॥
verses.translit: asathir karataa too dhanee tis hee kee mai oT ||
verses.translation: You are eternally stable, O Creator, Lord and Master; I lean on Your Support.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਚੋਟ ॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: gun kee maaree hau muiee sabadh ratee man choT ||43||
verses.translation: Conquered by virtue, egotism is killed; imbued with the Word of the Shabad, the mind rejects the world. ||43||

verses.original: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਤੁੰਗੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raanaa raau na ko rahai ra(n)g na tu(n)g fakeer ||
verses.translation: Neither the kings nor the nobles will remain; neither the rich nor the poor will remain.

verses.original: ਵਾਰੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: vaaree aapo aapanee koi na ba(n)dhai dheer ||
verses.translation: When one's turn comes, no one can stay here.

verses.original: ਰਾਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਾ ਸਰ ਡੂਗਰ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: raahu buraa bheehaavalaa sar ddoogar asagaeh ||
verses.translation: The path is difficult and treacherous; the pools and mountains are impassable.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਝੁਰਿ ਮੁਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: mai tan avagan jhur muiee vin gun kiau ghar jaeh ||
verses.translation: My body is filled with faults; I am dying of grief. Without virtue, how can I enter my home?

verses.original: ਗੁਣੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਉ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: guneeaa gun le prabh mile kiau tin milau piaar ||
verses.translation: The virtuous take virtue, and meet God; how can I meet them with love?

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾਂ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa(n) jap jap ridhai muraar ||
verses.translation: If ony I could be like them, chanting and meditating within my heart on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਵਗੁਣੀ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: avagunee bharapoor hai gun bhee vaseh naal ||
verses.translation: He is overflowing with faults and demerits, but virtue dwells within him as well.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: vin satagur gun na jaapanee jichar sabadh na kare beechaar ||44||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, he does not see God's Virtues; he does not chant the Glorious Virtues of God. ||44||

verses.original: ਲਸਕਰੀਆ ਘਰ ਸੰਮਲੇ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: lasakareeaa ghar sa(n)male aae vajahu likhai ||
verses.translation: God's soldiers take care of their homes; their pay is pre-ordained, before they come into the world.

verses.original: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਣੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaar kamaaveh sir dhanee laahaa palai pai ||
verses.translation: They serve their Supreme Lord and Master, and obtain the profit.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਆ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: lab lobh buriaaieeaa chhodde manahu visaar ||
verses.translation: They renounce greed, avarice and evil, and forget them from their minds.

verses.original: ਗੜਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gaR dhohee paatisaeh kee kadhe na aavai haar ||
verses.translation: In the fortress of the body, they announce the victory of their Supreme King; they are never ever vanquished.

verses.original: ਚਾਕਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਸਉਹੇ ਉਤਰ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaakar kaheeaai khasam kaa sauhe utar dhei ||
verses.translation: One who calls himself a servant of his Lord and Master, and yet speaks defiantly to Him,

verses.original: ਵਜਹੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਖਤਿ ਨ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: vajahu gavaae aapanaa takhat na baiseh sei ||
verses.translation: shall forfeit his pay, and not be seated upon the throne.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: preetam hath vaddiaaieeaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||
verses.translation: Glorious greatness rests in the hands of my Beloved; He gives, according to the Pleasure of His Will.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: aap kare kis aakheeaai avar na koi karei ||45||
verses.translation: He Himself does everything; who else should we address? No one else does anything. ||45||

verses.original: ਬੀਜਉ ਸੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹੈ ਦੁਲੀਚਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: beejau soojhai ko nahee bahai dhuleechaa pai ||
verses.translation: I cannot conceive of any other, who could be seated upon the royal cushions.

verses.original: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਨਰਹ ਨਰੁ ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: narak nivaaran nareh nar saachau saachai nai ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Man of men eradicates hell; He is True, and True is His Name.

verses.original: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਢੂਢਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: van tiran ddooddat fir rahee man meh karau beechaar ||
verses.translation: I wandered around searching for Him in the forests and meadows; I contemplate Him within my mind.

verses.original: ਲਾਲ ਰਤਨ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: laal ratan bahu maanakee satigur haath bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: The treasures of myriads of pearls, jewels and emeralds are in the hands of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: uootam hovaa prabh milai ik man ekai bhai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with God, I am exalted and elevated; I love the One Lord single-mindedly.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak preetam ras mile laahaa lai parathai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who lovingly meets with his Beloved, earns profit in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: rachanaa raach jin rachee jin siriaa aakaar ||
verses.translation: He who created and formed the creation, made your form as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bea(n)t dhiaaieeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||46||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, meditate on the Infinite Lord, who has no end or limitation. ||46||

verses.original: ੜਾੜੈ ਰੂੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: RaaRai rooRaa har jeeau soiee ||
verses.translation: Rharha: The Dear Lord is beautiful;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin raajaa avar na koiee ||
verses.translation: There is no other king, except Him.

verses.original: ੜਾੜੈ ਗਾਰੁੜੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: RaaRai gaaruR tum sunahu har vasai man maeh ||
verses.translation: Rharha: Listen to the spell, and the Lord will come to dwell in your mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har paieeaai mat ko bharam bhulaeh ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one finds the Lord; do not be deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: so saahu saachaa jis har dhan raas ||
verses.translation: He alone is the true banker, who has the capital of the wealth of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh pooraa tis saabaas ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is perfect - applaud him!

verses.original: ਰੂੜੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: rooRee baanee har paiaa gur sabadhee beechaar ||
verses.translation: Through the beautiful Word of the Guru's Bani, the Lord is obtained; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: aap giaa dhukh kaTiaa har var paiaa naar ||47||
verses.translation: Self-conceit is eliminated, and pain is eradicated; the soul bride obtains her Husband Lord. ||47||

verses.original: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਧਨੁ ਕਾਚਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: suinaa rupaa sa(n)cheeaai dhan kaachaa bikh chhaar ||
verses.translation: He hoards gold and silver, but this wealth is false and poisonous, nothing more than ashes.

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁ ਸਦਾਏ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saahu sadhaae sa(n)ch dhan dhubidhaa hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: He calls himself a banker, gathering wealth, but he is ruined by his dual-mindedness.

verses.original: ਸਚਿਆਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachiaaree sach sa(n)chiaa saachau naam amol ||
verses.translation: The truthful ones gather Truth; the True Name is priceless.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਊਜਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: har niramail uoojalo pat saachee sach bol ||
verses.translation: The Lord is immaculate and pure; through Him, their honor is true, and their speech is true.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet sujaan too too saravar too ha(n)s ||
verses.translation: You are my friend and companion, all-knowing Lord; You are the lake, and You are the swan.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachau Thaakur man vasai hau balihaaree tis ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to that being, whose mind is filled with the True Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mamataa mohanee jin keetee so jaan ||
verses.translation: Know the One who created love and attachment to Maya, the Enticer.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa a(n)mrit ek hai boojhai purakh sujaan ||48||
verses.translation: One who realizes the all-knowing Primal Lord, looks alike upon poison and nectar. ||48||

verses.original: ਖਿਮਾ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਖਪਿ ਗਏ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਅਸੰਖ ॥
verses.translit: khimaa vihoone khap ge khoohan lakh asa(n)kh ||
verses.translation: Without patience and forgiveness, countless hundreds of thousands have perished.

verses.original: ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਗਣੀ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਸੰਖ ॥
verses.translit: ganat na aavai kiau ganee khap khap mue bisa(n)kh ||
verses.translation: Their numbers cannot be counted; how could I count them? Bothered and bewildered, uncounted numbers have died.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਖੂਲੈ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khasam pachhaanai aapanaa khoolai ba(n)dh na pai ||
verses.translation: One who realizes his Lord and Master is set free, and not bound by chains.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੀ ਖਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਿਮਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh mahalee kharaa too khimaa sach sukh bhai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, enter the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; you shall be blessed with patience, forgiveness, truth and peace.

verses.original: ਖਰਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kharach kharaa dhan dhiaan too aape vaseh sareer ||
verses.translation: Partake of the true wealth of meditation, and the Lord Himself shall abide within your body.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: man tan mukh jaapai sadhaa gun a(n)tar man dheer ||
verses.translation: With mind, body and mouth, chant His Glorious Virtues forever; courage and composure shall enter deep within your mind.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪੈ ਖਪਾਇਸੀ ਬੀਜਉ ਵਥੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai khapai khapaisee beejau vath vikaar ||
verses.translation: Through egotism, one is distracted and ruined; other than the Lord, all things are corrupt.

verses.original: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਲਗੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: ja(n)t upai vich paian karataa alag apaar ||49||
verses.translation: Forming His creatures, He placed Himself within them; the Creator is unattached and infinite. ||49||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟੇ ਭੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sirasaTe bheau na jaanai koi ||
verses.translation: No one knows the mystery of the Creator of the World.

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਾ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sirasaTaa karai su nihachau hoi ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator of the World does, is certain to occur.

verses.original: ਸੰਪੈ ਕਉ ਈਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pai kau ieesar dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: For wealth, some meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੰਪੈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਕੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pai purab likhe kee paieeaai ||
verses.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, wealth is obtained.

verses.original: ਸੰਪੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਚਾਕਰ ਚੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pai kaaran chaakar chor ||
verses.translation: For the sake of wealth, some become servants or thieves.

verses.original: ਸੰਪੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਹੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pai saath na chaalai hor ||
verses.translation: Wealth does not go along with them when they die; it passes into the hands of others.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਨਹੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin saache nahee dharageh maan ||
verses.translation: Without Truth, honor is not obtained in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: har ras peevai chhuTai nidhaan ||50||
verses.translation: Drinking in the subtle essence of the Lord, one is emancipated in the end. ||50||

verses.original: ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇਰਤ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: herat herat he sakhee hoi rahee hairaan ||
verses.translation: Seeing and perceiving, O my companions, I am wonder-struck and amazed.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau karatee mai muiee sabadh ravai man giaan ||
verses.translation: My egotism, which proclaimed itself in possessiveness and self-conceit, is dead. My mind chants the Word of the Shabad, and attains spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਕੰਕਨ ਘਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haar ddor ka(n)kan ghane kar thaakee seegaar ||
verses.translation: I am so tired of wearing all these necklaces, hair-ties and bracelets, and decorating myself.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mil preetam sukh paiaa sagal gunaa gal haar ||
verses.translation: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; now, I wear the necklace of total virtue.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paieeaai har siau preet piaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains the Lord, with love and affection.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har bin kin sukh paiaa dhekhahu man beechaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord, who has found peace? Reflect upon this in your mind, and see.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪੜਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har paRanaa har bujhanaa har siau rakhahu piaar ||
verses.translation: Read about the Lord, understand the Lord, and enshrine love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: har japeeaai har dhiaaieeaai har kaa naam adhaar ||51||
verses.translation: Chant the Lord's Name, and meditate on the Lord; hold tight to the Support of the Name of the Lord. ||51||

verses.original: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: lekh na miTiee he sakhee jo likhiaa karataar ||
verses.translation: The inscription inscribed by the Creator Lord cannot be erased, O my companions.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aape kaaran jin keeaa kar kirapaa pag dhaar ||
verses.translation: He who created the universe, in His Mercy, installs His Feet within us.

verses.original: ਕਰਤੇ ਹਥਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: karate hath vaddiaaieeaa boojhahu gur beechaar ||
verses.translation: Glorious greatness rests in the Hands of the Creator; reflect upon the Guru, and understand this.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaa fer na sakeeaai jiau bhaavee tiau saar ||
verses.translation: This inscription cannot be challenged. As it pleases You, You care for me.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar teree sukh paiaa naanak sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: By Your Glance of Grace, I have found peace; O Nanak, reflect upon the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoole pach mue ubare gur beechaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are confused; they rot away and die. Only by reflecting upon the Guru can they be saved.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: j purakh nadhar na aaviee tis kaa kiaa kar kahiaa jai ||
verses.translation: What can anyone say, about that Primal Lord, who cannot be seen?

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: balihaaree gur aapane jin hiradhai dhitaa dhikhai ||52||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has revealed Him to me, within my own heart. ||52||

verses.original: ਪਾਧਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਰੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paadhaa paRiaa aakheeaai bidhiaa bicharai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: That Pandit, that religious scholar, is said to be well-educated, if he contemplates knowledge with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸੋਧੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bidhiaa sodhai tat lahai raam naam liv lai ||
verses.translation: Considering his knowledge, he finds the essence of reality, and lovingly focuses his attention on the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਕ੍ਰਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bidhiaa bikaradhaa bikh khaTe bikh khai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh sells his knowledge; he earns poison, and eats poison.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਈ ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨਹ ਕਾਇ ॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: moorakh sabadh na cheeniee soojh boojh neh kai ||53||
verses.translation: The fool does not think of the Word of the Shabad. He has no understanding, no comprehension. ||53||

verses.original: ਪਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: paadhaa gurmukh aakheeaai chaaTaRiaa mat dhei ||
verses.translation: That Pandit is called Gurmukh, who imparts understanding to his students.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਰਹੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam samaalahu naam sa(n)garahu laahaa jag meh lei ||
verses.translation: Contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord; gather in the Naam, and earn the true profit in this world.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਪਟੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਪੜੀਐ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachee paTee sach man paReeaai sabadhu su saar ||
verses.translation: With the true notebook of the true mind, study the most sublime Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੫੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak so paRiaa so pa(n)ddit beenaa jis raam naam gal haar ||54||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is learned, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name. ||54||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਸਿਧ ਗੋਸਟਿ
verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa sidh gosaT
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla, Sidh Gosht ~ Conversations With The Siddhas:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਭਾ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sidh sabhaa kar aasan baiThe sa(n)t sabhaa jaikaaro ||
verses.translation: The Siddhas formed an assembly; sitting in their Yogic postures, they shouted, ""Salute this gathering of Saints.""

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: tis aagai raharaas hamaaree saachaa apar apaaro ||
verses.translation: I offer my salutation to the One who is true, infinite and incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਧਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: masatak kaaT dharee tis aagai tan man aagai dheau ||
verses.translation: I cut off my head, and offer it to Him; I dedicate my body and mind to Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t milai sach paieeaai sahaj bhai jas leau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the Saints, Truth is obtained, and one is spontaneously blessed with distinction. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਭਵੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa bhaveeaai sach soochaa hoi ||
verses.translation: What is the use of wandering around? Purity comes only through Truth.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh bin mukat na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one finds liberation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਤੁਮੇ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁਆਓ ॥
verses.translit: kavan tume kiaa naau tumaaraa kaun maarag kaun suaao ||
verses.translation: "Who are you? What is your name? What is your way? What is your goal?

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਉ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਓ ॥
verses.translit: saach kahau aradhaas hamaaree hau sa(n)t janaa bal jaao ||
verses.translation: We pray that you will answer us truthfully; we are a sacrifice to the humble Saints.

verses.original: ਕਹ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹ ਰਹੀਐ ਬਾਲੇ ਕਹ ਆਵਹੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਹੋ ॥
verses.translit: keh baisahu keh raheeaai baale keh aavahu keh jaaho ||
verses.translation: Where is your seat? Where do you live, boy? Where did you come from, and where are you going?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਹੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bolai sun bairaagee kiaa tumaaraa raaho ||2||
verses.translation: Tell us, Nanak - the detached Siddhas wait to hear your reply. What is your path?""||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT bais nira(n)tar raheeaai chaaleh satigur bhaae ||
verses.translation: He dwells deep within the nucleus of each and every heart. This is my seat and my home. I walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਆਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje aae hukam sidhaae naanak sadhaa rajaae ||
verses.translation: I came from the Celestial Lord God; I go wherever He orders me to go. I am Nanak, forever under the Command of His Will.

verses.original: ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aasan baisan thir naarain aaisee gurmat paae ||
verses.translation: I sit in the posture of the eternal, imperishable Lord. These are the Teachings I have received from the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gurmukh boojhai aap pachhaanai sache sach samaae ||3||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have come to understand and realize myself; I merge in the Truest of the True. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa saagar dhutar kaheeaai kiau kar paieeaai paaro ||
verses.translation: "The world-ocean is treacherous and impassable; how can one cross over?

verses.original: ਚਰਪਟੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: charapaT bolai aaudhoo naanak dheh sachaa beechaaro ||
verses.translation: Charpat the Yogi says, O Nanak, think it over, and give us your true reply.""

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਮਝੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
