verses.translit: aape aakhai aape samajhai tis kiaa utar dheejai ||
verses.translation: What answer can I give to someone, who claims to understand himself?

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਤੁਝੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saach kahahu tum paaragaraamee tujh kiaa baisan dheejai ||4||
verses.translation: I speak the Truth; if you have already crossed over, how can I argue with you? ||4||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਨੈ ਸਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaise jal meh kamal niraalam muragaiee nai saane ||
verses.translation: The lotus flower floats untouched upon the surface of the water, and the duck swims through the stream;

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: surat sabadh bhav saagar tareeaai naanak naam vakhaane ||
verses.translation: with one's consciousness focused on the Word of the Shabad, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. O Nanak, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਹਹਿ ਇਕਾਂਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: raheh ikaa(n)t eko man vasiaa aasaa maeh niraaso ||
verses.translation: One who lives alone, as a hermit, enshrining the One Lord in his mind, remaining unaffected by hope in the midst of hope,

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: agam agochar dhekh dhikhaae naanak taa kaa dhaaso ||5||
verses.translation: sees and inspires others to see the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord. Nanak is his slave. ||5||

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪੂਛਉ ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: sun suaamee aradhaas hamaaree poochhau saach beechaaro ||
verses.translation: "Listen, Lord, to our prayer. We seek your true opinion.

verses.original: ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: ros na keejai utar dheejai kiau paieeaai gur dhuaaro ||
verses.translation: Don't be angry with us - please tell us: How can we find the Guru's Door?""

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚਲਤਉ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: eih man chalatau sach ghar baisai naanak naam adhaaro ||
verses.translation: This fickle mind sits in its true home, O Nanak, through the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaae karataa laagai saach piaaro ||6||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself unites us in Union, and inspires us to love the Truth. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਰਹਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ਰੂਖਿ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: haaTee baaTee raheh niraale rookh birakh udhiaane ||
verses.translation: "Away from stores and highways, we live in the woods, among plants and trees.

verses.original: ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਅਹਾਰੋ ਖਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਬੋਲੈ ਗਿਆਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)dh mool ahaaro khaieeaai aaudhoo bolai giaane ||
verses.translation: For food, we take fruits and roots. This is the spiritual wisdom spoken by the renunciates.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: teerath naieeaai sukh fal paieeaai mail na laagai kaiee ||
verses.translation: We bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and obtain the fruits of peace; not even an iota of filth sticks to us.

verses.original: ਗੋਰਖ ਪੂਤੁ ਲੋਹਾਰੀਪਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gorakh poot lohaareepaa bolai jog jugat bidh saiee ||7||
verses.translation: Luhaareepaa, the disciple of Gorakh says, this is the Way of Yoga.""||7||

verses.original: ਹਾਟੀ ਬਾਟੀ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਡੋੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: haaTee baaTee needh na aavai par ghar chit na dduolaiee ||
verses.translation: In the stores and on the road, do not sleep; do not let your consciousness covet anyone else's home.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਟਿਕਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai man Tek na Tikiee naanak bhookh na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the mind has no firm support; O Nanak, this hunger never departs.

verses.original: ਹਾਟੁ ਪਟਣੁ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: haaT paTan ghar guroo dhikhaiaa sahaje sach vaapaaro ||
verses.translation: The Guru has revealed the stores and the city within the home of my own heart, where I intuitively carry on the true trade.

verses.original: ਖੰਡਿਤ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਅਲਪ ਅਹਾਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: kha(n)ddit nidhraa alap ahaara(n) naanak tat beechaaro ||8||
verses.translation: Sleep little, and eat little; O Nanak, this is the essence of wisdom. ||8||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੋਗਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan bhekh karahu jogi(n)dhraa mu(n)dhraa jholee khi(n)thaa ||
verses.translation: "Wear the robes of the sect of Yogis who follow Gorakh; put on the ear-rings, begging wallet and patched coat.

verses.original: ਬਾਰਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਇਕ ਪੰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: baareh a(n)tar ek sarevahu khaT dharasan ik pa(n)thaa ||
verses.translation: Among the twelve schools of Yoga, ours is the highest; among the six schools of philosophy, ours is the best path.

verses.original: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: ein bidh man samajhaieeaai purakhaa baahuR choT na khaieeaai ||
verses.translation: This is the way to instruct the mind, so you will never suffer beatings again.""

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak bolai gurmukh boojhai jog jugat iv paieeaai ||9||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks: the Gurmukh understands; this is the way that Yoga is attained. ||9||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sabadh nira(n)tar mudhraa haumai mamataa dhoor karee ||
verses.translation: Let constant absorption in the Word of the Shabad deep within be your ear-rings; eradicate egotism and attachment.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਸਮਝ ਪਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh aha(n)kaar nivaarai gur kai sabadh su samajh paree ||
verses.translation: Discard sexual desire, anger and egotism, and through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, attain true understanding.

verses.original: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: khi(n)thaa jholee bharipur rahiaa naanak taarai ek haree ||
verses.translation: For your patched coat and begging bowl, see the Lord God pervading and permeating everywhere; O Nanak, the One Lord will carry you across.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ਪਰਖੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਖਰੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib saachee naiee parakhai gur kee baat kharee ||10||
verses.translation: True is our Lord and Master, and True is His Name. Analyze it, and you shall find the Word of the Guru to be True. ||10||

verses.original: ਊਂਧਉ ਖਪਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਟੋਪੀ ॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)dhau khapar pa(n)ch bhoo Topee ||
verses.translation: Let your mind turn away in detachment from the world, and let this be your begging bowl. Let the lessons of the five elements be your cap.

verses.original: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੜਾਸਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੋਟੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)iaa kaRaasan man jaagoTee ||
verses.translation: Let the body be your meditation mat, and the mind your loin cloth.

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh sa(n)jam hai naal ||
verses.translation: Let truth, contentment and self-discipline be your companions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam samaal ||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh dwells on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||11||

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavanu su gupataa kavanu su mukataa ||
verses.translation: "Who is hidden? Who is liberated?

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavanu su a(n)tar baahar jugataa ||
verses.translation: Who is united, inwardly and outwardly?

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kavanu su aavai kavanu su jai ||
verses.translation: Who comes, and who goes?

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kavanu su tirabhavan rahiaa samai ||12||
verses.translation: Who is permeating and pervading the three worlds?""||12||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT gupataa gurmukh mukataa ||
verses.translation: He is hidden within each and every heart. The Gurmukh is liberated.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sabadh su jugataa ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, one is united, inwardly and outwardly.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh binasai aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh perishes, and comes and goes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh saach samai ||13||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||13||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar baadhaa sarapan khaadhaa ||
verses.translation: "How is one placed in bondage, and consumed by the serpent of Maya?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar khoiaa kiau kar laadhaa ||
verses.translation: How does one lose, and how does one gain?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar niramal kiau kar a(n)dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: How does one become immaculate and pure? How is the darkness of ignorance removed?

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: eih tat beechaarai su guroo hamaaraa ||14||
verses.translation: One who understands this essence of reality is our Guru.""||14||

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat baadhaa sarapan khaadhaa ||
verses.translation: Man is bound by evil-mindedness, and consumed by Maya, the serpent.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh khoiaa gurmukh laadhaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh loses, and the Gurmukh gains.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai a(n)dheraa jai ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak haumai meT samai ||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, eradicating egotism, one merges in the Lord. ||15||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n nira(n)tar dheejai ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Focused deep within, in perfect absorption,

verses.original: ਉਡੈ ਨ ਹੰਸਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: auddai na ha(n)saa paRai na ka(n)dh ||
verses.translation: the soul-swan does not fly away, and the body-wall does not collapse.

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਫਾ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj gufaa ghar jaanai saachaa ||
verses.translation: Then, one knows that his true home is in the cave of intuitive poise.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: naanak saache bhaavai saachaa ||16||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord loves those who are truthful. ||16||

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿਓ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kis kaaran girahu tajio udhaasee ||
verses.translation: "Why have you left your house and become a wandering Udaasee?

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਇਹੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kis kaaran ih bhekh nivaasee ||
verses.translation: Why have you adopted these religious robes?

verses.original: ਕਿਸੁ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kis vakhar ke tum vanajaare ||
verses.translation: What merchandise do you trade?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੁ ਲੰਘਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: kiau kar saath la(n)ghaavahu paare ||17||
verses.translation: How will you carry others across with you?""||17||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh khojat bhe udhaasee ||
verses.translation: I became a wandering Udaasee, searching for the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੇਖ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan kai taiee bhekh nivaasee ||
verses.translation: I have adopted these robes seeking the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਵਖਰ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saach vakhar ke ham vanajaare ||
verses.translation: I trade in the merchandise of Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh utaras paare ||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, I carry others across. ||18||

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kit bidh purakhaa janam vaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: "How have you changed the course of your life?

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਝੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe kau tujh ih man laiaa ||
verses.translation: With what have you linked your mind?

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kit bidh aasaa manasaa khaiee ||
verses.translation: How have you subdued your hopes and desires?

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kit bidh jot nira(n)tar paiee ||
verses.translation: How have you found the Light deep within your nucleus?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਦੰਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin dha(n)taa kiau khaieeaai saar ||
verses.translation: Without teeth, how can you eat iron?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak saachaa karahu beechaar ||19||
verses.translation: Give us your true opinion, Nanak.""||19||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੇ ਗਵਨੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai janame gavan miTaiaa ||
verses.translation: Born into the House of the True Guru, my wandering in reincarnation ended.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: anahat raate ih man laiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is attached and attuned to the unstruck sound current.

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਆਸਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa aasaa sabadh jalaiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, my hopes and desires have been burnt away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jot nira(n)tar paiee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I found the Light deep within the nucleus of my self.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੇ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun meTe khaieeaai saar ||
verses.translation: Eradicating the three qualities, one eats iron.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak taare taaranahaar ||20||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates. ||20||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਕਵਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਕਹਾ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: aadh kau kavan beechaar katheeale su(n)n kahaa ghar vaaso ||
verses.translation: "What can you tell us about the beginning? In what home did the absolute dwell then?

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਵਨ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: giaan kee mudhraa kavan katheeale ghaT ghaT kavan nivaaso ||
verses.translation: What are the ear-rings of spiritual wisdom? Who dwells in each and every heart?

verses.original: ਕਾਲ ਕਾ ਠੀਗਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲਾਈਅਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: kaal kaa Theegaa kiau jalaieeale kiau nirabhau ghar jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: How can one avoid the attack of death? How can one enter the home of fearlessness?

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਆਸਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਛੇਦੇ ਬੈਰਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj sa(n)tokh kaa aasan jaanai kiau chhedhe bairaieeaai ||
verses.translation: How can one know the posture of intuition and contentment, and overcome one's adversaries?""

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh haumai bikh maarai taa nij ghar hovai vaaso ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism and corruption are conquered, and then one comes to dwell in the home of the self within.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੋ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: jin rach rachiaa tis sabadh pachhaanai naanak taa kaa dhaaso ||21||
verses.translation: One who realizes the Shabad of the One who created the creation - Nanak is his slave. ||21||

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਵੈ ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਕਹਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa te aavai kahaa ih jaavai kahaa ih rahai samaiee ||
verses.translation: "Where did we come from? Where are we going? Where will we be absorbed?

verses.original: ਏਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: es sabadh kau jo arathaavai tis gur til na tamaiee ||
verses.translation: One who reveals the meaning of this Shabad is the Guru, who has no greed at all.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਤਤੈ ਅਵਿਗਤੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: kiau tatai avigatai paavai gurmukh lagai piaaro ||
verses.translation: How can one find the essence of the unmanifest reality? How does one become Gurmukh, and enshrine love for the Lord?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aape surataa aape karataa kahu naanak beechaaro ||
verses.translation: He Himself is consciousness, He Himself is the Creator; share with us, Nanak, your wisdom.""

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukame aavai hukame jaavai hukame rahai samaiee ||
verses.translation: By His Command we come, and by His Command we go; by His Command, we merge in absorption.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: poore gur te saach kamaavai gat mit sabadhe paiee ||22||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, live the Truth; through the Word of the Shabad, the state of dignity is attained. ||22||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aadh kau bisamaadh beechaar katheeale su(n)n nira(n)tar vaas leeaa ||
verses.translation: We can only express a sense of wonder about the beginning. The absolute abided endlessly deep within Himself then.

verses.original: ਅਕਲਪਤ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਅਲੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: akalapat mudhraa gur giaan beechaareeale ghaT ghaT saachaa sarab jeeaa ||
verses.translation: Consider freedom from desire to be the ear-rings of the Guru's spiritual wisdom. The True Lord, the Soul of all, dwells within each and every heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅਵਿਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee avigat samaieeaai tat nira(n)jan sahaj lahai ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, one merges in the absolute, and intuitively receives the immaculate essence.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੇਵੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhoojee kaar na karanee sevai sikhu su khoj lahai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that Sikh who seeks and finds the Way does not serve any other.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: hukam bisamaadh hukam pachhaanai jeea jugat sach jaanai soiee ||
verses.translation: Wonderful and amazing is His Command; He alone realizes His Command and knows the true way of life of His creatures.

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: aap meT niraalam hovai a(n)tar saach jogee kaheeaai soiee ||23||
verses.translation: One who eradicates his self-conceit becomes free of desire; he alone is a Yogi, who enshrines the True Lord deep within. ||23||

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਉਪਜੇ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਸਰਗੁਣੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: avigato niramail upaje niragun te saragun theeaa ||
verses.translation: From His state of absolute existence, He assumed the immaculate form; from formless, He assumed the supreme form.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਲੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: satigur parachai param padh paieeaai saachai sabadh samai leeaa ||
verses.translation: By pleasing the True Guru, the supreme status is obtained, and one is absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਏਕੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਏਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: eke kau sach ekaa jaanai haumai dhoojaa dhoor keeaa ||
verses.translation: He knows the True Lord as the One and only; he sends his egotism and duality far away.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: so jogee gur sabadh pachhaanai a(n)tar kamal pragaas theeaa ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Yogi, who realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the lotus of the heart blossoms forth within.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat marai taa sabh kichh soojhai a(n)tar jaanai sarab dhiaa ||
verses.translation: If one remains dead while yet alive, then he understands everything; he knows the Lord deep within himself, who is kind and compassionate to all.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kau milai vaddaiee aap pachhaanai sarab jeeaa ||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he is blessed with glorious greatness; he realizes himself in all beings. ||24||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੌ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਏਕ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saachau upajai saach samaavai saache sooche ek miaa ||
verses.translation: We emerge from Truth, and merge into Truth again. The pure being merges into the One True Lord.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਠਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThe aaveh Thavar na paaveh dhoojai aavaa gaun bhiaa ||
verses.translation: The false come, and find no place of rest; in duality, they come and go.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun miTai gur sabadhee aape parakhai bakhas liaa ||
verses.translation: This coming and going in reincarnation is ended through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Lord Himself analyzes and grants His forgiveness.

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa bedhan dhoojai biaapee naam rasain veesariaa ||
verses.translation: One who suffers from the disease of duality, forgets the Naam, the source of nectar.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: so boojhai jis aap bujhaae gur kai sabadh su mukat bhiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is liberated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: naanak taare taaranahaaraa haumai dhoojaa parahariaa ||25||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Emancipator emancipates one who drives out egotism and duality. ||25||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhoolai jam kee kaan ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, under the shadow of death.

verses.original: ਪਰ ਘਰੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਹਾਣੇ ਹਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: par ghar johai haane haan ||
verses.translation: They look into the homes of others, and lose.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਬੇਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bharam bhavai bebaan ||
verses.translation: The manmukhs are confused by doubt, wandering in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਵੇਮਾਰਗਿ ਮੂਸੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਸਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: vemaarag moosai ma(n)tr masaan ||
verses.translation: Having lost their way, they are plundered; they chant their mantras at cremation grounds.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਲਵੈ ਕੁਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh na cheenai lavai kubaan ||
verses.translation: They do not think of the Shabad; instead, they utter obscenities.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: naanak saach rate sukh jaan ||26||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Truth know peace. ||26||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saache kaa bhau paavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh lives in the Fear of God, the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਘੜੁ ਘੜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh baanee aghaR ghaRaavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, the Gurmukh refines the unrefined.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh niramal har gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sings the immaculate, Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh pavitr param padh paavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh attains the supreme, sanctified status.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh rom rom har dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord with every hair of his body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh saach samaavai ||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||27||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh parachai bedh beechaaree ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is pleasing to the True Guru; this is contemplation on the Vedas.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh parachai tareeaai taaree ||
verses.translation: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh is carried across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh parachai su sabadh giaanee ||
verses.translation: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh receives the spiritual wisdom of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh parachai a(n)tar bidh jaanee ||
verses.translation: Pleasing the True Guru, the Gurmukh comes to know the path within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paieeaai alakh apaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh attains the unseen and infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mukat dhuaar ||28||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the door of liberation. ||28||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh akath kathai beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh speaks the unspoken wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਸਪਰਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh nibahai saparavaar ||
verses.translation: In the midst of his family, the Gurmukh lives a spiritual life.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh japeeaai a(n)tar piaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh lovingly meditates deep within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paieeaai sabadh achaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Shabad, and righteous conduct.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh bhedh jaanai jaanaiee ||
verses.translation: He knows the mystery of the Shabad, and inspires others to know it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: naanak haumai jaal samaiee ||29||
verses.translation: O Nanak, burning away his ego, he merges in the Lord. ||29||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dharatee saachai saajee ||
verses.translation: The True Lord fashioned the earth for the sake of the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਮਹਿ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis meh opat khapat su baajee ||
verses.translation: There, he set in motion the play of creation and destruction.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh rapai ra(n)g lai ||
verses.translation: One who is filled with the Word of the Guru's Shabad enshrines love for the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤਉ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saach ratau pat siau ghar jai ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Truth, he goes to his home with honor.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh bin pat nahee paavai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Word of the Shabad, no one receives honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naanak bin naavai kiau saach samaavai ||30||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, how can one be absorbed in Truth? ||30||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਬੁਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh asaT sidhee sabh budhee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the eight miraculous spiritual powers, and all wisdom.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚ ਸੁਧੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhavajal tareeaai sach sudhee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and obtains true understanding.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਰ ਅਪਸਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sar apasar bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows the ways of truth and untruth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paravirat naravirat pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows worldliness and renunciation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh taare paar utaare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh crosses over, and carries others across as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sabadh nisataare ||31||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is emancipated through the Shabad. ||31||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naame raate haumai jai ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, egotism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate sach rahe samai ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they remain absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate jog jugat beechaar ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Way of Yoga.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate paaveh mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they find the door of liberation.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate tirabhavan sojhee hoi ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they understand the three worlds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sadhaa sukh hoi ||32||
verses.translation: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, eternal peace is found. ||32||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate sidh gosaT hoi ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they attain Sidh Gosht - conversation with the Siddhas.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤਪੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate sadhaa tap hoi ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they practice intense meditation forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate sach karanee saar ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they live the true and excellent lifestyle.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate gun giaan beechaar ||
verses.translation: Attuned to the Naam, they contemplate the Lord's virtues and spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai bolai sabh vekaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, all that is spoken is useless.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate tin kau jaikaar ||33||
verses.translation: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, their victory is celebrated. ||33||

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: poore gur te naam paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, one obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jog jugat sach rahai samai ||
verses.translation: The Way of Yoga is to remain absorbed in Truth.

verses.original: ਬਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਭਰਮਾਏ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਛਿਅ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: baareh meh jogee bharamaae sa(n)niaasee chhia chaar ||
verses.translation: The Yogis wander in the twelve schools of Yoga; the Sannyaasis in six and four.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh jo mar jeevai so paae mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: One who remains dead while yet alive, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, finds the door of liberation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai sabh dhoojai laage dhekhahu ridhai beechaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, all are attached to duality. Contemplate this in your heart, and see.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: naanak vadde se vaddabhaagee jinee sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||34||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed and very fortunate are those who keep the True Lord enshrined in their hearts. ||34||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਲਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh ratan lahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel, lovingly focused on the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਖੈ ਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh parakhai ratan subhai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh intuitively recognizes the value of this jewel.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saachee kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh practices Truth in action.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saache man pateeaai ||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh alakh lakhaae tis bhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sees the unseen, when it pleases the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh choT na khaavai ||35||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh does not have to endure punishment. ||35||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dhaan isanaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is blessed with the Name, charity and purification.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh centers his meditation on the celestial Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paavai dharageh maan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bhau bha(n)jan paradhaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Supreme Lord, the Destroyer of fear.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh karanee kaar karaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh does good deeds, and inspires others to do so.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh mel milaae ||36||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh unites in the Lord's Union. ||36||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saasatr simirat bedh ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh understands the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh paavai ghaT ghaT bhedh ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows the secrets of each and every heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vair virodh gavaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh eliminates hate and envy.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਣਤ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sagalee ganat miTaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh erases all accounting.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam ra(n)g raataa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is imbued with love for the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh khasam pachhaataa ||37||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes his Lord and Master. ||37||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur bharamai aavai jai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, one wanders, coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur ghaal na paviee thai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, one's work is useless.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur manooaa at ddolai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the mind is totally unsteady.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur tirapat nahee bikh khai ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, one is unsatisfied, and eats poison.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਸੀਅਰੁ ਡਸੈ ਮਰਿ ਵਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur biseear ddasai mar vaaT ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, one is stung by the poisonous snake of Maya, and dies.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਾਟੇ ਘਾਟ ॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gur bin ghaaTe ghaaT ||38||
verses.translation: O Nanak without the Guru, all is lost. ||38||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis gur milai tis paar utaarai ||
verses.translation: One who meets the Guru is carried across.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟੈ ਗੁਣਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: avagan meTai gun nisataarai ||
verses.translation: His sins are erased, and he is emancipated through virtue.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mukat mahaa sukh gur sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The supreme peace of liberation is attained, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kadhe na aavai haar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is never defeated.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਹਟੜੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: tan haTaRee ih man vanajaaraa ||
verses.translation: In the store of the body, this mind is the merchant;

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaje sach vaapaaraa ||39||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it deals intuitively in Truth. ||39||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਸੇਤੁ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh baa(n)dhio set bidhaatai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is the bridge, built by the Architect of Destiny.

verses.original: ਲੰਕਾ ਲੂਟੀ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: la(n)kaa looTee dhait sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: The demons of passion which plundered Sri Lanka - the body - have been conquered.

verses.original: ਰਾਮਚੰਦਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਅਹਿ ਰਾਵਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: raamacha(n)dh maario eh raavan ||
verses.translation: Ram Chand - the mind - has slaughtered Raawan - pride;

verses.original: ਭੇਦੁ ਬਭੀਖਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚਾਇਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhedh babheekhan gurmukh parachain ||
verses.translation: the Gurmukh understands the secret revealed by Babheekhan.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਇਰਿ ਪਾਹਣ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sair paahan taare ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh carries even stones across the ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: gurmukh koT tetees udhaare ||40||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh saves millions of people. ||40||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh chookai aavan jaan ||
verses.translation: The comings and goings in reincarnation are ended for the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dharageh paavai maan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਟੇ ਖਰੇ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh khoTe khare pachhaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh distinguishes the true from the false.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dharageh sifat samai ||
verses.translation: In the Court of the Lord, the Gurmukh is absorbed in His Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh ba(n)dh na pai ||41||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is not bound by bonds. ||41||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam nira(n)jan paae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh haumai sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Gurmukh burns away his ego.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saache ke gun gaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saachai rahai samaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh remains absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saach naam pat uootam hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the True Name, the Gurmukh is honored and exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sagal bhavan kee sojhee hoi ||42||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands all the worlds. ||42||

verses.original: ਕਵਣ ਮੂਲੁ ਕਵਣ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: kavan mool kavan mat velaa ||
verses.translation: "What is the root, the source of all? What teachings hold for these times?

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤੂ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa kavan guroo jis kaa too chelaa ||
verses.translation: Who is your guru? Whose disciple are you?

verses.original: ਕਵਣ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਰਹਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kathaa le rahahu niraale ||
verses.translation: What is that speech, by which you remain unattached?

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: bolai naanak sunahu tum baale ||
verses.translation: Listen to what we say, O Nanak, you little boy.

verses.original: ਏਸੁ ਕਥਾ ਕਾ ਦੇਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: es kathaa kaa dhei beechaar ||
verses.translation: Give us your opinion on what we have said.

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: bhavajal sabadh la(n)ghaavanahaar ||43||
verses.translation: How can the Shabad carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?""||43||

verses.original: ਪਵਨ ਅਰੰਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: pavan ara(n)bh satigur mat velaa ||
verses.translation: From the air came the beginning. This is the age of the True Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਚੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh guroo surat dhun chelaa ||
verses.translation: The Shabad is the Guru, upon whom I lovingly focus my consciousness; I am the chaylaa, the disciple.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਰਹਉ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa le rahau niraalaa ||
verses.translation: Speaking the Unspoken Speech, I remain unattached.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jug jug gur gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, throughout the ages, the Lord of the World is my Guru.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ek sabadh jit kathaa veechaaree ||
verses.translation: I contemplate the sermon of the Shabad, the Word of the One God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh haumai agan nivaaree ||44||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh puts out the fire of egotism. ||44||

verses.original: ਮੈਣ ਕੇ ਦੰਤ ਕਿਉ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: main ke dha(n)t kiau khaieeaai saar ||
verses.translation: "With teeth of wax, how can one chew iron?

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਜਾਇ ਸੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਆਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jit garab jai su kavan aahaar ||
verses.translation: What is that food, which takes away pride?

verses.original: ਹਿਵੈ ਕਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਿਰਾਹਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: hivai kaa ghar ma(n)dhar agan piraahan ||
verses.translation: How can one live in the palace, the home of snow, wearing robes of fire?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਅਵਾਹਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kavan gufaa jit rahai avaahan ||
verses.translation: Where is that cave, within which one may remain unshaken?

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eit ut kis kau jaan samaavai ||
verses.translation: Who should we know to be pervading here and there?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪੫॥
verses.translit: kavan dhiaan man maneh samaavai ||45||
verses.translation: What is that meditation, which leads the mind to be absorbed in itself?""||45||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਮੈ ਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hau hau mai mai vichahu khovai ||
verses.translation: Eradicating egotism and individualism from within,

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਮੇਟੈ ਏਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa meTai eko hovai ||
verses.translation: and erasing duality, the mortal becomes one with God.

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਕਰੜਾ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jag karaRaa manmukh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: The world is difficult for the foolish, self-willed manmukh;

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਖਾਈਐ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh kamaieeaai khaieeaai saar ||
verses.translation: practicing the Shabad, one chews iron.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar eko jaanai ||
verses.translation: Know the One Lord, inside and out.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: naanak agan marai satigur kai bhaanai ||46||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the fire is quenched, through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will. ||46||

verses.original: ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach bhai raataa garab nivaarai ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the True Fear of God, pride is taken away;

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: eko jaataa sabadh veechaarai ||
verses.translation: realize that He is One, and contemplate the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh vasai sach a(n)tar heeaa ||
verses.translation: With the True Shabad abiding deep within the heart,

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal ra(n)g ra(n)geeaa ||
verses.translation: the body and mind are cooled and soothed, and colored with the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh bikh agan nivaare ||
verses.translation: The fire of sexual desire, anger and corruption is quenched.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee nadhar piaare ||47||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Beloved bestows His Glance of Grace. ||47||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kavan mukh cha(n)dh hivai ghar chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: "The moon of the mind is cool and dark; how is it enlightened?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਤਪੈ ਤਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kavan mukh sooraj tapai tapaiaa ||
verses.translation: How does the sun blaze so brilliantly?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan mukh kaal johat nit rahai ||
verses.translation: How can the constant watchful gaze of Death be turned away?

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan budh gurmukh pat rahai ||
verses.translation: By what understanding is the honor of the Gurmukh preserved?

verses.original: ਕਵਨੁ ਜੋਧੁ ਜੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan jodh jo kaal sa(n)ghaarai ||
verses.translation: Who is the warrior, who conquers Death?

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: bolai baanee naanak beechaarai ||48||
verses.translation: Give us your thoughtful reply, O Nanak.""||48||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਭਾਖਤ ਸਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh bhaakhat sas jot apaaraa ||
verses.translation: Giving voice to the Shabad, the moon of the mind is illuminated with infinity.

verses.original: ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sas ghar soor vasai miTai a(n)dhiaaraa ||
verses.translation: When the sun dwells in the house of the moon, the darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh sam kar naam adhaaraa ||
verses.translation: Pleasure and pain are just the same, when one takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape paar utaaranahaaraa ||
verses.translation: He Himself saves, and carries us across.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parachai man saach samai ||
verses.translation: With faith in the Guru, the mind merges in Truth,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak kaal na khai ||49||
verses.translation: and then, prays Nanak, one is not consumed by Death. ||49||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਤਤੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam tat sabh hee sir jaapai ||
verses.translation: The essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is known to be the most exalted and excellent of all.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai dhukh kaal sa(n)taapai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, one is afflicted by pain and death.

verses.original: ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: tato tat milai man maanai ||
verses.translation: When one's essence merges into the essence, the mind is satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਇ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa jai ikat ghar aanai ||
verses.translation: Duality is gone, and one enters into the home of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਪਵਨਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਗਰਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bolai pavanaa gagan garajai ||
verses.translation: The breath blows across the sky of the Tenth Gate and vibrates.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸਹਜੈ ॥੫੦॥
verses.translit: naanak nihachal milan sahajai ||50||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the mortal then intuitively meets the eternal, unchanging Lord. ||50||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੁੰਨੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੁੰਨ ਮਸੁੰਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar su(n)na(n) baahar su(n)na(n) tirabhavan su(n)n masu(n)na(n) ||
verses.translation: The absolute Lord is deep within; the absolute Lord is outside us as well. The absolute Lord totally fills the three worlds.

verses.original: ਚਉਥੇ ਸੁੰਨੈ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪਾਪੁ ਨ ਪੁੰਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: chauthe su(n)nai jo nar jaanai taa kau paap na pu(n)na(n) ||
verses.translation: One who knows the Lord in the fourth state, is not subject to virtue or vice.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT su(n)n kaa jaanai bheau || aadh purakh nira(n)jan dheau ||
verses.translation: One who knows the mystery of God the Absolute, who pervades each and every heart, knows the Primal Being, the Immaculate Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo jan naam nira(n)jan raataa ||
verses.translation: That humble being who is imbued with the Immaculate Naam,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੫੧॥
verses.translit: naanak soiee purakh bidhaataa ||51||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is himself the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||51||

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨੋ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)no su(n)n kahai sabh koiee ||
verses.translation: "Everyone speaks of the Absolute Lord, the unmanifest void.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: anahat su(n)n kahaa te hoiee ||
verses.translation: How can one find this absolute void?

verses.original: ਅਨਹਤ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: anahat su(n)n rate se kaise ||
verses.translation: Who are they, who are attuned to this absolute void?""

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: jis te upaje tis hee jaise ||
verses.translation: They are like the Lord, from whom they originated.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi janam na mareh na aaveh jaeh ||
verses.translation: They are not born, they do not die; they do not come and go.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਹਿ ॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh man samajhaeh ||52||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs instruct their minds. ||52||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਦਸਵੈ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: nau sar subhar dhasavai poore ||
verses.translation: By practicing control over the nine gates, one attains perfect control over the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਸੁੰਨ ਵਜਾਵਹਿ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: teh anahat su(n)n vajaaveh toore ||
verses.translation: There, the unstruck sound current of the absolute Lord vibrates and resounds.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਚੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: saachai raache dhekh hajoore ||
verses.translation: Behold the True Lord ever-present, and merge with Him.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT saach rahiaa bharapoore ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਪਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gupatee baanee paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: The hidden Bani of the Word is revealed.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਏ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: naanak parakh le sach soi ||53||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is revealed and known. ||53||

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj bhai mileeaai sukh hovai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord through intuition and love, peace is found.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jaagai needh na sovai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh remains awake and aware; he does not fall sleep.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)n sabadh apara(n)par dhaarai ||
verses.translation: He enshrines the unlimited, absolute Shabad deep within.

verses.original: ਕਹਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahate mukat sabadh nisataarai ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Shabad, he is liberated, and saves others as well.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee dheekhiaa se sach raate ||
verses.translation: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings are attuned to the Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਣ ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੇ ॥੫੪॥
verses.translit: naanak aap gavai milan nahee bhraate ||54||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who eradicate their self-conceit meet with the Lord; they do not remain separated by doubt. ||54||

verses.original: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਚਵਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kubudh chavaavai so kit Thai ||
verses.translation: "Where is that place, where evil thoughts are destroyed?

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau tat na boojhai choTaa khai ||
verses.translation: The mortal does not understand the essence of reality; why must he suffer in pain?""

verses.original: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jam dhar baadhe koi na raakhai ||
verses.translation: No one can save one who is tied up at Death's door.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai naahee pat saakhai ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one has any credit or honor.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar boojhai paavai paar ||
verses.translation: "How can one obtain understanding and cross over?"

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੫੫॥
verses.translit: naanak manmukh na bujhai gavaar ||55||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand. ||55||

verses.original: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kubudh miTai gur sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: Evil thoughts are erased, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTai mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the door of liberation is found.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tat na cheenai manmukh jal jai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not understand the essence of reality, and is burnt to ashes.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhuramat vichhuR choTaa khai ||
verses.translation: His evil-mindedness separates him from the Lord, and he suffers.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: maanai hukam sabhe gun giaan ||
verses.translation: Accepting the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he is blessed with all virtues and spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: naanak dharageh paavai maan ||56||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||56||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saach vakhar dhan palai hoi ||
verses.translation: One who possesses the merchandise, the wealth of the True Name,

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੇ ਭੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap tarai taare bhee soi ||
verses.translation: crosses over, and carries others across with him as well.

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj rataa boojhai pat hoi ||
verses.translation: One who intuitively understands, and is attuned to the Lord, is honored.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat karai na koi ||
verses.translation: No one can estimate his worth.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa teh rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥੫੭॥
verses.translit: naanak paar parai sach bhai ||57||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Love of the True Lord, one crosses over. ||57||

verses.original: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: s sabadh kaa kahaa vaas katheeale jit tareeaai bhavajal sa(n)saaro ||
verses.translation: "Where is the Shabad said to dwell? What will carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: trai sat a(n)gul vaiee kaheeaai tis kahu kavan adhaaro ||
verses.translation: The breath, when exhaled, extends out ten finger lengths; what is the support of the breath?

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: bolai khelai asathir hovai kiau kar alakh lakhaae ||
verses.translation: Speaking and playing, how can one be stable and steady? How can the unseen be seen?""

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sun suaamee sach naanak pranavai apane man samajhaae ||
verses.translation: Listen, O master; Nanak prays truly. Instruct your own mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadhe sach liv laagai kar nadharee mel milaae ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the True Shabad. Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He unites us in His Union.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫੮॥
verses.translit: aape dhaanaa aape beenaa poorai bhaag samaae ||58||
verses.translation: He Himself is all-knowing and all-seeing. By perfect destiny, we merge in Him. ||58||

verses.original: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਲਖੰ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: s sabadh kau nira(n)tar vaas alakha(n) jeh dhekhaa teh soiee ||
verses.translation: That Shabad dwells deep within the nucleus of all beings. God is invisible; wherever I look, there I see Him.

verses.original: ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: pavan kaa vaasaa su(n)n nivaasaa akal kalaa dhar soiee ||
verses.translation: The air is the dwelling place of the absolute Lord. He has no qualities; He has all qualities.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare sabadh ghaT meh vasai vichahu bharam gavaae ||
verses.translation: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, the Shabad comes to abide within the heart, and doubt is eradicated from within.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tan man niramal niramal baanee naamuo ma(n)n vasaae ||
verses.translation: The body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Word of His Bani. Let His Name be enshrined in your mind.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਭਵਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh guroo bhavasaagar tareeaai it ut eko jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Shabad is the Guru, to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. Know the One Lord alone, here and hereafter.

verses.original: ਚਿਹਨੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੫੯॥
verses.translit: chihan varan nahee chhaiaa maiaa naanak sabadh pachhaanai ||59||
verses.translation: He has no form or color, shadow or illusion; O Nanak, realize the Shabad. ||59||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਅਉਧੂ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਚੁ ਆਹਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: trai sat a(n)gul vaiee aaudhoo su(n)n sach aahaaro ||
verses.translation: O reclusive hermit, the True, Absolute Lord is the support of the exhaled breath, which extends out ten finger lengths.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh bolai tat birolai cheenai alakh apaaro ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh speaks and churns the essence of reality, and realizes the unseen, infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun meTai sabadh vasaae taa man chookai aha(n)kaaro ||
verses.translation: Eradicating the three qualities, he enshrines the Shabad within, and then, his mind is rid of egotism.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar eko jaanai taa har naam lagai piaaro ||
verses.translation: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord alone; he is in love with the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sukhamanaa iRaa pi(n)gulaa boojhai jaa aape alakh lakhaae ||
verses.translation: He understands the Sushmana, Ida and Pingala, when the unseen Lord reveals Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹੁ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬੦॥
verses.translit: naanak tih te uoopar saachaa satigur sabadh samaae ||60||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is above these three energy channels. Through the Word, the Shabad of the True Guru, one merges with Him. ||60||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa jeeau pavan katheeale pavan kahaa ras khaiee ||
verses.translation: "The air is said to be the soul of the mind. But what does the air feed on?

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਅਉਧੂ ਸਿਧ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: giaan kee mudhraa kavan aaudhoo sidh kee kavan kamaiee ||
verses.translation: What is the way of the spiritual teacher, and the reclusive hermit? What is the occupation of the Siddha?""

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਉਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai ras na aavai aaudhoo haumai piaas na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, the essence does not come, O hermit, and the thirst of egotism does not depart.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh rate a(n)mirat ras paiaa saache rahe aghaiee ||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Shabad, one finds the ambrosial essence, and remains fulfilled with the True Name.

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੀਐ ਕਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan budh jit asathir raheeaai kit bhojan tirapataasai ||
verses.translation: "What is that wisdom, by which one remains steady and stable? What food brings satisfaction?"

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਾਸੈ ॥੬੧॥
verses.translit: naanak dhukh sukh sam kar jaapai satigur te kaal na graasai ||61||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when one looks upon pain and pleasure alike, through the True Guru, then he is not consumed by Death. ||61||

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਨ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g na raataa ras nahee maataa ||
verses.translation: If one is not imbued with the Lord's Love, nor intoxicated with His subtle essence,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਤਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur sabadhai jal bal taataa ||
verses.translation: without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is frustrated, and consumed by his own inner fire.

verses.original: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bi(n)dh na raakhiaa sabadh na bhaakhiaa ||
verses.translation: He does not preserve his semen and seed, and does not chant the Shabad.

verses.original: ਪਵਨੁ ਨ ਸਾਧਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pavan na saadhiaa sach na araadhiaa ||
verses.translation: He does not control his breath; he does not worship and adore the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਲੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa le sam kar rahai ||
verses.translation: But one who speaks the Unspoken Speech, and remains balanced,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮ ਕਉ ਲਹੈ ॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: tau naanak aatam raam kau lahai ||62||
verses.translation: O Nanak, attains the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||62||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ra(n)ge raataa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is attuned to the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਸਾਚੇ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit peeaa saache maataa ||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is intoxicated with the Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur veechaaree agan nivaaree ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Guru, the fire within is put out.

verses.original: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਓ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: apiau peeo aatam sukh dhaaree ||
verses.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, the soul settles in peace.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach araadhiaa gurmukh tar taaree ||
verses.translation: Worshipping the True Lord in adoration, the Gurmukh crosses over the river of life.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੬੩॥
verses.translit: naanak boojhai ko veechaaree ||63||
verses.translation: O Nanak, after deep contemplation, this is understood. ||63||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੀਅਲੇ ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਇਹੁ ਪਵਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: eih man maigal kahaa baseeale kahaa basai ih pavanaa ||
verses.translation: "Where does this mind-elephant live? Where does the breath reside?

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਬਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਵਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa basai su sabadh aaudhoo taa kau chookai man kaa bhavanaa ||
verses.translation: Where should the Shabad reside, so that the wanderings of the mind may cease?""

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare taa satigur mele taa nij ghar vaasaa ih man paae ||
verses.translation: When the Lord blesses one with His Glance of Grace, he leads him to the True Guru. Then, this mind dwells in its own home within.

verses.original: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: aapai aap khai taa niramal hovai dhaavat varaj rahaae ||
verses.translation: When the individual consumes his egotism, he becomes immaculate, and his wandering mind is restrained.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਿਉ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kiau mool pachhaanai aatam jaanai kiau sas ghar soor samaavai ||
verses.translation: "How can the root, the source of all be realized? How can the soul know itself? How can the sun enter into the house of the moon?"

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੬੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh haumai vichahu khovai tau naanak sahaj samaavai ||64||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh eliminates egotism from within; then, O Nanak, the sun naturally enters into the home of the moon. ||64||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੀਅਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man nihachal hiradhai vaseeale gurmukh mool pachhaan rahai ||
verses.translation: When the mind becomes steady and stable, it abides in the heart, and then the Gurmukh realizes the root, the source of all.

verses.original: ਨਾਭਿ ਪਵਨੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: naabh pavan ghar aasan baisai gurmukh khojat tat lahai ||
verses.translation: The breath is seated in the home of the navel; the Gurmukh searches, and finds the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਛੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: s sabadh nira(n)tar nij ghar aachhai tirabhavan jot su sabadh lahai ||
verses.translation: This Shabad permeates the nucleus of the self, deep within, in its own home; the Light of this Shabad pervades the three worlds.

verses.original: ਖਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: khaavai dhookh bhookh saache kee saache hee tirapataas rahai ||
verses.translation: Hunger for the True Lord shall consume your pain, and through the True Lord, you shall be satisfied.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਕੋ ਅਰਥਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh baanee gurmukh jaanee biralo ko arathaavai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows the unstruck sound current of the Bani; how rare are those who understand.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਖੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੬੫॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhai sach subhaakhai sach rapai ra(n)g kabahoo na jaavai ||65||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who speaks the Truth is dyed in the color of Truth, which will never fade away. ||65||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਇਹੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਕੈਠੈ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ih hiradhaa dheh na hotee tau man kaiThai rahataa ||
verses.translation: "When this heart and body did not exist, where did the mind reside?

verses.original: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਵਨ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa pavan kavan ghar sahataa ||
verses.translation: When there was no support of the navel lotus, then in which home did the breath reside?

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: roop na hoto rekh na kaiee taa sabadh kahaa liv laiee ||
verses.translation: When there was no form or shape, then how could anyone lovingly focus on the Shabad?

verses.original: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕੀ ਮੜੀ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: rakat bi(n)dh kee maRee na hotee mit keemat nahee paiee ||
verses.translation: When there was no dungeon formed from egg and sperm, who could measure the Lord's value and extent?

verses.original: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: varan bhekh asaroop na jaapee kiau kar jaapas saachaa ||
verses.translation: When color, dress and form could not be seen, how could the True Lord be known?""

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਇਬ ਤਬ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ॥੬੬॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate bairaagee ib tab saacho saachaa ||66||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are detached. Then and now, they see the Truest of the True. ||66||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦਾ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਅਉਧੂ ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhaa dheh na hotee aaudhoo tau man su(n)n rahai bairaagee ||
verses.translation: When the heart and the body did not exist, O hermit, then the mind resided in the absolute, detached Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਭਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਸਥੰਭੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੋ ਤਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸਤਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: naabh kamal asatha(n)bh na hoto taa nij ghar basatau pavan anaraagee ||
verses.translation: When there was no support of the lotus of the navel, the breath remained in its own home, attuned to the Lord's Love.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਤਉ ਅਕੁਲੀਣਿ ਰਹਤਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: roop na rekhiaa jaat na hotee tau akuleen rahatau sabadhu su saar ||
verses.translation: When there was no form or shape or social class, then the Shabad, in its essence, resided in the unmanifest Lord.

verses.original: ਗਉਨੁ ਗਗਨੁ ਜਬ ਤਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਤਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜੋਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gaun gagan jab tabeh na hotau tirabhavan jot aape nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: When the world and the sky did not even exist, the Light of the Formless Lord filled the three worlds.

verses.original: ਵਰਨੁ ਭੇਖੁ ਅਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: varan bhekh asaroopu su eko eko sabadh viddaanee ||
verses.translation: Color, dress and form were contained in the One Lord; the Shabad was contained in the One, Wondrous Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੂਚਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬੭॥
verses.translit: saach binaa soochaa ko naahee naanak akath kahaanee ||67||
verses.translation: Without the True Name, no one can become pure; O Nanak, this is the Unspoken Speech. ||67||

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kit kit bidh jag upajai purakhaa kit kit dhukh binas jaiee ||
verses.translation: "How, in what way, was the world formed, O man? And what disaster will end it?"

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: haumai vich jag upajai purakhaa naam visariaai dhukh paiee ||
verses.translation: In egotism, the world was formed, O man; forgetting the Naam, it suffers and dies.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hovai su giaan tat beechaarai haumai sabadh jalaae ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the essence of spiritual wisdom; through the Shabad, he burns away his egotism.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tan man niramal niramal baanee saachai rahai samaae ||
verses.translation: His body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Bani of the Word. He remains absorbed in Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: naame naam rahai bairaagee saach rakhiaa ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he remains detached; he enshrines the True Name in his heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੬੮॥
verses.translit: naanak bin naavai jog kadhe na hovai dhekhahu ridhai beechaare ||68||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, Yoga is never attained; reflect upon this in your heart, and see. ||68||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saach sabadh beechaarai koi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is one who reflects upon the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sach baanee paragaT hoi ||
verses.translation: The True Bani is revealed to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man bheejai viralaa boojhai koi ||
verses.translation: The mind of the Gurmukh is drenched with the Lord's Love, but how rare are those who understand this.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh dwells in the home of the self, deep within.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jogee jugat pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes the Way of Yoga.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੬੯॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naanak eko jaanai ||69||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh knows the One Lord alone. ||69||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve jog na hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, Yoga is not attained;

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe mukat na koiee ||
verses.translation: without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe naam paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, the Naam cannot be found.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe mahaa dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, one suffers in terrible pain.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur bheTe mahaa garab gubaar ||
verses.translation: Without meeting the True Guru, there is only the deep darkness of egotistical pride.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੭੦॥
verses.translit: naanak bin gur muaa janam haar ||70||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Guru, one dies, having lost the opportunity of this life. ||70||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh man jeetaa haumai maar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh conquers his mind by subduing his ego.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh enshrines Truth in his heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਾ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jag jeetaa jamakaal maar bidhaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh conquers the world; he knocks down the Messenger of Death, and kills it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dharageh na aavai haar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh does not lose in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mel milaae suo jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is united in God's Union; he alone knows.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੭੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sabadh pachhaanai ||71||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad. ||71||

verses.original: ਸਬਦੈ ਕਾ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂ ਅਉਧੂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhai kaa nibeRaa sun too aaudhoo bin naavai jog na hoiee ||
verses.translation: This is the essence of the Shabad - listen, you hermits and Yogis. Without the Name, there is no Yoga.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਮਾਤੇ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: naame raate anadhin maate naamai te sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Name, remain intoxicated night and day; through the Name, they find peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naamai hee te sabh paragaT hovai naame sojhee paiee ||
verses.translation: Through the Name, everything is revealed; through the Name, understanding is obtained.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai bhekh kareh bahutere sachai aap khuaaiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, people wear all sorts of religious robes; the True Lord Himself has confused them.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਧੂ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te naam paieeaai aaudhoo jog jugat taa hoiee ||
verses.translation: The Name is obtained only from the True Guru, O hermit, and then, the Way of Yoga is found.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੭੨॥
verses.translit: kar beechaar man dhekhahu naanak bin naavai mukat na hoiee ||72||
verses.translation: Reflect upon this in your mind, and see; O Nanak, without the Name, there is no liberation. ||72||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: teree gat mit toohai jaaneh kiaa ko aakh vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your state and extent, Lord; What can anyone say about it?

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: too aape gupataa aape paragaT aape sabh ra(n)g maanai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are hidden, and You Yourself are revealed. You Yourself enjoy all pleasures.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhik sidh guroo bahu chele khojat fireh furamaanai ||
verses.translation: The seekers, the Siddhas, the many gurus and disciples wander around searching for You, according to Your Will.

verses.original: ਮਾਗਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਇਹ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: maageh naam pai ieh bhikhiaa tere dharasan kau kurabaanai ||
verses.translation: They beg for Your Name, and You bless them with this charity. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: abinaasee prabh khel rachaiaa gurmukh sojhee hoiee ||
verses.translation: The eternal imperishable Lord God has staged this play; the Gurmukh understands it.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭਿ ਜੁਗ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh jug aape varatai dhoojaa avar na koiee ||73||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He extends Himself throughout the ages; there is no other than Him. ||73||1||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Third Mehla,

verses.original: ਜੋਧੈ ਵੀਰੈ ਪੂਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jodhai veerai poorabaanee kee dhunee ||
verses.translation: To Be Sung To The Tune Of 'Jodha And Veera Poorbaanee':

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਦਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sahajai dhaa khet hai jis no laae bhaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the field of intuitive wisdom. One who is inspired to love Him,
