verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਉ ਉਗਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naau beeje naau ugavai naame rahai samai ||
verses.translation: plants the seed of the Name there. The Name sprouts up, and he remains absorbed in the Name.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਏਹੋ ਬੀਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai eho beej hai sahasaa giaa vilai ||
verses.translation: But this egotism is the seed of skepticism; it has been uprooted.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਨ ਉਗਵੈ ਜੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa kichh beeje na ugavai jo bakhase so khai ||
verses.translation: It is not planted there, and it does not sprout; whatever God grants us, we eat.

verses.original: ਅੰਭੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਅੰਭੁ ਰਲਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)bhai setee a(n)bh raliaa bahuR na nikasiaa jai ||
verses.translation: When water mixes with water, it cannot be separated again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh chalat hai vekhahu lokaa aai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is wonderful; come, poeple, and see!

verses.original: ਲੋਕੁ ਕਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: lok k vekhai bapuRaa jis no sojhee naeh ||
verses.translation: But what can the poor people see? They do not understand.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ ਸੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis vekhaale so vekhai jis vasiaa man maeh ||1||
verses.translation: He alone sees, whom the Lord causes to see; the Lord comes to dwell in his mind. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਬੀਜੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhukh kaa khet hai dhukh beeje dhukh khai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is the field of sorrow and suffering. He plains sorrow, and eats sorrow.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh vich ja(n)mai dhukh marai haumai karat vihai ||
verses.translation: In sorrow he is born, and in sorrow he dies. Acting in egotism, his life passes away.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan na sujhiee a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamai ||
verses.translation: He does not understand the coming and going of reincarnation; the blind man acts in blindness.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦਿਤੇ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhevai tisai na jaaniee dhite kau lapaTai ||
verses.translation: He does not know the One who gives, but he is attached to what is given.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he acts according to his pre-ordained destiny. He cannot do anything else. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai sadhaa sukh jis no aape mele soi ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, everlasting peace is obtained. He Himself leads us to meet Him.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੈ ਏਹੁ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukhai eh bibek hai a(n)tar niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: This is the true meaning of peace, that one becomes immaculate within oneself.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan kaa bhram kaTeeaai giaan paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: The doubt of ignorance is eradicated, and spiritual wisdom is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak eko nadharee aaiaa jeh dhekhaa teh soi ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak comes to gaze upon the One Lord alone; wherever he looks, there He is. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachai takhat rachaiaa baisan kau jaa(n)iee ||
verses.translation: The True Lord created His throne, upon which He sits.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap hai gur sabadh sunaiee ||
verses.translation: He Himself is everything; this is what the Word of the Guru's Shabad says.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape kudharat saajeean kar mahal saraiee ||
verses.translation: Through His almighty creative power, He created and fashioned the mansions and hotels.

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਚਾਨਣੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui chaanane pooree banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: He made the two lamps, the sun and the moon; He formed the perfect form.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape vekhai sune aap gur sabadh dhiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਤੂ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu sache paatisaeh too sachee naiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail, O True King! True is Your Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ਆਪੁ ਪੀਸਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer mahidhee kar kai ghaaliaa aap peesai peesai ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, I have ground myself into henna paste.

verses.original: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੀਆ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਲਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tai seh baat na puchheeaa kabahoo na laiee pai ||1||
verses.translation: O my Husband Lord, You took no notice of me; You never applied me to Your feet. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak mahidhee kar kai rakhiaa so sahu nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my Husband Lord keeps me like henna paste; He blesses me with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪੀਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਘਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਲਾਇ ਲਏਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape peesai aape ghasai aape hee lai lei ||
verses.translation: He Himself grinds me, and He Himself rubs me; He Himself applies me to His feet.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eih piram piaalaa khasam kaa jai bhaavai tai dhei ||2||
verses.translation: This is the cup of love of my Lord and Master; He gives it as He chooses. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਵੇਕੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: vekee sirasaT upaieean sabh hukam aavai jai samaahee ||
verses.translation: You created the world with its variety; by the Hukam of Your Command, it comes, goes, and merges again in You.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape vekh vigasadhaa dhoojaa ko naahee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself see, and blossom forth; there is no one else at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too gur sabadh bujhaahee ||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You keep me. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I understand You.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa teraa jor hai jiau bhaavai tivai chalaahee ||
verses.translation: You are the strength of all. As it pleases You, You lead us on.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd mai naeh ko kis aakh sunaiee ||2||
verses.translation: There is no other as great as You; unto whom should I speak and talk? ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਫਾਵੀ ਹੋਈ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhulaiee sabh jag firee faavee hoiee bhaal ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, I wandered over the whole world. Searching, I became frustrated.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਦੇਵਈ ਕਿਆ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: so sahu saa(n)t na dheviee kiaa chalai tis naal ||
verses.translation: My Husband Lord has not blessed me with peace and tranquility; what will work with Him?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har dhiaaieeaai a(n)tar rakheeaai ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I meditate on the Lord; I enshrine Him deep within my heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ghar baiThiaa sahu paiaa jaa kirapaa keetee karataar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, seated in his her own home, she finds her Husband Lord, when the Creator Lord grants His Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਗਵਾਈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat dhin giaa rain gavaiee soi ||
verses.translation: Chasing after worldly affairs, the day is wasted, and the night passes in sleep.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kooR bol bikh khaiaa manmukh chaliaa roi ||
verses.translation: Speaking lies, one eats poison; the self-willed manmukh departs, crying out in pain.

verses.original: ਸਿਰੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sirai upar jam dda(n)dd hai dhoojai bhai pat khoi ||
verses.translation: The Mesenger of Death holds his club over the mortal's head; in the love of duality, he loses his honor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam kadhe na chetio fir aavan jaanaa hoi ||
verses.translation: He never even thinks of the Name of the Lord; over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee har man vasai jam dda(n)dd na laagai koi ||
verses.translation: But if, by Guru's Grace, the Lord's Name comes to dwell in his mind, then the Messenger of Death will not strike him down with his club.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaje mil rahai karam paraapat hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Then, O Nanak, he merges intuitively into the Lord, receiving His Grace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik aapanee sifatee laian dhe satigur matee ||
verses.translation: Some are linked to His Praises, when the Lord blesses them with the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਨਾਉ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa no naau bakhasion asathir har satee ||
verses.translation: Some are blessed with the Name of the eternal, unchanging True Lord.

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee baisa(n)taro hukam kareh bhagatee ||
verses.translation: Water, air and fire, by His Will, worship Him.

verses.original: ਏਨਾ ਨੋ ਭਉ ਅਗਲਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: enaa no bhau agalaa pooree banat banatee ||
verses.translation: They are held in the Fear of God; He has formed the perfect form.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh iko hukam varatadhaa ma(n)niaai sukh paiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Hukam, the Command of the One Lord is all-pervasive; accepting it, peace is found. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: salok ||
verses.translation: Shalok:

verses.original: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਝੂਠਾ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kabeer kasauTee raam kee jhooThaa Tikai na koi ||
verses.translation: Kabeer, such is the touchstone of the Lord; the false cannot even touch it.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਕਸਉਟੀ ਸੋ ਸਹੈ ਜੋ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam kasauTee so sahai jo marajeevaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: He alone passes this test of the Lord, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau kar ih man maareeaai kiau kar mritak hoi ||
verses.translation: How can this mind be conquered? How can it be killed?

verses.original: ਕਹਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਛਡੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahiaa sabadh na maaniee haumai chhaddai na koi ||
verses.translation: If one does not accept the Word of the Shabad, egotism does not depart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee haumai chhuTai jeevan mukat so hoi ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated, and then, one is Jivan Mukta - liberated while yet alive.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jis no bakhase tis milai tis bighan na laagai koi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one whom the Lord forgives is united with Him, and then no obstacles block his way. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat maranaa sabh ko kahai jeevan mukat kiau hoi ||
verses.translation: Everyone can say that they are dead while yet alive; how can they be liberated while yet alive?

verses.original: ਭੈ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਰੂ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai kaa sa(n)jam je kare dhaaroo bhaau laaei ||
verses.translation: If someone restrains himself through the Fear of God, and takes the medicine of the Love of God,

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin gun gaavai sukh sahaje bikh bhavajal naam tarei ||
verses.translation: night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. In celestial peace and poise, he crosses over the poisonous, terrifying world-ocean, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh paieeaai jaa kau nadhar karei ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord; he is blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojaa bhaau rachaion trai gun varataaraa ||
verses.translation: God created the love of duality, and the three modes which pervade the universe.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਨਿ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes upaian hukam kamaavan kaaraa ||
verses.translation: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, who act according to His Will.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਦੇ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paRadhe jotakee naa boojheh beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers study their books, but they do not understand contemplation.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh teraa khel hai sach sirajanahaaraa ||
verses.translation: Everything is Your play, O True Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jis bhaavai tis bakhas laih sach sabadh samaiee ||4||
verses.translation: As it pleases You, You bless us with forgiveness, and merge us in the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਝੂਠਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa jhooThaa jhooTh kamaavai ||
verses.translation: The man of false mind practices falsehood.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਫਿਰੈ ਤਪਾ ਸਦਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa no firai tapaa sadhaavai ||
verses.translation: He runs after Maya, and yet pretends to be a man of disciplined meditation.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: bharame bhoolaa sabh teerath gahai ||
verses.translation: Deluded by doubt, he visits all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਤਪਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: oh tapaa kaise param gat lahai ||
verses.translation: How can such a man of disciplined meditation attain the supreme status?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ko sach kamaavai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one lives the Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak so tapaa mokha(n)tar paavai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation attains liberation. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਜਿ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: so tapaa j ih tap ghaale ||
verses.translation: He alone is a man of disciplined meditation, who practices this self-discipline.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur no milai sabadh samaale ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, he contemplates the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sevaa ih tap paravaan ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru - this is the only acceptable disciplined meditation.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਤਪਾ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so tapaa dharageh paavai maan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, such a man of disciplined meditation is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: raat dhinas upaian sa(n)saar kee varatan ||
verses.translation: He created the night and the day, for the activities of the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੇਰੁ ਬਿਨਾਸਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee ghaT chaananaa aaner binaasan ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, one's heart is illumined, and the darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: hukame hee sabh saajeean raviaa sabh van tiran ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He creates everything; He pervades and permeates all the woods and meadows.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap hai gurmukh sadhaa har bhan ||
verses.translation: He Himself is everything; the Gurmukh constantly chants the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabadhe hee sojhee piee sachai aap bujhaiee ||5||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, understanding comes; the True Lord Himself inspires us to understand. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: abhiaagat eh na aakheean jin ke chit meh bharam ||
verses.translation: He is not called a renunciate, whose consciousness is filled with doubt.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਦਿਤੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhai dhitai naanakaa teho jehaa dharam ||
verses.translation: Donations to him bring proportionate rewards.

verses.original: ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭੂਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: abhai nira(n)jan param padh taa kaa bhookhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: He hungers for the supreme status of the Fearless, Immaculate Lord;

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis kaa bhojan naanakaa viralaa paae koi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how rare are those who offer him this food. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: abhiaagat eh na aakheean j par ghar bhojan karen ||
verses.translation: They are not called renunciates, who take food in the homes of others.

verses.original: ਉਦਰੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਹਲੇ ਭੇਖਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: audharai kaaran aapane bahale bhekh karen ||
verses.translation: For the sake of their bellies, they wear various religious robes.

verses.original: ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਆਤਮ ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: abhiaagat seiee naanakaa j aatam gaun karen ||
verses.translation: They alone are renunciates, O Nanak, who enter into their own souls.

verses.original: ਭਾਲਿ ਲਹਨਿ ਸਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaal lahan sahu aapanaa nij ghar rahan karen ||2||
verses.translation: They seek and find their Husband Lord; they dwell within the home of their own inner self. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)bar dharat vichhoRian vich sachaa asaraau ||
verses.translation: They sky and the earth are separate, but the True Lord supports them from within.

verses.original: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghar dhar sabho sach hai jis vich sachaa naau ||
verses.translation: True are all those homes and gates, within which the True Name is enshrined.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sachaa hukam varatadhaa gurmukh sach samaau ||
verses.translation: The Hukam of the True Lord's Command is effective everywhere. The Gurmukh merges in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa aap takhat sachaa beh sachaa kare niaau ||
verses.translation: He Himself is True, and True is His throne. Seated upon it, He administers true justice.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabh sacho sach varatadhaa gurmukh alakh lakhaiee ||6||
verses.translation: The Truest of the True is all-pervading everywhere; the Gurmukh sees the unseen. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rainair maeh ana(n)t hai kooRee aavai jai ||
verses.translation: In the world-ocean, the Infinite Lord abides. The false come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai chalai aapanai bahutee lahai sajai ||
verses.translation: One who walks according to his own will, suffers terrible punishment.

verses.original: ਰੈਣਾਇਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rainair meh sabh kichh hai karamee palai pai ||
verses.translation: All things are in the world-ocean, but they are obtained only by the karma of good actions.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nau nidh paieeaai je chalai tisai rajai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone obtains the nine treasures, who walks in the Will of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sahaje satigur na sevio vich haumai janam binaas ||
verses.translation: One who doesn't intuitively serves the True Guru, loses his life in egotism.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇਓ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa har ras na chakhio kamal na hoio paragaas ||
verses.translation: His tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord, and his heart-lotus does not blossom forth.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikh khaadhee manmukh muaa maiaa moh vinaas ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh eats poison and dies; he is ruined by love and attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikas har ke naam vin dhirag jeevan dhirag vaas ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the One Lord, his life is cursed, and his home is cursed as well.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa aape nadhar kare prabh sachaa taa hovai dhaasan dhaas ||
verses.translation: When God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then one becomes the slave of His slaves.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਪਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa anadhin sevaa kare satiguroo kee kabeh na chhoddai paas ||
verses.translation: And then, night and day, he serves the True Guru, and never leaves His side.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਿਉ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jal meh kamal alipato varatai tiau viche gireh udhaas ||
verses.translation: As the lotus flower floats unaffected in the water, so does he remain detached in his own household.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kare karaiaa sabh ko jiau bhaavai tiv har gunataas ||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the Lord acts, and inspires everyone to act, according to the Pleasure of His Will. He is the treasure of virtue. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਛਤੀਹ ਜੁਗ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਸਾ ਆਪੇ ਗਣਤ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: chhateeh jug gubaar saa aape ganat keenee ||
verses.translation: For thirty-six ages, there was utter darkness. Then, the Lord revealed Himself.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aape sirasaT sabh saajeean aap mat dheenee ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the entire universe. He Himself blessed it with understanding.

verses.original: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਾਜਿਅਨੁ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: simirat saasat saajian paap pu(n)n ganat ganeenee ||
verses.translation: He created the Simritees and the Shaastras; He calculates the accounts of virtue and vice.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis bujhaae so bujhasee sachai sabadh pateenee ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand and to be pleased with the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabh aape aap varatadhaa aape bakhas milaiee ||7||
verses.translation: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੋ ਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਤੰਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih tan sabho rat hai rat bin ta(n)n na hoi ||
verses.translation: This body is all blood; without blood, the body cannot exist.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸਹਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਣੈ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo seh rate aapanai tin tan lobh rat na hoi ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to their Lord - their bodies are not filled with the blood of greed.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਭ ਰਤੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhai piaai tan kheen hoi lobh rat vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God, the body becomes thin, and the blood of greed passes out of the body.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau baisa(n)tar dhaat sudh hoi tiau har kaa bhau dhuramat mail gavai ||
verses.translation: As fire purifies metal, so does the Fear of the Lord eradicate the filth of evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak te jan sohane jo rate har ra(n)g lai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who are imbued with the Lord's Love. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: raamakalee raam man vasiaa taa baniaa seegaar ||
verses.translation: In Raamkalee, I have enshrined the Lord in my mind; thus I have been embellished.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh kamal bigasiaa taa saupiaa bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, my heart-lotus has blossomed forth; the Lord blessed me with the treasure of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bharam giaa taa jaagiaa chookaa agiaan a(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: My doubt was dispelled, and I woke up; the darkness of ignorance was dispelled.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਲਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis no roop at agalaa jis har naal piaar ||
verses.translation: She who is in love with her Lord, is the most infinitely beautiful.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ravai pir aapanaa sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
verses.translation: Such a beautiful, happy soul-bride enjoys her Husband Lord forever.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh seegaar na jaananee jaasan janam sabh haar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know how to decorate themselves; wasting their whole lives, they depart.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin har bhagatee seegaar kareh nit ja(n)meh hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Those who decorate themselves without devotional worship to the Lord, are continually reincarnated to suffer.

verses.original: ਸੈਸਾਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਅਗੈ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saisaarai vich sobh na painee agai j kare su jaanai karataar ||
verses.translation: They do not obtain respect in this world; the Creator Lord alone knows what will happen to them in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa ek hai dhuh vich hai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is the One and only; duality exists only in the world.

verses.original: ਚੰਗੈ ਮੰਦੈ ਆਪਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਕਰਨਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cha(n)gai ma(n)dhai aap laian so karan j aap karaae karataar ||2||
verses.translation: He Himself enjoins them to good and bad; they do only that which the Creator Lord causes them to do. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur seve saa(n)t na aaviee dhoojee naahee jai ||
verses.translation: Without serving the True Guru, tranquility is not obtained. It cannot be found anywhere else.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je bahuteraa locheeaai vin karamaa paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: No matter how much one may long for it, without the karma of good actions, it cannot be found.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar lobh vikaar hai dhoojai bhai khuaai ||
verses.translation: Those whose inner beings are filled with greed and corruption, are ruined through the love of duality.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin ja(n)man maran na chukiee haumai vich dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: The cycle of birth and death is not ended, and filled with egotism, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee satigur siau chit laiaa so khaalee koiee naeh ||
verses.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru, do not remain unfulfilled.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tin jam kee talab na hoviee naa oi dhukh sahaeh ||
verses.translation: They are not summoned by the Messenger of Death, and they do not suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh ubare sachai sabadh samaeh ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is saved, merging in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap alipat sadhaa rahai hor dha(n)dhai sabh dhaaveh ||
verses.translation: He Himself remains unattached forever; all others run after worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਚਲੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aap nihachal achal hai hor aaveh jaaveh ||
verses.translation: He Himself is eternal, unchanging and unmoving; the others continue coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa har dhiaaieeaai gurmukh sukh paaveh ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord forever and ever, the Gurmukh finds peace.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaasaa paieeaai sach sifat samaaveh ||
verses.translation: He dwells in the home of his own inner being, absorbed in the Praise of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer hai gur sabadh bujhaiee ||8||
verses.translation: The True Lord is profound and unfathomable; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is understood. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa naam dhiaai too sabho varatai sach ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the True Name; the True Lord is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੋ ਬੁਝੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak hukamai jo bujhai so fal paae sach ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, obtains the fruit of Truth.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee karataa firai hukam na boojhai sach ||
verses.translation: One who merely mouths the words, does not understand the Hukam of the True Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੰਨੇ ਕਚੁ ਨਿਕਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har kaa bhaanaa ma(n)ne so bhagat hoi vin ma(n)ne kach nikach ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who accepts the Will of the Lord is His devotee. Without accepting it, he is the falsest of the false. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bol na jaananee onaa a(n)dhar kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know what they are saying. They are filled with sexual desire, anger and egotism.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਥਾਉ ਕੁਥਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਉਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: oi thaau kuthaau na jaananee un a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
verses.translation: They do not understand right places and wrong places; they are filled with greed and corruption.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਿ ਗਲਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: oi aapanai suaai aai beh galaa kareh onaa maare jam ja(n)dhaar ||
verses.translation: They come, and sit and talk for their own purposes. The Messenger of Death strikes them down.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਮਾਰਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: agai dharageh lekhai ma(n)giaai maar khuaar keecheh kooRiaar ||
verses.translation: Hereafter, they are called to account in the Court of the Lord; the false ones are struck down and humiliated.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eh kooRai kee mal kiau utarai koiee kaddahu ih veechaar ||
verses.translation: How can this filth of falsehood be washed off? Can anyone think about this, and find the way?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਏ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai taa naam dhiRaae sabh kilavikh kaTanahaar ||
verses.translation: If one meets with the True Guru, He implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord within; all his sins are destroyed.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam jape naamo aaraadhe tis jan kau karahu sabh namasakaar ||
verses.translation: Let all bow in humility to that humble being who chants the Naam, and worships the Naam in adoration.

verses.original: ਮਲੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਤਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mal kooRee naam utaareean jap naam hoaa sachiaar ||
verses.translation: The Naam washes off the filth of falsehood; chanting the Naam, one becomes truthful.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਏਹਿ ਚਲਤ ਹਹਿ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਉ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak jis dhe eh chalat heh so jeevau dhevanahaar ||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, wondrous are the plays of the Lord, the Giver of life. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: tudh jevadd dhaataa naeh kis aakh sunaieeaai ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver; no other is as great as You. Unto whom should I speak and talk?

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee pai jithahu haumai jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I find You; You eradicate egotism from within.

verses.original: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਾਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: ras kas saadhaa baaharaa sachee vaddiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: You are beyond sweet and salty flavors; True is Your glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis no bakhase tis dhei aap le milaieeaai ||
verses.translation: You bless those whom You forgive, and unite them with Yourself.

verses.original: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: ghaT a(n)tar a(n)mrit rakhion gurmukh kisai piaaiee ||9||
verses.translation: You have placed the Ambrosial Nectar deep within the heart; the Gurmukh drinks it in. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾਣੀਆ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਪੁਤ ਸਪੁਤ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: baabaaneeaa kahaaneeaa put saput karen ||
verses.translation: The stories of one's ancestors make the children good children.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: j satigur bhaavai su ma(n)n lain seiee karam karen ||
verses.translation: They accept what is pleasing to the Will of the True Guru, and act accordingly.

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਬਿਆਸ ਸੁਕ ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: jai puchhahu simirat saasat biaas suk naaradh bachan sabh sirasaT karen ||
verses.translation: Go and consult the Simritees, the Shaastras, the writings of Vyaas, Suk Dayv, Naarad, and all those who preach to the world.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachai laae sach lage sadhaa sach samaalen ||
verses.translation: Those, whom the True Lord attaches, are attached to the Truth; they contemplate the True Name forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਏ ਜਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak aae se paravaan bhe j sagale kul taaren ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, their coming into the world is approved; they redeem all their ancestors. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਸਿਖ ਭੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: guroo jinaa kaa a(n)dhulaa sikh bhee a(n)dhe karam karen ||
verses.translation: The disciples whose teacher is blind, act blindly as well.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਨਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਠੋ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi bhaanai chalan aapanai nit jhooTho jhooTh bolen ||
verses.translation: They walk according to their own wills, and continually speak falsehood and lies.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: kooR kusat kamaavadhe par ni(n)dhaa sadhaa karen ||
verses.translation: They practice falsehood and deception, and endlessly slander others.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi aap ddube par ni(n)dhakaa sagale kul ddoben ||
verses.translation: Slandering others, they drown themselves, and drown all their generations as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਤੁ ਓਇ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੇ ਉਇ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jit oi laae tit lage ui bapuRe kiaa karen ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever the Lord links them to, to that they are linked; what can the poor creatures do? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਕੀਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh nadharee a(n)dhar rakhadhaa jetee sisaT sabh keetee ||
verses.translation: He keeps all under His Gaze; He created the entire Universe.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik kooR kusat laian manmukh vigootee ||
verses.translation: He has linked some to falsehood and deception; these self-willed manmukhs are plundered.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa dhiaaieeaai a(n)dhar har preetee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Lord forever; their inner beings are filled with love.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਵਾਤਿ ਸਿਪੀਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau potai pu(n)n hai tin(h) vaat sipeetee ||
verses.translation: Those who have the treasure of virtue, chant the Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਨਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai sach sifat sanaiee ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, and the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਤੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: satee paap kar sat kamaeh ||
verses.translation: Men of charity gather wealth by committing sins, and then give it away in donations to charity.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਦੇਵਣ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur dheekhiaa ghar dhevan jaeh ||
verses.translation: Their spiritual teachers go to their homes to instruct them.

verses.original: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਖਟਿਐ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eisataree purakhai khaTiaai bhaau ||
verses.translation: The woman loves the man only for his wealth;

verses.original: ਭਾਵੈ ਆਵਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhaavai aavau bhaavai jaau ||
verses.translation: they come and go as they please.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saasat bedh na maanai koi ||
verses.translation: No one obeys the Shaastras or the Vedas.

verses.original: ਆਪੋ ਆਪੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapo aapai poojaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Everyone worships himself.

verses.original: ਕਾਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬਹੈ ਨਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaajee hoi kai bahai niaai ||
verses.translation: Becoming judges, they sit and administer justice.

verses.original: ਫੇਰੇ ਤਸਬੀ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: fere tasabee kare khudhai ||
verses.translation: They chant on their malas, and call upon God.

verses.original: ਵਢੀ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਹਕੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: vaddee lai kai hak gavaae ||
verses.translation: They accept bribes, and block justice.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪੁਛੈ ਤਾ ਪੜਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: je ko puchhai taa paR sunaae ||
verses.translation: If someone asks them, they read quotations from their books.

verses.original: ਤੁਰਕ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: turak ma(n)tr kan ridhai samaeh ||
verses.translation: The Muslim scriptures are in their ears and in their hearts.

verses.original: ਲੋਕ ਮੁਹਾਵਹਿ ਚਾੜੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: lok muhaaveh chaaRee khaeh ||
verses.translation: They plunder the people, and engage in gossip and flattery.

verses.original: ਚਉਕਾ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਸੁਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaukaa dhe kai suchaa hoi ||
verses.translation: They anoint their kitchens to try to become pure.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa hi(n)dhoo vekhahu koi ||
verses.translation: Behold, such is the Hindu.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜਟਾ ਬਿਭੂਤ ॥
verses.translit: jogee girahee jaTaa bibhoot ||
verses.translation: The Yogi, with matted hair and ashes on his body, has become a householder.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
verses.translit: aagai paachhai roveh poot ||
verses.translation: The children weep in front of him and behind him.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jog na paiaa jugat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: He does not attain Yoga - he has lost his way.

verses.original: ਕਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kit kaaran sir chhaiee paiee ||
verses.translation: Why does he apply ashes to his forehead?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak kal kaa eh paravaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this is the sign of the Dark Age of Kali Yuga;

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aape aakhan aape jaan ||1||
verses.translation: everyone says that he himself knows. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: hi(n)dhoo kai ghar hi(n)dhoo aavai ||
verses.translation: The Hindu comes to the house of a Hindu.

verses.original: ਸੂਤੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਪੜਿ ਗਲਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: soot janeuoo paR gal paavai ||
verses.translation: He puts the sacred thread around his neck and reads the scriptures.

verses.original: ਸੂਤੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: soot pai kare buriaaiee ||
verses.translation: He puts on the thread, but does evil deeds.

verses.original: ਨਾਤਾ ਧੋਤਾ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naataa dhotaa thai na paiee ||
verses.translation: His cleansings and washings will not be approved.

verses.original: ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: musalamaan kare vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Muslim glorifies his own faith.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ਕੋ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: vin gur peerai ko thai na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru or a spiritual teacher, no one is accepted.

verses.original: ਰਾਹੁ ਦਸਾਇ ਓਥੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: raahu dhasai othai ko jai ||
verses.translation: They may be shown the way, but only a few go there.

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਭਿਸਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karanee baajhahu bhisat na pai ||
verses.translation: Without the karma of good actions, heaven is not attained.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jogee kai ghar jugat dhasaiee ||
verses.translation: The Way of Yoga is demonstrated in the Yogi's monastery.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਕਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tit kaaran kan mu(n)dhraa paiee ||
verses.translation: They wear ear-rings to show the way.

verses.original: ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਇ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mu(n)dhraa pai firai sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Wearing ear-rings, they wander around the world.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jithai kithai sirajanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord is everywhere.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਤੇ ਵਾਟਾਊ ॥
verses.translit: jete jeea tete vaaTaauoo ||
verses.translation: There are as many travellers as there are beings.

verses.original: ਚੀਰੀ ਆਈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਕਾਊ ॥
verses.translit: cheeree aaiee ddil na kaauoo ||
verses.translation: When one's death warrant is issued, there is no delay.

verses.original: ਏਥੈ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: ethai jaanai su jai sin(j)aanai ||
verses.translation: One who knows the Lord here, realizes Him there as well.

verses.original: ਹੋਰੁ ਫਕੜੁ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: hor fakaR hi(n)dhoo musalamaanai ||
verses.translation: Others, whether Hindu or Muslim, are just babbling.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa kaa dhar lekhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Everyone's account is read in the Court of the Lord;

verses.original: ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਤਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: karanee baajhahu tarai na koi ||
verses.translation: without the karma of good actions, no one crosses over.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sacho sach vakhaanai koi ||
verses.translation: One who speaks the True Name of the True Lord,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਗੈ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak agai puchh na hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, is not called to account hereafter. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਗੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa ma(n)dhar aakheeaai kaiaa koT gaR ||
verses.translation: The fortress of the body is called the Mansion of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar laal javeharee gurmukh har naam paR ||
verses.translation: The rubies and gems are found within it; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa ma(n)dhar sareer at sohanaa har har naam dhiR ||
verses.translation: The body, the Mansion of the Lord, is very beautiful, when the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is implanted deep within.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਤ ਕੜੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh aap khuaaian maiaa moh nit kaR ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs ruin themselves; they boil continuously in attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa saahib ek hai poorai bhaag paiaa jaiee ||11||
verses.translation: The One Lord is the Master of all. He is found only by perfect destiny. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਜੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa sat dhukheeaa naa sat sukheeaa naa sat paanee ja(n)t fireh ||
verses.translation: There is no Truth in suffering, there is no Truth in comfort. There is no Truth in wandering like animals through the water.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਮੁਡਾਈ ਕੇਸੀ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਦੇਸ ਫਿਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa sat moo(n)dd muddaiee kesee naa sat paRiaa dhes fireh ||
verses.translation: There is no Truth in shaving one's head; there is no Truth is studying the scriptures or wandering in foreign lands.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਰੁਖੀ ਬਿਰਖੀ ਪਥਰ ਆਪੁ ਤਛਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa sat rukhee birakhee pathar aap tachhaaveh dhukh saheh ||
verses.translation: There is no Truth in trees, plants or stones, in mutilating oneself or suffering in pain.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਬਧੇ ਸੰਗਲ ਨਾ ਸਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਘਾਹੁ ਚਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naa sat hasatee badhe sa(n)gal naa sat gaiee ghaahu chareh ||
verses.translation: There is no Truth in binding elephants in chains; there is no Truth in grazing cows.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਜੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis hath sidh dhevai je soiee jis no dhei tis aai milai ||
verses.translation: He alone grants it, whose hands hold spritual perfection; he alone receives it, unto whom it is given.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak taa kau milai vaddaiee jis ghaT bheetar sabadh ravai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone is blessed with glorious greatness, whose heart is filled with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਉ ਸਭਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ghaT mere hau sabhanaa a(n)dhar jiseh khuaaiee tis kaun kahai ||
verses.translation: God says, all hearts are mine, and I am in all hearts. Who can explain this to one who is confused?

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਾ ਵਾਟੜੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh dhikhaalaa vaaTaRee tiseh bhulaavai kaun ||
verses.translation: Who can confuse that being, unto whom I have shown the Way?

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਭੁਲਾਈ ਪੰਧ ਸਿਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiseh bhulaiee pa(n)dh sir tiseh dhikhaavai kaun ||1||
verses.translation: And who can show the Path to that being whom I have confused since the beginning of time? ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so girahee jo nigrahu karai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a householder, who restrains his passions

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam bheekhiaa karai ||
verses.translation: and begs for meditation, austerity and self-discipline.

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan kaa kare sareer ||
verses.translation: He gives donations to charity with his body;

verses.original: ਸੋ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਗੰਗਾ ਕਾ ਨੀਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: so girahee ga(n)gaa kaa neer ||
verses.translation: such a householder is as pure as the water of the Ganges.

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਈਸਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: bolai ieesar sat saroop ||
verses.translation: Says Eeshar, the Lord is the embodiment of Truth.

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||2||
verses.translation: The supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਜੋ ਧੂਪੈ ਆਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: so aaudhootee jo dhoopai aap ||
verses.translation: He alone is a detached hermit, who burns away his self-conceit.

verses.original: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhikhiaa bhojan karai sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: He begs for suffering as his food.

verses.original: ਅਉਹਠ ਪਟਣ ਮਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aauhaTh paTan meh bheekhiaa karai ||
verses.translation: In the city of the heart, he begs for charity.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
verses.translit: so aaudhootee siv pur chaRai ||
verses.translation: Such a renunciate ascends to the City of God.

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: bolai gorakh sat saroop ||
verses.translation: Says Gorakh, God is the embodiment of Truth;

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||3||
verses.translation: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਜਿ ਪਾਲੇ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: so udhaasee j paale udhaas ||
verses.translation: He alone is an Udasi, a shaven-headed renunciate, who embraces renunciation.

verses.original: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: aradh uradh kare nira(n)jan vaas ||
verses.translation: He sees the Immaculate Lord dwelling in both the upper and lower regions.

verses.original: ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਪਾਏ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj kee paae ga(n)dd ||
verses.translation: He balances the sun and the moon energies.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੜੈ ਨ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis udhaasee kaa paRai na ka(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The body-wall of such an Udasi does not collapse.

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਗੋਪੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: bolai gopee cha(n)dh sat saroop ||
verses.translation: Says Gopi Chand, God is the embodiment of Truth;

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||4||
verses.translation: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||4||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਜਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਖਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: so paakha(n)ddee j kaiaa pakhaale ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Paakhandi, who cleanses his body of filth.

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa kee agan braham parajaale ||
verses.translation: The fire of his body illuminates God within.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਝਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: supanai bi(n)dh na dheiee jharanaa ||
verses.translation: He does not waste his energy in wet dreams.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: tis paakha(n)ddee jaraa na maranaa ||
verses.translation: Such a Paakhandi does not grow old or die.

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਚਰਪਟੁ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: bolai charapaT sat saroop ||
verses.translation: Says Charpat, God is the embodiment of Truth;

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||5||
verses.translation: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||5||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਉਲਟੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: so bairaagee j ulaTe braham ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Bairaagi, who turns himself toward God.

verses.original: ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਰੋਪੈ ਥੰਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: gagan ma(n)ddal meh ropai tha(n)m ||
verses.translation: In the Tenth Gate, the sky of the mind, he erects his pillar.

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis a(n)tar rahai dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he remains in deep inner meditation.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਤ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: te bairaagee sat samaan ||
verses.translation: Such a Bairaagi is just like the True Lord.

verses.original: ਬੋਲੈ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: bolai bharathar sat saroop ||
verses.translation: Says Bhart'har, God is the embodiment of Truth;

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: param ta(n)t meh rekh na roop ||6||
verses.translation: the supreme essence of reality has no shape or form. ||6||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiau marai ma(n)dhaa kiau jeevai jugat ||
verses.translation: How is evil eradicated? How can the true way of life be found?

verses.original: ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਖਾਜੈ ਭੁਗਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)n paRai kiaa khaajai bhugat ||
verses.translation: What is the use of piercing the ears, or begging for food?

verses.original: ਆਸਤਿ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aasat naasat eko naau ||
verses.translation: Throughout existence and non-existence, there is only the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaunu su akhar jit rahai hiaau ||
verses.translation: What is that Word, which holds the heart in its place?

verses.original: ਧੂਪ ਛਾਵ ਜੇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਸਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoop chhaav je sam kar sahai ||
verses.translation: When you look alike upon sunshine and shade,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: taa naanak aakhai gur ko kahai ||
verses.translation: says Nanak, then the Guru will speak to you.

verses.original: ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਪੂਤ ॥
verses.translit: chhia varataare varateh poot ||
verses.translation: The students follow the six systems.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਾ ਅਉਧੂਤ ॥
verses.translit: naa sa(n)saaree naa aaudhoot ||
verses.translation: They are neither worldly people, nor detached renunciates.

verses.original: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਜੋ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nira(n)kaar jo rahai samai ||
verses.translation: One who remains absorbed in the Formless Lord

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kaahe bheekhiaa ma(n)gan jai ||7||
verses.translation: - why should he go out begging? ||7||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ma(n)dhar soiee aakheeaai jithahu har jaataa ||
verses.translation: That alone is said to be the Lord's temple, where the Lord is known.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: maanas dheh gur bachanee paiaa sabh aatam raam pachhaataa ||
verses.translation: In the human body, the Guru's Word is found, when one understands that the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is in all.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: baahar mool na khojeeaai ghar maeh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: Don't look for Him outside your self. The Creator, the Architect of Destiny, is within the home of your own heart.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh har ma(n)dhar kee saar na jaananee tinee janam gavaataa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not appreciate the value of the Lord's temple; they waste away and lose their lives.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sabh meh ik varatadhaa gur sabadhee paiaa jaiee ||12||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading in all; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He can be found. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh hovai so sunai moorakh kaa kahanaa ||
verses.translation: Only a fool listens to the words of the fool.

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖ ਕੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਖਣ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh ke kiaa lakhan hai kiaa moorakh kaa karanaa ||
verses.translation: What are the signs of the fool? What does the fool do?

verses.original: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਓਹੁ ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਹੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੇ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: moorakh oh j mugadh hai aha(n)kaare maranaa ||
verses.translation: A fool is stupid; he dies of egotism.

verses.original: ਏਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: et kamaanai sadhaa dhukh dhukh hee meh rahanaa ||
verses.translation: His actions always bring him pain; he lives in pain.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਵੈ ਖੂਹਿ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: at piaaraa pavai khooh kih sa(n)jam karanaa ||
verses.translation: If someone's beloved friend falls into the pit, what can be used to pull him out?

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਓਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh hoi su kare veechaar os alipato rahanaa ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh contemplates the Lord, and remains detached.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਭੀ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: har naam japai aap udharai os pichhai ddubadhe bhee taranaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, he saves himself, and he carries across those who are drowning as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jo tis bhaavai so kare jo dhei su sahanaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he acts in accordance with the Will of God; he endures whatever he is given. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਿਖ ਸਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: naanak aakhai re manaa suneeaai sikh sahee ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O mind, to the True Teachings.

verses.original: ਲੇਖਾ ਰਬੁ ਮੰਗੇਸੀਆ ਬੈਠਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: lekhaa rab ma(n)geseeaa baiThaa kadd vahee ||
verses.translation: Opening His ledger, God will call you to account.

verses.original: ਤਲਬਾ ਪਉਸਨਿ ਆਕੀਆ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਰਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: talabaa pausan aakeeaa baakee jinaa rahee ||
verses.translation: Those rebels who have unpaid accounts shall be called out.

verses.original: ਅਜਰਾਈਲੁ ਫਰੇਸਤਾ ਹੋਸੀ ਆਇ ਤਈ ॥
verses.translit: ajaraieel faresataa hosee aai tiee ||
verses.translation: Azraa-eel, the Angel of Death, shall be appointed to punish them.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਭੀੜੀ ਗਲੀ ਫਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan na sujhiee bheeRee galee fahee ||
verses.translation: They will find no way to escape coming and going in reincarnation; they are trapped in the narrow path.

verses.original: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਓੜਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kooR nikhuTe naanakaa oRak sach rahee ||2||
verses.translation: Falsehood will come to an end, O Nanak, and Truth will prevail in the end. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa sabh sareer hai har rav rahiaa sabh aapai ||
verses.translation: The body and everything belongs to the Lord; the Lord Himself is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kee keemat na pavai kichh kahan na jaapai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee saalaaheeaai har bhagatee raapai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one praises the Lord, imbued with feelings of devotion.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਗਵਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh man tan hariaa hoiaa aha(n)kaar gavaapai ||
verses.translation: The mind and body are totally rejuvenated, and egotism is eradicated.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh har kaa khel hai gurmukh kisai bujhaiee ||13||
verses.translation: Everything is the play of the Lord. The Gurmukh understands this. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਹੰਸਰ ਦਾਨ ਦੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਰੋਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saha(n)sar dhaan dhe i(n)dhr roaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Branded with a thousand marks of disgrace, Indra cried in shame.

verses.original: ਪਰਸ ਰਾਮੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paras raam rovai ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Paras Raam returned home crying.

verses.original: ਅਜੈ ਸੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ajai su rovai bheekhiaa khai ||
verses.translation: Ajai cried and wept, when he was made to eat the manure he had given, pretending it was charity.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee dharageh milai sajai ||
verses.translation: Such is the punishment received in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰੋਵੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਕਾਲਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: rovai raam nikaalaa bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Rama wept when he was sent into exile,

verses.original: ਸੀਤਾ ਲਖਮਣੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: seetaa lakhaman vichhuR giaa ||
verses.translation: and separated from Sita and Lakhshman.

verses.original: ਰੋਵੈ ਦਹਸਿਰੁ ਲੰਕ ਗਵਾਇ ॥ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਆਦੀ ਡਉਰੂ ਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: rovai dhahasir la(n)k gavai || jin seetaa aadhee ddauroo vai ||
verses.translation: The ten-headed Raawan, who stole away Sita with the beat of his tambourine, wept when he lost Sri Lanka.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਂਡਵ ਭਏ ਮਜੂਰ ॥ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਤ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: roveh paa(n)ddav bhe majoor || jin kai suaamee rahat hadhoor ||
verses.translation: The Paandavas once lived in the Presence of the Lord; they were made slaves, and wept.

verses.original: ਰੋਵੈ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਖੁਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: rovai janamejaa khui giaa ||
verses.translation: Janmayjaa wept, that he had lost his way.

verses.original: ਏਕੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪੀ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ekee kaaran paapee bhiaa ||
verses.translation: One mistake, and he became a sinner.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਪੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: roveh sekh masaik peer ||
verses.translation: The Shaykhs, Pirs and spiritual teachers weep;

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੀੜ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal mat laagai bheeR ||
verses.translation: at the very last instant, they suffer in agony.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: roveh raaje ka(n)n paRai ||
verses.translation: The kings weep - their ears are cut;

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar maageh bheekhiaa jai ||
verses.translation: they go begging from house to house.

verses.original: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: roveh kirapan sa(n)cheh dhan jai ||
verses.translation: The miser weeps; he has to leave behind the wealth he has gathered.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit roveh giaan gavai ||
verses.translation: The Pandit, the religious scholar, weeps when his learning is gone.

verses.original: ਬਾਲੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: baalee rovai naeh bhataar ||
verses.translation: The young woman weeps because she has no husband.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhukheeaa sabh sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the whole world is suffering.

verses.original: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)ne naau soiee jin jai ||
verses.translation: He alone is victorious, who believes in the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅਉਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aauree karam na lekhai lai ||1||
verses.translation: No other action is of any account. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sabh kichh ma(n)niaai avar kaaraa sabh baadh ||
verses.translation: Meditation, austerity and everything come through belief in the Lord's Name. All other actions are useless.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak ma(n)niaa ma(n)neeaai bujheeaai gur parasaadh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, believe in the One who is worth believing in. By Guru's Grace, he is realized. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa ha(n)s dhur mel karatai likh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The union of the body and the soul-swan was pre-ordained by the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh gupat varatadhaa gurmukh pragaTaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is hidden, and yet pervading all. He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavai gun ucharai gun maeh samaiaa ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chanting His Praises, one merges in His Glories.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachee baanee sach hai sach mel milaiaa ||
verses.translation: True is the True Word of the Guru's Bani. One unites in Union with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh aape aap hai aape dhei vaddiaaiee ||14||
verses.translation: He Himself is everything; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਤਨਾ ਪਰਖਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)dhaa hoi kai ratanaa parakhan jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the blind man may go to appraise the jewels,

verses.original: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ratanaa saar na jaaniee aavai aap lakhai ||1||
verses.translation: but he will not know their value; he will return home after exposing his ignorance. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਤਨਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਥਲੀ ਰਤਨੀ ਖੋਲੀ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: ratanaa keree guthalee ratanee kholee aai ||
verses.translation: The Jeweller has come, and opened up the bag of jewels.

verses.original: ਵਖਰ ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਦੁਹਾ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vakhar tai vanajaariaa dhuhaa rahee samai ||
verses.translation: The merchandise and the merchant are merged together.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਣਕ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin gun palai naanakaa maanak vanajeh sei ||
verses.translation: They alone purchase the gem, O Nanak, who have virtue in their purse.

verses.original: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਤਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ratanaa saar na jaananee a(n)dhe vateh loi ||2||
verses.translation: Those who do not appreciate the value of the jewels, wander like blind men in the world. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਦਸਵੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: nau dharavaaje kaiaa koT hai dhasavai gupat rakheejai ||
verses.translation: The fortress of the body has nine gates; the tenth gate is kept hidden.

verses.original: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੁਲਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bajar kapaaT na khulanee gur sabadh khuleejai ||
verses.translation: The rigid door is not open; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad can it be opened.

verses.original: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: anahadh vaaje dhun vajadhe gur sabadh suneejai ||
verses.translation: The unstruck sound current resounds and vibrates there. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is heard.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: tit ghaT a(n)tar chaananaa kar bhagat mileejai ||
verses.translation: Deep within the nucleus of the heart, the Divine Light shines forth. Through devotional worship, one meets the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sabh meh ek varatadhaa jin aape rachan rachaiee ||15||
verses.translation: The One Lord is pervading and permeating all. He Himself created the creation. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਦਸਿਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe kai raeh dhasiaai a(n)dhaa hoi su jai ||
verses.translation: He is truly blind, who follows the way shown by the blind man.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hoi sujaakhaa naanakaa so kiau ujhaR pai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, why should the one who can see, get lost?

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਇਣ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe eh na aakheean jin mukh loin naeh ||
verses.translation: Do not call them blind, who have no eyes in their face.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe seiee naanakaa khasamahu ghuthe jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: They alone are blind, O Nanak, who wander away from their Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: saahib a(n)dhaa jo keeaa kare sujaakhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: One whom the Lord has made blind - the Lord can make him see again.

verses.original: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jehaa jaanai teho varatai je sau aakhai koi ||
verses.translation: He acts only as he knows, although he may be spoken to a hundred times.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਸੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਉ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: jithai su vasat na jaapiee aape varatau jaan ||
verses.translation: Where the real thing is not seen, self-conceit prevails there - know this well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gaahak kiau le sakai na vasat pachhaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, how can the purshaser purchase the real thing, if he cannot recognize it? ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਹੁਕਮਹੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: so kiau a(n)dhaa aakheeaai j hukamahu a(n)dhaa hoi ||
verses.translation: How can someone be called blind, if he was made blind by the Lord's Command?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam na bujhiee a(n)dhaa kaheeaai soi ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command should be called blind. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੜੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa a(n)dhar gaR koT hai sabh dhisa(n)tar dhesaa ||
verses.translation: Deep within the body is the fortress of the Lord, and all lands and countries.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape taaRee laieean sabh meh paravesaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself sits in primal, profound Samaadhi; He Himself is all-pervading.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape sirasaT saajeean aap gupat rakhesaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the Universe, and He Himself remains hidden within it.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਪਰਗਟੀਏਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te jaaniaa sach paragaTe'eesaa ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, the Lord is known, and the Truth is revealed.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh sacho sach hai gur sojhee paiee ||16||
verses.translation: He is True, the Truest of the True; the Guru has imparted this understanding. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਹਾੜੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਖੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: saavan raat ahaaR dhih kaam karodh dhui khet ||
verses.translation: Night is the summer season, and day is the winter season; sexual desire and anger are the two fields planted.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਦਰੋਗੁ ਬੀਉ ਹਾਲੀ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਹੇਤ ॥
verses.translit: lab vatr dharog beeau haalee raahak het ||
verses.translation: Greed prepares the soil, and the seed of falsehood is planted; attachment and love are the farmer and hired hand.

verses.original: ਹਲੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਣ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਖਟੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hal beechaar vikaar man hukamee khaTe khai ||
verses.translation: Contemplation is the plow, and corruption is the harvest; this is what one earns and eats, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਅਉਤੁ ਜਣੇਦਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak lekhai ma(n)giaai aaut janedhaa jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when one is called to give his account, he will be barren and infertile. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਉ ਭੁਇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਬਲੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: bhau bhui pavit paanee sat sa(n)tokh baledh ||
verses.translation: Make the Fear of God the farm, purity the water, truth and contentment the cows and bulls,

verses.original: ਹਲੁ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਹਾਲੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਚੇਤਾ ਵਤ੍ਰ ਵਖਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: hal halemee haalee chit chetaa vatr vakhat sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: humility the plow, consciousness the plowman, remembrance the preparation of the soil, and union with the Lord the planting time.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਬੋਹਲ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਦਰੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: naau beej bakhasees bohal dhuneeaa sagal dharog ||
verses.translation: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, and His Forgiving Grace the harvest. Do this, and the whole world will seem false.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee karam hoi jaaveh sagal vijog ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if He bestows His Merciful Glance of Grace, then all your separation will be ended. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh moh gubaar hai dhoojai bhai bolai ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is trapped in the darkness of emotional attachment; in the love of duality he speaks.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai sadhaa dhukh hai nit neer virolai ||
verses.translation: The love of duality brings pain forever; he churns the water endlessly.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai math tat kaddolai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he churns, and obtains the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਧਾ ਟੋਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar paragaas ghaT chaananaa har ladhaa Tolai ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light illuminates his heart deep within; he seeks the Lord, and obtains Him.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: aape bharam bhulaidhaa kichh kahan na jaiee ||17||
verses.translation: He Himself deludes in doubt; no one can comment on this. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਰੋਜੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jal meh ja(n)t upaian tinaa bh rojee dhei ||
verses.translation: He created the creatures in water, and He gives them their nourishment.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਹਟੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: othai haT na chaliee naa ko kiras karei ||
verses.translation: There are no stores open there, and no one farms there.

verses.original: ਸਉਦਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: saudhaa mool na hoviee naa ko le na dhei ||
verses.translation: No business is ever transacted there, and no one buys or sells.

verses.original: ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਹਾਰੁ ਜੀਅ ਖਾਣਾ ਏਹੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: jeeaa kaa aahaar jeea khaanaa eh karei ||
