verses.translation: Animals eat other animals; this is what the Lord has given them as food.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਸਾਇਰਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਿ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: vich upaae sairaa tinaa bh saar karei ||
verses.translation: He created them in the oceans, and He provides for them as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak chi(n)taa mat karahu chi(n)taa tis hee hei ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, don't be anxious; the Lord will take care of you. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਝੀਵਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ih jeeau machhulee jheevar tirasanaa kaal ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this soul is the fish, and death is the hungry fisherman.

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਪੜੈ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa a(n)dh na chetiee paRai achi(n)taa jaal ||
verses.translation: The blind man does not even think of this. And suddenly, the net is cast.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak chit achet hai chi(n)taa badhaa jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, his consciousness is unconscious, and he departs, bound by anxiety.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare je aapanee taa aape le milai ||2||
verses.translation: But if the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then He unites the soul with Himself. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: se jan saache sadhaa sadhaa jinee har ras peetaa ||
verses.translation: They are true, forever true, who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sachaa man vasai sach saudhaa keetaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; He strikes the true bargain.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh ghar hee maeh hai vaddabhaagee leetaa ||
verses.translation: Everything is in the home of the self within; only the very fortunate obtain it.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar tirasanaa mar giee har gun gaaveetaa ||
verses.translation: The hunger within is conquered and overcome, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaian aape dhei bujhaiee ||18||
verses.translation: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself blesses them with understanding. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੇਲਿ ਪਿੰਞਾਇਆ ਕਤਿ ਵੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: vel pi(n)n(j)aiaa kat vunaiaa ||
verses.translation: The cotton is ginned, woven and spun;

verses.original: ਕਟਿ ਕੁਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਖੁੰਬਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaT kuT kar khu(n)b chaRaiaa ||
verses.translation: the cloth is laid out, washed and bleached white.

verses.original: ਲੋਹਾ ਵਢੇ ਦਰਜੀ ਪਾੜੇ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਸੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: lohaa vadde dharajee paaRe sooiee dhaagaa seevai ||
verses.translation: The tailor cuts it with his scissors, and sews it with his thread.

verses.original: ਇਉ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸੀਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eiau pat paaTee sifatee seepai naanak jeevat jeevai ||
verses.translation: Thus, the torn and tattered honor is sewn up again, through the Lord's Praise, O Nanak, and one lives the true life.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਾਟੈ ਸੂਈ ਧਾਗਾ ਗੰਢੈ ॥
verses.translit: hoi puraanaa kapaR paaTai sooiee dhaagaa ga(n)ddai ||
verses.translation: Becoming worn, the cloth is torn; with needle and thread it is sewn up again.

verses.original: ਮਾਹੁ ਪਖੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੰਢੈ ॥
verses.translit: maahu pakh kih chalai naahee ghaRee muhat kichh ha(n)ddai ||
verses.translation: It will not last for a month, or even a week. It barely lasts for an hour, or even a moment.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੀਤਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach puraanaa hovai naahee seetaa kadhe na paaTai ||
verses.translation: But the Truth does not grow old; and when it is stitched, it is never torn again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਪੀ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib sacho sachaa tichar jaapee jaapai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is the Truest of the True. While we meditate on Him, we see Him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਚ ਕੀ ਕਾਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sach kee kaatee sach sabh saar ||
verses.translation: The knife is Truth, and its steel is totally True.

verses.original: ਘਾੜਤ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: ghaaRat tis kee apar apaar ||
verses.translation: Its workmanship is incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਸਾਣ ਰਖਾਈ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe saan rakhaiee lai ||
verses.translation: It is sharpened on the grindstone of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਥੇਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun kee thekai vich samai ||
verses.translation: It is placed in the scabbard of virtue.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਕੁਠਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis dhaa kuThaa hovai sekh ||
verses.translation: If the Shaykh is killed with that,

verses.original: ਲੋਹੂ ਲਬੁ ਨਿਕਥਾ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: lohoo lab nikathaa vekh ||
verses.translation: then the blood of greed will spill out.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਹਲਾਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਕਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hoi halaal lagai hak jai ||
verses.translation: One who is slaughtered in this ritualistic way, will be attached to the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਦੀਦਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhar dheedhaar samai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, at the Lord's door, he is absorbed into His Blessed Vision. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਮਰਿ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਬੰਕੁੜਾ ਬੰਕੇ ਕਾ ਅਸਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kamar kaTaaraa ba(n)kuRaa ba(n)ke kaa asavaar ||
verses.translation: A beautiful dagger hangs by your waist, and you ride such a beautiful horse.

verses.original: ਗਰਬੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: garab na keejai naanakaa mat sir aavai bhaar ||3||
verses.translation: But don't be too proud; O Nanak, you may fall head first to the ground. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: so satasa(n)gat sabadh milai jo gurmukh chalai ||
verses.translation: They alone walk as Gurmukh, who receive the Shabad in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: sach dhiaain se sache jin har kharach dhan palai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the True Lord, they become truthful; they carry in their robes the supplies of the Lord's wealth.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਚਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat sohan gun gaavadhe gurmat achalai ||
verses.translation: The devotees look beautiful, singing the Praises of the Lord; following the Guru's Teachings, they become stable and unchanging.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: ratan beechaar man vasiaa gur kai sabadh bhalai ||
verses.translation: They enshrine the jewel of contemplation within their minds, and the most sublime Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: aape mel milaidhaa aape dhei vaddiaaiee ||19||
verses.translation: He Himself unites in His Union; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa a(n)dhar sabh ko koi niraasaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Everyone is filled with hope; hardly anyone is free of hope.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jo mar jeeviaa sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed is the birth of one, who remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਸਾ ਹਥਿ ਹੈ ਕੇਉ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa kichh aasaa hath hai keau niraasaa hoi ||
verses.translation: Nothing is in the hands of hope. How can one become free of hope?

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਏਹ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਜਾਂ ਭੋੁਲਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kiaa kare eh bapuRee jaa(n) bhuolaae soi ||2||
verses.translation: What can this poor being do? The Lord Himself creates confusion. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar sache naam bin ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the life in this world, without the True Name.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhaataa dhaataar nihachal eh dhan ||
verses.translation: God is the Great Giver of givers. His wealth is permanent and unchanging.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas aaraadhe niramal soi jan ||
verses.translation: That humble being is immaculate, who worships the Lord with each and every breath.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਅਗਮੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕੁ ਭਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee agam rasanaa ek bhan ||
verses.translation: With your tongue, vibrate the One Inaccessible Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: rav rahiaa sarabat naanak bal jaiee ||20||
verses.translation: He is all-pervading everywhere. Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰੇ ਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: saravar ha(n)s dhure hee melaa khasamai evai bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: The union between the lake of the True Guru, and the swan of the soul, was pre-ordained from the very beginning, by the Pleasure of the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੋ ਹੰਸਾ ਕਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: saravar a(n)dhar heeraa motee so ha(n)saa kaa khaanaa ||
verses.translation: The diamonds are in this lake; they are the food of the swans.

verses.original: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗੁ ਨ ਰਹਈ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: bagulaa kaag na rahiee saravar je hovai at siaanaa ||
verses.translation: The cranes and the ravens may be very wise, but they do not remain in this lake.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਨ ਪਇਓ ਓਥੈ ਓਨੑਾ ਹੋਰੋ ਖਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: onaa rijak na pio othai on(h)aa horo khaanaa ||
verses.translation: They do not find their food there; their food is different.

verses.original: ਸਚਿ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਚੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach kamaanai sacho paieeaai kooRai kooRaa maanaa ||
verses.translation: Practicing Truth, the True Lord is found. False is the pride of the false.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪੈਯਾ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kau satigur miliaa jinaa dhure paiyaa paravaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, who are so pre-destined by the Lord's Command. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਉਜਲਾ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: saahib meraa ujalaa je ko chit karei ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is immaculate, as are those who think of Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak soiee seveeaai sadhaa sadhaa jo dhei ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, serve Him, who gives to you forever and ever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak soiee seveeaai jit seviaai dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, serve Him; by serving Him, sorrow is dispelled.

verses.original: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: avagun va(n)n(j)n gun raveh man sukh vasai aai ||2||
verses.translation: Faults and demerits vanish, and virtues take their place; peace comes to dwell in the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap varatadhaa aap taaRee laieean ||
verses.translation: He Himself is all-pervading; He Himself is absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਉਪਦੇਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤੀਆਈਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape hee upadhesadhaa gurmukh pateeaaieean ||
verses.translation: He Himself instructs; the Gurmukh is satisfied and fulfilled.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: eik aape ujhaR paian ik bhagatee laian ||
verses.translation: Some, He causes to wander in the wilderness, while others are committed to His devotional worship.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee aape nai laieean ||
verses.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; He Himself attaches mortals to His Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai sachee vaddiaaiee ||21||1|| sudh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, true greatness is obtained. ||21||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: raamakalee kee vaar mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Vaar Of Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਣੀਦਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਡੀਠੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaisaa satigur suneedhaa taiso hee mai ddeeTh ||
verses.translation: As I have heard of the True Guru, so I have seen Him.

verses.original: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਬਸੀਠੁ ॥
verses.translit: vichhuRiaa mele prabhoo har dharageh kaa baseeTh ||
verses.translation: He re-unites the separated ones with God; He is the Mediator at the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਦਾ ਕਟੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naamo ma(n)tr dhiraRaidhaa kaTe haumai rog ||
verses.translation: He implants the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and eradicates the illness of egotism.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਪਇਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur tinaa milaiaa jinaa dhure piaa sa(n)jog ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he alone meets the True Guru, who has such union pre-ordained. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik sajan sabh sajanaa ik vairee sabh vaadh ||
verses.translation: If the One Lord is my Friend, then all are my friends. If the One Lord is my enemy, then all fight with me.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai dhekhaaliaa vin naavai sabh baadh ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has shown me that, without the Name, everything is useless.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਜੋ ਲਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: saakat dhurajan bharamiaa jo lage dhoojai saadh ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics and the evil people wander in reincarnation; they are attached to other tastes.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har prabh bujhiaa gur satigur kai parasaadh ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has realized the Lord God, by the Grace of the Guru, the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਥਟਣਹਾਰੈ ਥਾਟੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਥਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: thaTanahaarai thaaT aape hee thaTiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Lord created the Creation.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape pooraa saahu aape hee khaTiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the perfect Banker; He Himself earns His profit.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape kar paasaar aape ra(n)g raTiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself made the expansive Universe; He Himself is imbued with joy.

verses.original: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਇ ਅਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kudharat keem na pai alakh brahamaTiaa ||
verses.translation: The value of God's almighty creative power cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: agam athaeh bea(n)t parai paraTiaa ||
verses.translation: He is inaccessible, unfathomable, endless, the farthest of the far.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਜੀਰਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape vadd paatisaahu aap vajeeraTiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the greatest Emperor; He Himself is His own Prime Minister.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਮਟਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: koi na jaanai keem kevadd maTiaa ||
verses.translation: No one knows His worth, or the greatness of His resting place.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib aap gurmukh paragaTiaa ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself is our True Lord and Master. He reveals Himself to the Gurmukh. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਜਣ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: sun sajan preetam meriaa mai satigur dheh dhikhaal ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my beloved friend: please show me the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਮਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau tis dhevaa man aapanaa nit hiradhai rakhaa samaal ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my mind to Him; I keep Him continually enshrined within my heart.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eikas satigur baaharaa dhirag jeevan sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Without the One and Only True Guru, life in this world is cursed.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਿਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak satigur tinaa milaion jin sadh hee varatai naal ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, they alone meet the True Guru, with whom He constantly abides. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਚਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: merai a(n)tar lochaa milan kee kiau paavaa prabh toh ||
verses.translation: Deep within me is the longing to meet You; how can I find You, God?

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜੋ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: koiee aaisaa sajan loR lahu jo mele preetam moh ||
verses.translation: I will search for someone, some friend, who will unite me with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai melaiaa jat dhekhaa tat soi ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him; wherever I look, there He is.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak so prabh seviaa tis jevadd avar na koi ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak serves that God; there is no other as great as He is. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: dhevanahaar dhaataar kit mukh saalaaheeaai ||
verses.translation: He is the Great Giver, the Generous Lord; with what mouth can I praise Him?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਰਖੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis rakhai kirapaa dhaar rijak samaaheeaai ||
verses.translation: In His Mercy, He protects, preserves and sustains us.

verses.original: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਇਕ ਧਰ ॥
verses.translit: koi na kis hee vas sabhanaa ik dhar ||
verses.translation: No one is under anyone else's control; He is the One Support of all.

verses.original: ਪਾਲੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਵਾਗਿ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰ ॥
verses.translit: paale baalak vaag dhe kai aap kar ||
verses.translation: He cherishes all as His children, and reaches out with His hand.

verses.original: ਕਰਦਾ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: karadhaa anadh binodh kichhoo na jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: He stages His joyous plays, which no one understands at all.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sarab dhaar samarath hau tis kurabaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The all-powerful Lord gives His Support to all; I am a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਗਾਈਐ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਗਾਵਣ ਜੋਗਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gaieeaai raat dhina(n)t gaavan jogiaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, sing the Praises of the One who is worthy of being praised.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo gur kee pairee paeh tinee har ras bhogiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Those who fall at the Guru's Feet, enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੀੜਹੁ ਮੋਕਲਾਈ ਕੀਤੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਰਖੇ ਕੁਟੰਬੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: bheeRahu mokalaiee keeteean sabh rakhe kuTa(n)bai naal ||
verses.translation: He has widened the narrow path for me, and preserved my integrity, along with that of my family.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਸਭਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj aap savaarian so prabh sadhaa sabhaal ||
verses.translation: He Himself has arranged and resolved my affairs. I dwell upon that God forever.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਲਹੁੜੇ ਬਾਲਕ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh maat pitaa ka(n)Th laidhaa lahuRe baalak paal ||
verses.translation: God is my mother and father; He hugs me close in His embrace, and cherishes me, like His tiny baby.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhiaal hoe sabh jeea ja(n)tr har naanak nadhar nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me. O Nanak, the Lord has blessed me with His Glance of Grace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਜਿ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਖਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: vin tudh hor j ma(n)ganaa sir dhukhaa kai dhukh ||
verses.translation: To ask for any other than You, Lord, is the most miserable of miseries.

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: dheh naam sa(n)tokheeaa utarai man kee bhukh ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Name, and make me content; may the hunger of my mind be satisfied.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਤਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਆ ਮਨੁਖ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur van tin hariaa keetiaa naanak kiaa manukh ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru has made the woods and meadows green again. O Nanak, is it any wonder that He blesses human beings as well? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa dhaataar manahu na veesarai ||
verses.translation: Such is that Great Giver; may I never forget Him from my mind.

verses.original: ਘੜੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਚਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾ ਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghaRee na muhat chasaa tis bin naa sarai ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive without Him, for an instant, for a moment, for a second.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਲੁਕਿ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar baahar sa(n)g kiaa ko luk karai ||
verses.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, He is with us; how can we hide anything from Him?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis pat rakhai aap so bhavajal tarai ||
verses.translation: One whose honor He Himself has preserved, crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat giaanee tapaa jis kirapaa karai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a devotee, a spiritual teacher, and a disciplined pratictioner of meditation, whom the Lord has so blessed.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਲੁ ਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so pooraa paradhaan jis no bal dharai ||
verses.translation: He alone is perfect and renowned as supreme, whom the Lord has blessed with His power.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh jaraae aap soiee ajar jarai ||
verses.translation: He alone endures the unendurable, whom the Lord inspires to endure it.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis hee miliaa sach ma(n)tr gur man dharai ||3||
verses.translation: And he alone meets the True Lord, within whose mind the Guru's Mantra is implanted. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੜੇ ਆਲਾਪਤ ਸਭ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su raag sura(n)gaRe aalaapat sabh tikh jai ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those beautiful Ragas which, when chanted, quench all thirst.

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪਦੇ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su ja(n)t suhaavaRe jo gurmukh japadhe naau ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those beautiful people who, as Gurmukh, chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jinee ik man ik araadhiaa tin sadh balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who single-mindedly worship and adore the One Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਹਮ ਬਾਛਦੇ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin kee dhooR ham baachhadhe karamee palai pai ||
verses.translation: I yearn for the dust of their feet; by His Grace, it is obtained.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo rate ra(n)g govidh kai hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are imbued with love for the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਆਖਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aakhaa birathaa jeea kee har sajan melahu rai ||
verses.translation: I tell them the state of my soul, and pray that I may be united with the Sovereign Lord King, my Friend.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai melaiaa janam maran dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has united me with Him, and the pains of birth and death have departed.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak paiaa agam roop anat na kaahoo jai ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found the inaccessible, infinitely beautiful Lord, and he will not go anywhere else. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਪਲੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su velaa ghaRee dha(n)n dhan moorat pal saar ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that time, blessed is that hour, blessed is that second, excellent is that instant;

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੜਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su dhinas sa(n)jogaRaa jit ddiThaa gur dharasaar ||
verses.translation: blessed is that day, and that opportunity, when I gazed upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa har paiaa agam apaar ||
verses.translation: The mind's desires are fulfilled, when the inaccessible, unfathomable Lord is obtained.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟਾ ਮੋਹੜਾ ਇਕੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: haumai tuTaa mohaRaa ik sach naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Egotism and emotional attachment are eradicated, and one leans only on the Support of the True Name.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak lagaa sev har udhariaa sagal sa(n)saar ||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, one who is committed to the Lord's service - the whole world is saved along with him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sifat salaahan bhagat virale dhiteean ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who are blessed to praise the Lord, in devotional worship.

verses.original: ਸਉਪੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਫਿਰਿ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਲੀਤੀਅਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saupe jis bha(n)ddaar fir puchh na leeteean ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with the Lord's treasures are not called to give their account again.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis no lagaa ra(n)g se ra(n)g ratiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with His Love are absorbed in ecstasy.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਇਕਾ ਉਨ ਭਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: onaa iko naam adhaar ikaa un bhatiaa ||
verses.translation: They take the Support of the One Name; the One Name is their only food.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਭੋਗਈ ॥
verses.translit: onaa pichhai jag bhu(n)chai bhogiee ||
verses.translation: For their sake, the world eats and enjoys.

verses.original: ਓਨਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਬੁ ਓਨਾਹਾ ਜੋਗਈ ॥
verses.translit: onaa piaaraa rab onaahaa jogiee ||
verses.translation: Their Beloved Lord belongs to them alone.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis miliaa gur aai tin prabh jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru comes and meets them; they alone know God.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree tin j khasamai bhaaniaa ||4||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to their Lord and Master. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ikasai naal mai dhosatee har ikasai naal mai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: My friendship is with the One Lord alone; I am in love with the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੋ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har iko meraa sajano har ikasai naal mai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my only friend; my companionship is with the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਗੋਸਟੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ikasai naal mai gosaTe muh mailaa karai na bha(n)g ||
verses.translation: My conversation is with the One Lord alone; He never frowns, or turns His face away.

verses.original: ਜਾਣੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਮੋੜੈ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaanai birathaa jeea kee kadhe na moRai ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: He alone knows the state of my soul; He never ignores my love.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਸਲਤੀ ਭੰਨਣ ਘੜਨ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: har iko meraa masalatee bha(n)nan ghaRan samarath ||
verses.translation: He is my only counselor, all-powerful to destroy and create.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਤਿਆ ਜਗ ਹਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: har iko meraa dhaataar hai sir dhaatiaa jag hath ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my only Giver. He places His hand upon the heads of the generous in the world.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ikasai dhee mai Tek hai jo sir sabhanaa samarath ||
verses.translation: I take the Support of the One Lord alone; He is all-powerful, over the heads of all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sa(n)t milaiaa masatak dhar kai hath ||
verses.translation: The Saint, the True Guru, has united me with the Lord. He placed His hand on my forehead.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa saahib guroo milaiaa jin taariaa sagal jagat ||
verses.translation: The Guru led me to meet the greatest Lord and Master; He saved the whole world.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa paiaa dhur sa(n)jog ||
verses.translation: The desires of the mind are fulfilled; I have attained my pre-destined Union with God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak paiaa sach naam sadh hee bhoge bhog ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak has obtained the True Name; He enjoys the enjoyments forever. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukhaa keree dhosatee maiaa kaa sanaba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs is an alliance with Maya.

verses.original: ਵੇਖਦਿਆ ਹੀ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: vekhadhiaa hee bhaj jaan kadhe na pain ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: As we watch, they run away; they never stand firm.

verses.original: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਪੈਨਨਿ ਖਾਵਨੑੇ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਰਖਨਿ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
verses.translit: jichar painan khaavan(h)e tichar rakhan ga(n)dd ||
verses.translation: As long as they get food and clothing, they stick around.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhin kichh na hoviee tit dhin bolan ga(n)dh ||
verses.translation: But on that day when they receive nothing, then they start to curse.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea kee saar na jaananee manmukh agiaanee a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are ignorant and blind; they do not know the secrets of the soul.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਚਿਕੜਿ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: kooRaa ga(n)dd na chaliee chikaR pathar ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The false bond does not last; it is like stones joined with mud.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟਨਿ ਧੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe aap na jaananee fakaR piTan dha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The blind do not understand themselves; they are engrossed in false worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jhooThai moh lapaTaiaa hau hau karat biha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Entangled in false attachments, they pass their lives in egotism and self-conceit.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kare jis aapanee dhur pooraa karam karei ||
verses.translation: But that being, whom the Lord has blessed with His Mercy from the very beginning, does perfect deeds, and accumulates good karma.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak se jan ubare jo satigur saran pare ||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, those humble beings alone are saved, who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ਸੇਈ ਸਚੁ ਹਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo rate dheedhaar seiee sach haak ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision, speak the Truth.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਭੈ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinee jaataa khasam kiau labhai tinaa khaak ||
verses.translation: How can I obtain the dust of those who realize their Lord and Master?

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mailaa vekaar hovai sa(n)g paak ||
verses.translation: The mind, stained by corruption, becomes pure by associating with them.

verses.original: ਦਿਸੈ ਸਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਭਰਮ ਤਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhisai sachaa mahal khulai bharam taak ||
verses.translation: One sees the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, when the door of doubt is opened.

verses.original: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਧਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: jiseh dhikhaale mahal tis na milai dhaak ||
verses.translation: That one, unto whom the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed, is never pushed or shoved.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਬਿੰਦਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਝਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: man tan hoi nihaal bi(n)dhak nadhar jhaak ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are enraptured, when the Lord blesses me, even for an instant, with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: nau nidh naam nidhaan gur kai sabadh laag ||
verses.translation: The nine treasures, and the treasure of the Naam are obtained by commitment to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤ ਖਾਕੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tisai milai sa(n)t khaak masatak jisai bhaag ||5||
verses.translation: He alone is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Saints, upon whose forehead such pre-ordained destiny is inscribed. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਣਾਖੀ ਕੂ ਸਚੁ ਵੈਣੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ਜੋ ਤਉ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: haranaakhee koo sach vain sunaiee jo tau kare udhaaran ||
verses.translation: O deer-eyed bride, I speak the Truth, which shall save you.

verses.original: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਬਚਨ ਤੁਮ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਛਬੀਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਤੈਡਾ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਾਰਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: su(n)dhar bachan tum sunahu chhabeelee pir taiddaa man saadhaaran ||
verses.translation: Listen to these beautiful words, O beauteous bride; your Beloved Lord is your mind's only support.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਨੇਹੁ ਰਚਾਇਓ ਦਸਿ ਵਿਖਾ ਮੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhurajan setee neh rachaio dhas vikhaa mai kaaran ||
verses.translation: You have fallen in love with an evil person; tell me - show me why!

verses.original: ਊਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਝੂਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: uoonee naahee jhoonee naahee naahee kisai vihoonee ||
verses.translation: I lack nothing, and I am not sad or depressed; I have no deficiency at all.

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੈਲੁ ਛਬੀਲਾ ਛਡਿ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: pir chhail chhabeelaa chhadd gavaio dhuramat karam vihoonee ||
verses.translation: I abandoned and lost my fascinating and beautiful Husband Lord; in this evil-mindedness, I have lost my good fortune.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਭੁਲੀ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਚੁਕੀ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੋਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: naa hau bhulee naa hau chukee naa mai naahee dhosaa ||
verses.translation: I am not mistaken, and I am not confused; I have no egotism, and commit no offense.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਉ ਲਗੀ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jit hau laiee tit hau lagee too sun sach sa(n)dhesaa ||
verses.translation: As You have linked me, so I am linked; listen to my true message.

verses.original: ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਈ ਭਾਗਣਿ ਜੈ ਪਿਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: saiee suohaagan saiee bhaagan jai pir kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: She alone is the blessed soul-bride, and she alone is fortunate, upon whom the Husband Lord has showered His Mercy.

verses.original: ਪਿਰਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: pir aaugan tis ke sabh gavaae gal setee lai savaaree ||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord takes away all her faults and mistakes; hugging her close in His embrace, He embellishes her.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਕਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karamaheen dhan karai bina(n)tee kadh naanak aavai vaaree ||
verses.translation: The unfortunate soul-bride makes this prayer: O Nanak, when will my turn come?

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਇਕ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh suhaagan maaneh raleeaa ik dhevahu raat muraaree ||1||
verses.translation: All the blessed soul-brides celebrate and make merry; bless me as well with a night of bliss, O Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਡੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe man too ddolataa har manasaa pooranahaar ||
verses.translation: Why do you waver, O my mind? The Lord is the Fulfiller of hopes and desires.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur purakh dhiaai too sabh dhukh visaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being; He is the Destroyer of all pains.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਮਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har naamaa aaraadh man sabh kilavikh jaeh vikaar ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the Lord's Name, O my mind; all sins and corruption shall be washed away.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin ra(n)g lagaa nira(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, are in love with the Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਓਨੀ ਛਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੁਆਵੜਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: onee chhaddiaa maiaa suaavaRaa dhan sa(n)chiaa naam apaar ||
verses.translation: They abandon the tastes of Maya, and gather in the infinite wealth of the Naam.

verses.original: ਅਠੇ ਪਹਰ ਇਕਤੈ ਲਿਵੈ ਮੰਨੇਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aThe pahar ikatai livai ma(n)nen hukam apaar ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, they are lovingly absorbed in the One Lord; they surrender and accept the Will of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhaan ik dheh dharas man piaar ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for this one gift: please bless me, Lord, with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; my mind is in love with You. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: jis too aaveh chit tis no sadhaa sukh ||
verses.translation: One who is conscious of You finds everlasting peace.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮ ਨਾਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: jis too aaveh chit tis jam naeh dhukh ||
verses.translation: One who is conscious of You does not suffer at the hands of the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿ ਕਾੜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis too aaveh chit tis k kaaRiaa ||
verses.translation: One who is conscious of You is not anxious.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhaa karataa mitr sabh kaaj savaariaa ||
verses.translation: One who has the Creator as his Friend - all his affairs are resolved.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis too aaveh chit so paravaan jan ||
verses.translation: One who is conscious of You is renowned and respected.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis too aaveh chit bahutaa tis dhan ||
verses.translation: One who is conscious of You becomes very wealthy.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis too aaveh chit so vadd paravaariaa ||
verses.translation: One who is conscious of You has a great family.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jis too aaveh chit tin kul udhaariaa ||6||
verses.translation: One who is conscious of You saves his ancestors. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਨਾ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dharahu a(n)naa baaharahu a(n)naa kooRee kooRee gaavai ||
verses.translation: Blind inwardly, and blind outwardly, he sings falsely, falsely.

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਣਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੋ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee dhovai chakar banaae maiaa no bahu dhaavai ||
verses.translation: He washes his body, and draws ritual marks on it, and totally runs after wealth.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar mail na utarai haumai fir fir aavai jaavai ||
verses.translation: But the filth of his egotism is not removed from within, and over and over again, he comes and goes in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਨੀਂਦ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਸੰਤਾਪਿਆ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: nee(n)dh viaapiaa kaam sa(n)taapiaa mukhahu har har kahaavai ||
verses.translation: Engulfed in sleep, and tormented by frustrated sexual desire, he chants the Lord's Name with his mouth.

verses.original: ਬੈਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਤੁਹ ਕੁਟੇ ਕਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: baisano naam karam hau jugataa tuh kuTe kiaa fal paavai ||
verses.translation: He is called a Vaishnav, but he is bound to deeds of egotism; by threshing only husks, what rewards can be obtained?

verses.original: ਹੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਠਾ ਬਗੁ ਨ ਬਣਈ ਨਿਤ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਛੀ ਨੋ ਤਾਰ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)saa vich baiThaa bag na baniee nit baiThaa machhee no taar laavai ||
verses.translation: Sitting among the swans, the crane does not become one of them; sitting there, he keeps staring at the fish.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਹੰਸ ਸਭਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਨਿ ਤਾ ਬਗਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਜੋੜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ha(n)s sabhaa veechaar kar dhekhan taa bagaa naal joR kadhe na aavai ||
verses.translation: And when the gathering of swans looks and sees, they realize that they can never form an alliance with the crane.

verses.original: ਹੰਸਾ ਹੀਰਾ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੁਗਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਡਡਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ha(n)saa heeraa motee chuganaa bag ddaddaa bhaalan jaavai ||
verses.translation: The swans peck at the diamonds and pearls, while the crane chases after frogs.

verses.original: ਉਡਰਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਬਗੁਲਾ ਮਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੰਞੁ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: auddariaa vechaaraa bagulaa mat hovai ma(n)n(j) lakhaavai ||
verses.translation: The poor crane flies away, so that his secret will not be exposed.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੋਸੁ ਦਿਚੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jit ko laiaa tit hee laagaa kis dhos dhichai jaa har evai bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord attaches one to, to that he is attached. Who is to blame, when the Lord wills it so?

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਰਤਨੀ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saravar ratanee bharapoore jis praapat so paavai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the lake, overflowing with pearls. One who meets the True Guru obtains them.

verses.original: ਸਿਖ ਹੰਸ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਇਕਠੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sikh ha(n)s saravar ikaThe hoe satigur kai hukamaavai ||
verses.translation: The Sikh-swans gather at the lake, according to the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਮਾਣਕ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ratan padhaarath maanak saravar bharapoore khai kharach rahe toT na aavai ||
verses.translation: The lake is filled with the wealth of these jewels and pearls; they are spent and consumed, but they never run out.

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰ ਹੰਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saravar ha(n)s dhoor na hoiee karate evai bhaavai ||
verses.translation: The swan never leaves the lake; such is the Pleasure of the Creator's Will.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak jis dhai masatak bhaag dhur likhiaa so sikh guroo peh aavai ||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead - that Sikh comes to the Guru.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਭਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap tariaa kuTa(n)b sabh taare sabhaa sirasaT chhaddaavai ||1||
verses.translation: He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well; he emancipates the whole world. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਆਖਾਏ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਰਾਹੀ ਕੋਰੜ ਮੋਠ ਜਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit aakhaae bahutee raahee koraR moTh jinehaa ||
verses.translation: He is called a Pandit, a religious scholar, and yet he wanders along many pathways. He is as hard as uncooked beans.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਤਿਸਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar moh nit bharam viaapiaa tisaTas naahee dhehaa ||
verses.translation: He is filled with attachment, and constantly engrossed in doubt; his body cannot hold still.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੀ ਆਵੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: kooRee aavai kooRee jaavai maiaa kee nit johaa ||
verses.translation: False is his coming, and false is his going; he is continually on the lookout for Maya.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਤਾ ਛੋਹੋ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਰੋਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: sach kahai taa chhoho aavai a(n)tar bahutaa rohaa ||
verses.translation: If someone speaks the truth, then he is aggravated; he is totally filled with anger.

verses.original: ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕੁਮੂੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: viaapiaa dhuramat kubudh kumooRaa man laagaa tis mohaa ||
verses.translation: The evil fool is engrossed in evil-mindedness and false intellectualizations; his mind is attached to emotional attachment.

verses.original: ਠਗੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਠਗੁ ਰਲਿ ਆਇਆ ਸਾਥੁ ਭਿ ਇਕੋ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: Thagai setee Thag ral aaiaa saath bh iko jehaa ||
verses.translation: The deceiver abides with the five deceivers; it is a gathering of like minds.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਵਿਚਦੋ ਕਢੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਇਆ ਲੋਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saraaf nadharee vichadho kaddai taa(n) ughaR aaiaa lohaa ||
verses.translation: And when the Jeweller, the True Guru, appraises him, then he is exposed as mere iron.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਥਾਈ ਰਲਾਇ ਰਲਾਇ ਦਿਤਾ ਉਘੜਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਅਗੈ ਆਇ ਖਲੋਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: bahuteree thaiee ralai ralai dhitaa ughaRiaa paRadhaa agai aai khalohaa ||
verses.translation: Mixed and mingled with others, he was passed off as genuine in many places; but now, the veil has been lifted, and he stands naked before all.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜੇ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਨੂਰਹੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee je saranee aavai fir manoorahu ka(n)chan hohaa ||
verses.translation: One who comes to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, shall be transformed from iron into gold.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਟੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਧੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur niravair putr satr samaane aaugan kaTe kare sudh dhehaa ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has no anger or vengeance; He looks upon son and enemy alike. Removing faults and mistakes, He purifies the human body.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: naanak jis dhur masatak hovai likhiaa tis satigur naal sanehaa ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, is in love with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੇਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee satigur poore kee jis kirapaal hovai tis ridhai vasehaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Perfect True Guru's Bani is Ambrosial Nectar; it dwells in the heart of one who is blessed by the Guru's Mercy.

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਹਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa tis kaa kaTeeaai sadhaa sadhaa sukh hohaa ||2||
verses.translation: His coming and going in reincarnation is ended; forever and ever, he is at peace. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਬੁਝਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)t so tudh bujhiee ||
verses.translation: He alone understands You, Lord, with whom You are pleased.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਜੰਤੁ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਿਝਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaanaa ja(n)tu su dharageh sijhiee ||
verses.translation: He alone is approved in the Court of the Lord, with whom You are pleased.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no teree nadhar haumai tis giee ||
verses.translation: Egotism is eradicated, when You bestow Your Grace.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਕਲਮਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਖਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too sa(n)tusaT kalamal tis khiee ||
verses.translation: Sins are erased, when You are thoroughly pleased.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੋ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai suaamee val nirabhau so bhiee ||
verses.translation: One who has the Lord Master on his side, becomes fearless.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋ ਥਿਅਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too kirapaal sachaa so thiee ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with Your Mercy, becomes truthful.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਇਆ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ਅਗਨਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis no teree miaa na pohai aganiee ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with Your Kindness, is not touched by fire.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tis no sadhaa dhiaal jin gur te mat liee ||7||
verses.translation: You are forever Merciful to those who are receptive to the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa kirapaal aape bakhas lai ||
verses.translation: Please grant Your Grace, O Merciful Lord; please forgive me.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਇ ਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa japee teraa naam satigur pai pai ||
verses.translation: Forever and ever, I chant Your Name; I fall at the feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੁ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan a(n)tar vas dhookhaa naas hoi ||
verses.translation: Please, dwell within my mind and body, and end my sufferings.

verses.original: ਹਥ ਦੇਇ ਆਪਿ ਰਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਭਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hath dhei aap rakh viaapai bhau na koi ||
verses.translation: Please give me Your hand, and save me, that fear may not afflict me.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਏਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavaa dhin rain etai ka(n)m lai ||
verses.translation: May I sing Your Glorious Praises day and night; please commit me to this task.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kai sa(n)g haumai rog jai ||
verses.translation: Associating with the humble Saints, the disease of egotism is eradicated.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sarab nira(n)tar khasam eko rav rahiaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord and Master is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee sach sacho sach lahiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have truly found the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਪਣੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa karahu dhiaal apanee sifat dheh ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Kindness, O Kind Lord, and bless me with Your Praises.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan dhekh nihaal naanak preet eh ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I am in ecstasy; this is what Nanak loves. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਜਪੀਐ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਇਕਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eko japeeaai manai maeh ikas kee saranai ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the One Lord within your mind, and enter the Sanctuary of the One Lord alone.

verses.original: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eikas siau kar pirahaRee dhoojee naahee jai ||
verses.translation: Be in love with the One Lord; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eiko dhaataa ma(n)geeaai sabh kichh palai pai ||
verses.translation: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you will be blessed with everything.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan saas giraas prabh iko ik dhiaai ||
verses.translation: In your mind and body, with each breath and morsel of food, meditate on the One and only Lord God.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan sach gurmukh paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh obtains the true treasure, the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee te sa(n)t jan jin man vuThaa aai ||
verses.translation: Very fortunate are those humble Saints, within whose minds the Lord has come to abide.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal rav rahiaa dhoojaa koiee naeh ||
verses.translation: He is pervading and permeating the water, the land and the sky; there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam dhiaaiee naam ucharaa naanak khasam rajai ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Naam, and chanting the Naam, Nanak abides in the Will of his Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too rakhavaalaa maare tis kaun ||
verses.translation: One who has You as his Saving Grace - who can kill him?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਜਿਤਾ ਤਿਨੈ ਭੈਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too rakhavaalaa jitaa tinai bhain ||
verses.translation: One who has You as his Saving Grace conquers the three worlds.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no teraa a(n)g tis mukh ujalaa ||
verses.translation: One who has You on his side - his face is radiant and bright.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no teraa a(n)gu su niramalee hoo(n) niramalaa ||
verses.translation: One who has You on his side, is the purest of the Pure.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਲੇਖਾ ਪੁਛੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis no teree nadhar na lekhaa puchheeaai ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with Your Grace is not called to give his account.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਖੁਸੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭੁੰਚੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jis no teree khusee tin nau nidh bhu(n)cheeaai ||
verses.translation: One with whom You are pleased, obtains the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵਲਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis no too prabh val tis kiaa muhachha(n)dhagee ||
verses.translation: One who has You on his side, God - unto whom is he subservient?

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਬੰਦਿਗੀ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jis no teree mihar su teree ba(n)dhigee ||8||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with Your Kind Mercy is dedicated to Your worship. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਿਹਾਵੇ ॥
verses.translit: hoh kirapaal suaamee mere sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)g vihaave ||
verses.translation: Be Merciful, O my Lord and Master, that I may pass my life in the Society of the Saints.

verses.original: ਤੁਧਹੁ ਭੁਲੇ ਸਿ ਜਮਿ ਜਮਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੁਕਨਿ ਹਾਵੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tudhahu bhule s jam jam maradhe tin kadhe na chukan haave ||1||
verses.translation: Those who forget You are born only to die and be reincarnated again; their sufferings will never end. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਘਟ ਘਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: satigur simarahu aapanaa ghaT avaghaT ghaT ghaaT ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance within your heart on the True Guru, whether you are on the most difficult path, on the mountain or by the river bank.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੰਧੈ ਵਾਟ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har har naam japa(n)tiaa koi na ba(n)dhai vaaT ||2||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, no one shall block your way. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:
